Jumle: Lefetexto
Sentence: Preface

Jumle: Bonata cel Tigades lilhikaye in Globasa
Sentence: Welcome to Thirty Short Stories in Globasa

Jumle: Hin kitabu le bekrea cel na sahay yu na velosi doxo Globasa.
Sentence: This book was created to help you read Globasa fluently.

Jumle: Moyun jumle in Globasa befolo aselli jumle in Englisa.
Sentence: Each sentence in Globasa is followed by the original sentence in English.

Jumle: Am xidu na aham moyun jumle in Globasa, ji jaxali, am moni yusu aham yon Englisali mambatexto.
Sentence: Try to understand each sentence in Globasa and then check your understanding with the English original.

Jumle: Mi (Vanege) rekomenda ki yu yongu yusu hanta or alo tul cel na koberi resta de texto durki yu doxo.
Sentence: I (Vanege) recommend that you use your hand or another tool to hide the rest of the text as you read.

Jumle: Maxori hikaye bekrea in Englisa yon ChatGPT-4o (OpenAI) yon ingi har max or min detale tem hikaye.
Sentence: Most stories are generated in English using ChatGPT-4o (OpenAI) from a prompt with more or less details about the story.

Jumle: Kreado hikaye le jaxali bemoni ji bealogi cel maxmo bon duhikaye ji duarmoni.
Sentence: The generated stories are then curated and modified for better storytelling and consistency.

Jumle: Denwatu, oto bebasatayti cel Globasa yon Claude 3 Opus (Anthropic) yon Globasali menalari, gramati, pimpan sahigi, ji lil kanonli textolari.
Sentence: Then they are translated to Globasa with Claude 3 Opus (Anthropic) using the Globasa dictionary, grammar, frequent corrections and a small corpus of texts.

Jumle: Moyun basa-taytido hikaye le bemoni ji besahigi minimum dua maharapul Globasayen.
Sentence: Each translated story has been proofread and corrected by at least two skilled Globasa users.

Jumle: Imi abil na yakingi tas yu ki inhare de hikaye sen sahi ji estandarli Globasa.
Sentence: We can ensure you that the content of the stories is correct and standard Globasa.

Jumle: Mi vole na xukra Aldo kos dayday sahay, ji pia moy membro de Globasali Discord-servitul hu da le gibe ijen tem hikaye.
Sentence: I would like to thank Aldo for the enormous help, and also all the members of the Globasa Discord server who gave input on the stories.

Jumle: Balutajozi
Sentence: Acorn

Jumle: In xantipul drevogeo, daylil sinjabu namedo Espayk ogar.
Sentence: In a quiet forest, there was a tiny squirrel named Espayk.

Jumle: Espayk hare day brilapul oko ji belonarem koda.
Sentence: Espayk had big, bright eyes and a fluffy tail.

Jumle: Te multi suki na toncudu balutajozi.
Sentence: He loved to collect acorns.

Jumle: Un soba, Espayk jagecu ji xorjui ki moy tesu balutajozi le awcu.
Sentence: One morning, Espayk woke up to find that all his acorns were gone.

Jumle: Te oko fe jowey, mas oto sen okoible nilloka.
Sentence: He looked around, but they were nowhere to be seen.

Jumle: Espayk yolyu.
Sentence: Espayk was worried.

Jumle: Bardimosem nun ata ji te haja yam.
Sentence: Winter was coming, and he needed food.

Jumle: Espayk karar na xerca balutajozi.
Sentence: Espayk decided to search for acorns.

Jumle: Te pawbu pas drevogeo, te oko bax ganmoku ji in drevo.
Sentence: He ran through the forest, looking under bushes and in trees.

Jumle: Te peti sesu dostetim na sahay.
Sentence: He asked his friends for help.

Jumle: Moy piu, kargux ji hirxa toncu ton te in xerca.
Sentence: The birds, rabbits, and deer all joined him in the search.

Jumle: Ete xerca dur total nuru.
Sentence: They searched all day.

Jumle: Preciso denwatu hu sola infracu, ete ewreka sangudo estoka fe balutajozi.
Sentence: Just as the sun was setting, they found a hidden stash of acorns.

Jumle: Lutufpul lao borsuke le dupul hifazi oto.
Sentence: A kind old badger had been saving them.

Jumle: Borsuke oko yolyu de Espayk, ji te karar na sahay.
Sentence: The badger saw Espayk's worry and decided to help.

Jumle: Borsuke dishadya balutajozi tas Espayk ji tesu dostetim.
Sentence: The badger shared the acorns with Espayk and his friends.

Jumle: Espayk sen daymo xukrapul.
Sentence: Espayk was very grateful.

Jumle: Te ji tesu doste pulgi sesu goyuogar yon balutajozi.
Sentence: He and his friends filled their burrows with acorns.

Jumle: Ete sen jumbi cel bardimosem.
Sentence: They were ready for winter.

Jumle: Espayk xukra borsuke ji moy sesu doste.
Sentence: Espayk thanked the badger and all his friends.

Jumle: Te xoraham ki tonaksyon ji lutuf abil na hala he ban problema.
Sentence: He realized that teamwork and kindness could solve any problem.

Jumle: Den bardimosem, Espayk ji tesu doste resta termopul ji hox, fe na tongo befuraha balutajozi.
Sentence: That winter, Espayk and his friends stayed warm and happy, enjoying their acorns together.

Jumle: Bursolo lil megu
Sentence: The Lonely Little Cloud

Jumle: Ban mara, gao in asman, hay bursolo lil megu har name Flafi.
Sentence: Once, high in the sky, there was a lonely little cloud named Flafi.

Jumle: Flafi sen maxmo lil kom alo megu ji te le moywatu levita solo.
Sentence: Flafi was smaller than the other clouds and always drifted alone.

Jumle: Un solapul din, Flafi levita supra ixgalupul xaher.
Sentence: One sunny day, Flafi floated over a bustling city.

Jumle: Of super, te oko insan hu da ajela fe jowey.
Sentence: From above, he watched people rushing around.

Jumle: Ete kwasisen ixgalupul ji hox.
Sentence: They seemed busy and happy.

Jumle: Flafi xiwon ki te abil na sen mon de joxune banto.
Sentence: Flafi wished he could be part of something exciting.

Jumle: Durki Flafi levita, te oko grupo fe nini hu da yuxi in parke.
Sentence: As Flafi drifted, he saw a group of children playing in a park.

Jumle: Ete supraoko ji ixara hoy asman.
Sentence: They were looking up and pointing at the sky.

Jumle: Flafi levita maxmo ner.
Sentence: Flafi floated closer.

Jumle: Nini sen joxudo kos na oko megu hu da hare figura fe kargux.
Sentence: The children were excited to see a cloud shaped like a bunny.

Jumle: Flafi xoraham ki ete ixara hoy te!
Sentence: Flafi realized they were pointing at him!

Jumle: Te ganjon hox kos na pregi joxu tas nini.
Sentence: He felt happy to bring excitement to the children.

Jumle: Har ganjon fe ilhamu, Flafi karar na levita supra maxpul loka.
Sentence: Feeling inspired, Flafi decided to drift over more places.

Jumle: Te flota supra sahel, drevogeo, ji hata jabal.
Sentence: He floated over a beach, a forest, and even a mountain.

Jumle: He moyloka hu cel da te idi, insan tabasum ji ixara hoy tesu plu solunpul figura.
Sentence: Everywhere he went, people smiled and pointed at his unique shapes.

Jumle: Flafi no haji ganjon bursolo.
Sentence: Flafi no longer felt lonely.

Jumle: Te aham ki tesu presen in asman pregi hoxya tas alo ete.
Sentence: He understood that his presence in the sky brought happiness to others.

Jumle: Te le ewreka sesu cele.
Sentence: He had found his purpose.

Jumle: Xorfe den din, Flafi nilwatu sen realmo solo.
Sentence: From that day, Flafi was never really alone.

Jumle: Te hare total dunya cel na diskonegi sesu figura, ji te daysuki na tabasumgi insan.
Sentence: He had the whole world to share his shapes with, and he loved making people smile.

Jumle: Sofipul Lao Huhu
Sentence: The Wise Old Owl

Jumle: In amiku luminkal drevogeo, hay sofipul lao huhu namedo Oliver.
Sentence: In a deep, dark forest, there was a wise old owl named Oliver.

Jumle: Oliver ogar in maxim gao drevo ji te jawgu drevogeo.
Sentence: Oliver lived in the tallest tree and watched over the forest.

Jumle: Un bardipul axam, lil maux namedo Mili sonxicu.
Sentence: One chilly evening, a small mouse named Mili lost her way.

Jumle: Te ganjon fobido ji bardipul.
Sentence: She felt scared and cold.

Jumle: Te no jixi ku te xa ewreka sesu ogar kemaner.
Sentence: She didn't know how to find her home.

Jumle: Mili oko drevo de Oliver, ji te karar na peti sahay.
Sentence: Mili saw Oliver's tree and decided to ask for help.

Jumle: Te supraidi drevo, fe na lil treme.
Sentence: She climbed up the tree, trembling a little.

Jumle: "Senyor Huhu, kam yu am sahay mi cel na ewreka misu ogar?" te swal adebupul.
Sentence: "Mr. Owl, would you help me find my way home?" she asked politely.

Jumle: Oliver infraoko hoy lil maux.
Sentence: Oliver looked down at the tiny mouse.

Jumle: Te ganjon lutuf ji te vole na sahay.
Sentence: He felt kind and wanted to help.

Jumle: "Am folo utara-estare," te loga, fe na ixara hoy brilapul estare yon sesu fleytul.
Sentence: "Follow the north star," he said, pointing his wing towards a bright star.

Jumle: "To xa gida yu cel ogar."
Sentence: "It will guide you home."

Jumle: Mili supraoko hoy estare.
Sentence: Mili looked up at the star.

Jumle: To sen kostantemo brilapul.
Sentence: It was bright and steady.

Jumle: Te xukra Oliver ji te xoru sesu dao cel ogar, yon na folo estare.
Sentence: She thanked Oliver and started her journey back home, following the star.

Jumle: Folki te anda, drevogeo sencu minno fobine.
Sentence: As she walked, the forest became less scary.

Jumle: Estare sen denpul kom doste, to lumin tesu dao.
Sentence: The star was like a friend, shining its light on her path.

Jumle: Nerxali, Mili ewreka sesu dao cel sesu konfortane kyota.
Sentence: Soon, Mili found her way back to her cozy nest.

Jumle: Mili sen xukrapul kos sahay de Oliver.
Sentence: Mili was grateful for Oliver's help.

Jumle: Te jixi ki te hare doste in sofipul lao huhu.
Sentence: She knew she had a friend in the wise old owl.

Jumle: Xorfe den noce, te nilwatu befobi na sonxicu.
Sentence: From that night, she was never afraid of getting lost.

Jumle: Drevogeo ganjon ogarsim, ji estare moywatu gida te.
Sentence: The forest felt like home, and the stars always guided her.

Jumle: Kitabudom de Oliver
Sentence: Oliver's library

Jumle: Banwatu, in bio-ativo drevogeo, jixifil juni kargux har name Beni ogar.
Sentence: Once upon a time, in a vibrant forest, there lived a curious young rabbit named Beni.

Jumle: Beni daysuki na kentan drevogeo ji na xorhare neo doste fe durya.
Sentence: Beni loved exploring the forest and making new friends along the way.

Jumle: Un solapul din, dur na tyao in drevogeo, Beni xorewreka sangudo drevolari.
Sentence: One sunny day, while hopping through the forest, Beni stumbled upon a hidden grove.

Jumle: In centro de drevolari, wangusim baluta estay, har sesu xube daygao hoy asman.
Sentence: In the center of the grove stood a majestic oak tree, its branches reaching high into the sky.

Jumle: Beni nercu cel baluta, fe na daykefuku tesu meliya ji dayje.
Sentence: Beni approached the tree, marveling at its beauty and size.

Jumle: Folki te max nercu, te xorjui lil dwer fe peda de drevo.
Sentence: As he got closer, he noticed a small door at the base of the tree.

Jumle: Jixivole de Beni sen godomo bala, ji te narem toka dwer.
Sentence: Curiosity got the better of him, and he gently knocked on the door.

Jumle: Fe tesu surprisa, dwer hanman buka, fe na onexa konfortane inya.
Sentence: To his surprise, the door slowly creaked open, revealing a cozy interior.

Jumle: Fe inya, Beni ewreka sofipul lao huhu Oliver, hu da beweygi kitabu ji papergulun.
Sentence: Inside, Beni found a wise old owl named Oliver, surrounded by books and scrolls.

Jumle: Oliver bonatagi Beni dostefil ji te invita te na kentan tesu kitabudom.
Sentence: Oliver greeted Beni warmly and invited him to explore his library.

Jumle: Beni multi joxu kos invita ji te swikara volepul.
Sentence: Beni was thrilled by the invitation and eagerly accepted.

Jumle: Durki Beni paskentan kitabulari, Oliver konegi hikaye tem histori de drevogeo ji de tosu duogartim.
Sentence: As Beni browsed through the books, Oliver shared stories of the forest's history and its inhabitants.

Jumle: Beni ore juipul, carmedo fal hikaye fe yunki, dosteya, ji aventur.
Sentence: Beni listened intently, fascinated by the tales of bravery, friendship, and adventure.

Jumle: Multi satu pasa, ji Beni xorjui ki to nun sen watu na xoridi cel ogar.
Sentence: Hours passed, and Beni realized it was time to head home.

Jumle: Te xukra Oliver kos tesu mehmangi ji kos furahaday hikaye.
Sentence: He thanked Oliver for his hospitality and the wonderful stories.

Jumle: Oliver tabasum ji loga tas Beni ki te moywatu bebonatagi na visita.
Sentence: Oliver smiled and told Beni that he was always welcome to visit.

Jumle: Xorfe den din, Beni regulapul visita kitabudom de Oliver.
Sentence: From that day forward, Beni made regular visits to Oliver's library.

Jumle: Te sencu maxmo sofipul yon moyun hikaye ji te xorhare bala linku ton lutufpul lao huhu.
Sentence: He grew wiser with each story and formed a deep bond with the kind old owl.

Jumle: Beni diskonegi sesu neo jixi ton sesu dostetim in drevogeo.
Sentence: Beni shared his newfound knowledge with his friends in the forest.

Jumle: Tongo, ete xoru plu aventur, yon gida de sofi xorharedo of hikaye de Oliver.
Sentence: Together, they embarked on adventures, guided by the wisdom gained from Oliver's stories.

Jumle: Denmaner, warisa de sofipul lao huhu durepul jiwa yon aventur de Beni ji de tesu dostetim.
Sentence: And so, the legacy of the wise old owl lived on through the adventures of Beni and his friends.

Jumle: Baytu fe multi kamer
Sentence: The House of Many Rooms

Jumle: Ban mara, in xantipul deha, hay lil baytu hu da sen alopul nenkom moy alo baytu.
Sentence: Once upon a time, in a quiet village, there stood a little house that was different from all the others.

Jumle: Moy kamer in baytu hare sesu suli magikali siri.
Sentence: Each room in the house had its own magical secret.

Jumle: In kokikamer, kaxoke ji forke danse denwatu hu nilte oko.
Sentence: In the kitchen, the spoons and forks would dance when no one was looking.

Jumle: Oto toka ji cundotu cel na krea musika hu sol baytu abil na ore da.
Sentence: They tapped and clinked to make music that only the house could hear.

Jumle: Lama boyletul fale plu melodi hu da kosa ki cayfenjan hox rota.
Sentence: The old kettle would whistle tunes that made the teacups spin joyfully around.

Jumle: Jaxali, hay familkamer hu in da kusen per sofa pimpan alocu fe kolor.
Sentence: Next was the living room, where the cushions on the couch would often change colors.

Jumle: Eger bante ganjon hazuni, kusen sencu blue.
Sentence: If someone felt sad, the cushions turned blue.

Jumle: Eger te sen hox, oto brila yon luminpul jalo ji roso kolor.
Sentence: If they are happy, they sparkled with bright yellows and reds.

Jumle: Hin kamer jixi ku kemaner na hoxgi he bante hu da inkadam.
Sentence: This room knew how to cheer up anyone who walked in.

Jumle: Banyokamer sen maxim magikali to of moy kamer.
Sentence: The bathroom was the most magical of all.

Jumle: Ayna per divar abil na pala.
Sentence: The mirror on the wall could talk.

Jumle: To gibe sofipul nasiha ji to moywatu jixi na loga nasibune xey.
Sentence: It gave wise advice and always knew the right thing to say.

Jumle: To loga hikaye fe teli dexa ji to alim darsu tem lutuf ji yunki.
Sentence: It told stories of faraway lands and taught lessons about kindness and courage.

Jumle: Fe supracengu, hay somnokamer hu in da janela onexa alo sahni fe moyun din.
Sentence: Upstairs, there was a bedroom where the window showed different views every day.

Jumle: Un din, to ible onexa solapul sahel, ji jaxali din, talujipul jabalkapi.
Sentence: One day it might display a sunny beach, and the next, a snowy mountain peak.

Jumle: To sen denpul kom na hare neo aventur moywatu hu yu oko hoy exya.
Sentence: It was like having a new adventure every time you looked outside.

Jumle: In sakfukamer, lama yuxitul hifazido denloka no sol harkakal leta.
Sentence: In the attic, the old toys stored there didn't just sit around.

Jumle: Fe noce, oto sencu jiwane.
Sentence: At night, they came alive.

Jumle: Oto yuxi ji soho loga tas se hikaye tem watu feki oto le belubi nini, hu da nun sen baligu.
Sentence: They played games and told each other stories of the days they were loved by children now grown.

Jumle: Moy kamer in baytu pregi hoxya ji wao tas moyte hu da inkadam.
Sentence: Each room in the house brought joy and wonder to those who entered.

Jumle: Hin lil baytu in deha le nilwatu sen sol baytu; to sen magikapul ogar hu da intizar na diskonegi sesu siri tas he bante hu da haja oto.
Sentence: This little house in the village was never just a house; it was a home filled with magic, waiting to share its secrets with anyone who needed them.

Jumle: Nuru in xaher
Sentence: A Day in the City

Jumle: Ana jagecu joxudo.
Sentence: Ana wakes up excited.

Jumle: Nundin, te plani na kentan xaher.
Sentence: Today, she plans to explore the city.

Jumle: Xafe sobayam, te cudu sesu xaher-harita ji te anda cel bus-estodom.
Sentence: After breakfast, she grabs her city map and walks to the bus stop.

Jumle: Bus sen daymo insanpul, mas te ewreka sidetul ner fe janela.
Sentence: The bus is crowded, but she finds a seat near the window.

Jumle: Unyum, te visita parke.
Sentence: First, she visits the park.

Jumle: Parke sen day har multi dao.
Sentence: The park is large with many paths.

Jumle: Ana exgi sesu harita cel na ewreka hosu, mas abruto lilvento fleygi harita of tesu hanta.
Sentence: Ana takes out her map to find the pond, but a sudden breeze sweeps the map out of her hands.

Jumle: Te takibu to, mas to fley cel in lilhosu.
Sentence: She chases it, but it flies into a pond.

Jumle: Fe nunya, Ana sen sonxido wal sesu harita.
Sentence: Now, Ana is lost without her map.

Jumle: Te side per benki, ji te fikir.
Sentence: She sits on a bench, thinking.

Jumle: Denwatu, te oko nini hu da yuxi yuxi yon paper ji pensil.
Sentence: Then, she sees children playing a game with a paper and pencil.

Jumle: Ana hare idey.
Sentence: Ana has an idea.

Jumle: Te anda cel ete ji te swal kama te harizin na karducudu etesu pensil.
Sentence: She walks over and asks if she can borrow their pencil.

Jumle: Nini kapi-siya, jixipeldo.
Sentence: The children nod, curious.

Jumle: Ana ruidi cel benki ji te ciru sayfa of sesu daftari.
Sentence: Ana returns to the bench and tears a piece of paper from her notebook.

Jumle: Te xoru na rasamu parke ji dao hu te memori da.
Sentence: She starts drawing the park and the paths she remembers.

Jumle: Durki te rasamu, lutufpul lao manixu xorjui ji nercu.
Sentence: As she sketches, a friendly old man notices and comes over.

Jumle: Te bon kone parke ji te sahay Ana na maxusgi plu detale tas tesu harita.
Sentence: He knows the park well and helps her add details to her map.

Jumle: Yon sesu neo harita, Ana xorata cel kafedom hu te le doxo tem da.
Sentence: With her new map, Ana finds her way to the café she read about.

Jumle: To sen lil, bonatagine dom.
Sentence: It's a small, welcoming place.

Jumle: Te peti sandwici ji bortokal-jusu.
Sentence: She orders a sandwich and orange juice.

Jumle: Dur na yam, te maxusgi max to tas sesu harita, ji te plani sesu jaxali celedom.
Sentence: While eating, she adds more to her map, planning her next stops.

Jumle: Xafe midiyam, Ana visita kitabudom ji museum yon sesu hantakreado harita hu da gida te.
Sentence: After lunch, Ana visits the library and the museum, using her handmade map to guide her.

Jumle: Moyloka hu te visita, te maxusgi max detale tas sesu harita, fe na sengi to solunpul ji personli.
Sentence: Each place she visits, she adds more details to her map, making it unique and personal.

Jumle: Fe nurufini, Ana yonidi bus cel ogar, har sesu neo harita pulgido yon memori ji hikaye.
Sentence: At the end of the day, Ana takes the bus home, her new map filled with memories and stories.

Jumle: Te ganjon fahuri.
Sentence: She feels proud.

Jumle: Te kreaabil hala sesu problema ji te xwexi max tem xaher kom te ger jixi yon sesu lama harita.
Sentence: She solved her problem creatively and learned more about the city than she ever would have with her old map.

Jumle: Te no abil na intizar na kentan neo loka har sesu harita in hanta.
Sentence: She can't wait to explore new places with her map in hand.

Jumle: Magikali drevo fe mosem.
Sentence: The Magic Tree of Seasons

Jumle: In lil deha, hay magikali drevo.
Sentence: In a small village, there is a magic tree.

Jumle: Hin drevo alocu fol mosem.
Sentence: This tree changes with the seasons.

Jumle: Fe bijamosem, to hare roso flura.
Sentence: In spring, it has pink flowers.

Jumle: Fe termomosem, to hare kijawi dahun.
Sentence: In summer, it has green leaves.

Jumle: Fe xuhamosem, to hare orange dahun.
Sentence: In autumn, it has orange leaves.

Jumle: Fe bardimosem, to no hare dahun, sol taluji.
Sentence: In winter, it has no leaves, only snow.

Jumle: Un nyan, drevo esto na alocu.
Sentence: One year, the tree stops changing.

Jumle: To sen bardimosem, mas drevo haji hare orange dahun.
Sentence: It is winter, but the tree still has orange leaves.

Jumle: Dehatim walaganjon taluji.
Sentence: The villagers miss the snow.

Jumle: Wal taluji, bardimosem sen godomo luminkal.
Sentence: Without snow, winter is too dark.

Jumle: Juni femyen, Mia, karar na sahay.
Sentence: A young girl, Mia, decides to help.

Jumle: Te lubi drevo ji te visita to fe moy din.
Sentence: She loves the tree and visits it every day.

Jumle: Mia pala tas drevo.
Sentence: Mia talks to the tree.

Jumle: Te loga, "Yu haji sen orange keseba? To sen bardimosem fe nunya. Imi haja yusu sefide taluji."
Sentence: She says, "Why are you still orange? It is winter now. We need your white snow."

Jumle: Drevo no jawabu.
Sentence: The tree does not answer.

Jumle: Mia hare idey.
Sentence: Mia has an idea.

Jumle: Te preporta kolor of ogar.
Sentence: She brings colors from home.

Jumle: Te hare roso, kijawi, orange, ji sefide pentu.
Sentence: She has pink, green, orange, and white paints.

Jumle: Te pentu un solo dahun sefide.
Sentence: She paints a single leaf white.

Jumle: Jaxali din, Mia oko sefide dahun ji te tabasum.
Sentence: The next day, Mia sees the white leaf and smiles.

Jumle: Hanman, drevo xoru na alocu.
Sentence: Slowly, the tree starts to change.

Jumle: Unyum, un dahun, xali, max to alocu sefide.
Sentence: First one leaf, then more, turn white.

Jumle: To sen mujeza!
Sentence: It is a miracle!

Jumle: Taluji xoru na sokutu.
Sentence: Snow begins to fall.

Jumle: Dehatim sen hox.
Sentence: The villagers are happy.

Jumle: Bardimosem ruata!
Sentence: Winter is back!

Jumle: Mia xwexi ki dumara, lil aksyon abil na fale day alogi.
Sentence: Mia learns that sometimes, a small action can make a big difference.

Jumle: Dehatim xwexi ki ete moywatu abil na soho sahay se.
Sentence: The villagers learn that they can always help each other.

Jumle: Fe moy mosem, ete pentu un dahun de drevo.
Sentence: Every season, they paint one leaf of the tree.

Jumle: Ete memori darsu de Mia, ji ete jaxne magikali drevo tongo.

Jumle: Kacupa ji piu
Sentence: The Turtle and the Bird

Jumle: In day xantipul drevogeo, sofipul lao kacupa namedo Tim ji juni nensabar piu har name Bela ogar.
Sentence: In a large, peaceful forest, there lives a wise old turtle named Tim and a young, restless bird named Bela.

Jumle: Tim harkacu hanman mas te befuraha moyun momento, fe kompara ki Bela velosi fley of drevo cel drevo; te moywatu xerca neo banto.
Sentence: Tim moves slowly but enjoys every moment, while Bela flies quickly from tree to tree, always looking for something new.

Jumle: Un solapul din, Bela side per xube supra Tim ji te xekaye,  "Tim, mi xiwon na ewreka maxim gao drevo."
Sentence: One sunny day, Bela perches on a branch above Tim and complains, "Tim, I wish I could find the tallest tree."

Jumle: "Drevo hinloka sen godomo cote tas mi."
Sentence: "The trees here are too short for me."

Jumle: Tim supraoko har tabasum ji te loga, "Mas Bela, of hin xube, yu abil na oko nahir, grasgeo, ji hata jabal. Kam dento no sen waone?"
Sentence: Tim looks up with a smile and says, "But Bela, from these branches, you can see the river, the meadow, and even the mountains. Isn't that wonderful?"

Jumle: Bela harka sesu yumaw. "To no sen kufi. Mi vole na oko moyto!"
Sentence: Bela fluffs her feathers. "It's not enough. I want to see everything!"

Jumle: Kararpul na sahay Bela, Tim jeni tyojan. "Moydua imi am ewreka maxim gao drevo. Yu am fley fe super, ji mi xa anda. Imi xa tonata ripul hinloka fe solainfracu."
Sentence: Determined to help Bela, Tim suggests a challenge. "Let's both find the tallest tree. You fly up, and I will walk. We meet back here at sunset."

Jumle: Joxupul, Bela xorfley cel asman, fe na ofxerca moy gona de drevogeo.
Sentence: Excited, Bela takes off into the sky, searching every corner of the forest.

Jumle: Mas Tim resta preciso samaloka, fe na oko asman na alocu fe kolor dur nurupasa.
Sentence: Tim, however, stays right where he is, watching the sky change colors as the day goes by.

Jumle: Fe solainfracu, Bela ruata, pilodo ji gitayfrustrado. "Mi le fley moyloka ji mi le no sukses na ewreka maxim gao drevo."
Sentence: At sunset, Bela returns, tired and disappointed. "I flew all around and couldn't find a taller tree."

Jumle: Tim kapi-siya ji peti te na oko jowey of loka hu in da ete sen. Bela exoko ji oko total drevogeo banyodo in dahabukolordo lumin.

Jumle: To sen meli, maxmo meli kom te memori. "Yu oko," Tim hasaxi loga, "fe dumara, otima okoxey sen preciso denloka hu in da yu sen. Yu haja sol na oko to yon neo oko."
Sentence: It's beautiful, more beautiful than she remembered. "You see," Tim says gently, "sometimes, the best view is right where you are. You just need to see it with fresh eyes."

Jumle: Bela tabasum, te xoraham meliya de sesu ogar. Te karar ki te sen preciso denloka hu in da te haja na sen.
Sentence: Bela smiles, realizing the beauty of her home. She decides she is exactly where she needs to be.

Sentence: The garden is happy and full of love.

Jumle: Uma su xerca fe medisente
Sentence: The Horse's Search for Medicine

Jumle: Hay uma har name Part.
Sentence: There is a horse named Part.

Jumle: Part no ganjon bon.
Sentence: Part is not feeling well.

Jumle: Tesu siko sen problemapul.
Sentence: His mind is troubled.

Jumle: Te pimpan ganjon fobi ji hazuniya.
Sentence: He often feels scared and sad.

Jumle: Part jixi ki te haja sahay.
Sentence: Part knows he needs help.

Jumle: Te ore tem espesyal medisente.
Sentence: He hears about a special medicine.

Jumle: Hin medisente abil na ganjongi te maxmo bon.
Sentence: This medicine can make him feel better.

Jumle: Part karar na xerca medisente.
Sentence: Part decides to find the medicine.

Jumle: Te idi cel unyum davadukan.
Sentence: He goes to the first pharmacy.

Jumle: Davadukanyen kapi-noya.
Sentence: The pharmacist shakes his head.

Jumle: Te loga, "Imi no haji hare den medisente."
Sentence: "We don't have that medicine anymore," he says.

Jumle: Part ganjon lilmo yolyudo.
Sentence: Part feels a bit more worried.

Jumle: Te xukra davadukanyen ji te awidi.
Sentence: He thanks the pharmacist and leaves.

Jumle: Part idi cel duayum davadukan.
Sentence: Part goes to a second pharmacy.

Jumle: Jawabu sen sama to.
Sentence: The answer is the same.

Jumle: Davadukanyen loga, "Imi no haji hare den medisente."
Sentence: "We don't have that medicine anymore," the pharmacist says.

Jumle: Part ganjon ki tesu siko sencu maxmo onxalakal.
Sentence: Part feels his mind getting darker.

Jumle: Te awidi, fe na ganjon onxalakalya.
Sentence: He leaves, feeling hopeless.

Jumle: Part jaribi tigayum davadukan.
Sentence: Part tries a third pharmacy.

Jumle: Davadukanyen okocu hazuni.
Sentence: The pharmacist looks sad.

Jumle: Te loga, "Imi le duhare den medisente, mas no haji."
Sentence: "We used to have that medicine, but not anymore," he says.

Jumle: Part hisi sesu tutum-nabiza na velosicu.
Sentence: Part feels his heart race.

Jumle: Te xoru na paniko mas te xukra davadukanyen ji te awidi.
Sentence: He starts to panic but thanks the pharmacist and leaves.

Jumle: Part visita max davadukan.
Sentence: Part visits more pharmacies.

Jumle: Moy mara, jawabu sen sama to.
Sentence: Every time, the answer is the same.

Jumle: Nilte hare medisente.
Sentence: No one has the medicine.

Jumle: Siko de Part burcu.
Sentence: Part's mind is getting worse.

Jumle: Te xoru na ore voka.
Sentence: He starts to hear voices.

Jumle: Te oko saye hu da fobi te.
Sentence: He sees shadows that scare him.

Jumle: Te ganjon sonxido ji bursolo.
Sentence: He feels lost and alone.

Jumle: Xerca de Part sencu dayonxalakal.
Sentence: Part's search becomes desperate.

Jumle: Te pawbu of davadukan cel davadukan.
Sentence: He runs from pharmacy to pharmacy.

Jumle: Tesu siko kasiru.
Sentence: His mind is breaking.

Jumle: Te no abil na fikir mingu.
Sentence: He can't think clearly.

Jumle: Te ganjon bujodo in sesu siko.
Sentence: He feels trapped in his own head.

Jumle: Un din, Part esto na xerca.
Sentence: One day, Part stops searching.

Jumle: Te sen godomo pilodo.
Sentence: He is too tired.

Jumle: Te leta per geomon.
Sentence: He lies down in a field.

Jumle: Tesu oko sen daybukado ji fobido.
Sentence: His eyes are wide and frightened.

Jumle: Tesu siko sen pul fe kaos.
Sentence: His mind is full of chaos.

Jumle: Part ganjon kwas te garaku in sesu fikir.
Sentence: Part feels like he is drowning in his own thoughts.

Jumle: Part no estaycu.
Sentence: Part does not get up.

Jumle: Te klosi sesu oko, ji finili tesu siko sencu sotikal.
Sentence: He closes his eyes, and his mind finally becomes silent.

Jumle: Dao de Part esto hinloka.
Sentence: The horse's journey ends here.

Jumle: Medisente nilwatu beewreka.
Sentence: The medicine is never found.

Jumle: Hikaye de Part finicu in luminkalya.
Sentence: Part's story ends in darkness.

Jumle: Okonenabil piu ji hufaxlari
Sentence: The Blind Bird and the Bats

Jumle: In luminkal drevogeo, okonenabil piu namedo Wilo jiwa solo.
Sentence: In a dark forest, a blind bird named Wilo lives alone.

Jumle: Te no abil na oko, fe folo, to sen katina na fley ji na ewreka yam.
Sentence: She cannot see, so she finds it hard to fly and find food.

Jumle: Un noce, hufaxlari ore lil wawa de Wilo.
Sentence: One night, a group of bats hears Wilo's soft cries.

Jumle: Hufax yongu rusoti cel na navi in luminkalya.
Sentence: These bats use echolocation to navigate in the dark.

Jumle: Lideyen de hufaxlari, namedo Eko, nercu cel Wilo.
Sentence: The leader of the bats, named Eko, approaches Wilo.

Jumle: "Imi abil na sahay yu," Eko loga.
Sentence: "We can help you," Eko says.

Jumle: Wilo ganjon fobipul mas onxalapul.
Sentence: Wilo feels scared but hopeful.

Jumle: Te le nilwatu hare doste fe leya.
Sentence: She has never had friends before.

Jumle: Hufax alim Wilo na juiore rusoti.
Sentence: The bats teach Wilo how to listen for echoes.

Jumle: Ete onexa tas te na yongu soti cel na aham sesu jowey.
Sentence: They show her how to use sound to understand her surroundings.

Jumle: Wilo juiore dayjuipul.
Sentence: Wilo listens carefully.

Jumle: Te xwexi na ore soti de dahun ji soti de koncun.
Sentence: She learns to hear the rustle of leaves and the buzz of insects.

Jumle: Plu din pasa, ji Wilo sencu maxmo bon fe na yongu soti.
Sentence: Days pass, and Wilo becomes better at using sound.

Jumle: Te fley ton hufax fe noce, fe na lilpiusa cel na krea rusoti.
Sentence: She flies with the bats at night, chirping softly to create echoes.

Jumle: Te ganjon anjen ji hox ton sesu neo dostetim.
Sentence: She feels safe and happy with her new friends.

Jumle: Ete gida te cel yam ji sui.
Sentence: They guide her to food and water.

Jumle: Wilo ganjon kwas te deya famil.
Sentence: Wilo feels like she belongs.

Jumle: Un axam, Eko loga, "Fe nunya, yu sen un te of imi."
Sentence: One evening, Eko says, "You are one of us now."

Jumle: Wilo ganjon termo lumin in se.
Sentence: Wilo feels a warm glow inside.

Jumle: Te jixi ki te no haji sen solo.
Sentence: She knows she is no longer alone.

Jumle: Drevogeo sen luminkal, mas Wilo no sen fobipul.
Sentence: The forest is dark, but Wilo is not afraid.

Jumle: Te fley ton hufax, tesu neo famil.
Sentence: She flies with the bats, her new family.

Jumle: Ete tongo navi fe noce, ete yongu soti cel na oko dunya.
Sentence: Together, they navigate the night, using sound to see the world.

Jumle: Wilo sen okonenabil piu, mas ton hufax, te ganjon huru.
Sentence: Wilo is a blind bird, but with the bats, she feels free.

Jumle: Fe nunya, luminkal drevolari sen loka fe dosteya ji aventur tas Wilo.
Sentence: The dark forest is now a place of friendship and adventure for Wilo.

Jumle: Te jixi ki te sen in ogar.
Sentence: She knows she is home.

Jumle: Kroa in Nederili deha
Sentence: The Frog in the Dutch Village

Jumle: Kroa namedo Fredi trasogar cel lil Nederili deha.
Sentence: A frog named Fredi moves to a small Dutch village.

Jumle: Te sen joxupul ji jixifil.
Sentence: He is excited and curious.

Jumle: Fredi tyao of tren ji te oko fe jowey.
Sentence: Fredi hops off the train and looks around.

Jumle: Deha sen xantipul ji meli.
Sentence: The village is peaceful and pretty.

Jumle: Lutufpul kwake namedo Deyzi bonatagi Fredi.
Sentence: A kind duck named Daisy welcomes Fredi.

Jumle: Te teyan na gibe tas te turi fe deha.
Sentence: She offers to give him a tour of the village.

Jumle: Fredi dongwi ji ete xoru sesu turi.
Sentence: Fredi agrees and they start their journey.

Jumle: Unyum, Deyzi gida Fredi cel vento-muledom.
Sentence: First, Daisy takes Fredi to the windmill.

Jumle: Vento-muledom sen gao ji bala.
Sentence: The windmill is tall and strong.

Jumle: To hanman rota in vento.
Sentence: It spins slowly in the wind.

Jumle: Fredi bewao tosu dayje ji meliya.
Sentence: Fredi is amazed by its size and beauty.

Jumle: Deyzi xomin ki vento-muledom sahay na mule danyam cel farina.
Sentence: Daisy explains how the windmill helps grind grain into flour.

Jumle: Jaxali, ete visita tulipageo.
Sentence: Next, they visit the tulip fields.

Jumle: Geo sen pul fe kolorpul flura.
Sentence: The fields are full of colorful flowers.

Jumle: Fredi lubi brilapulmo roso, jalo, ji pinku tulipa.
Sentence: Fredi loves the bright red, yellow, and pink tulips.

Jumle: Te amiku nafasu ji te befuraha yukwe nasacu.
Sentence: He takes a deep breath and enjoys the sweet scent.

Jumle: Deyzi loga tas Fredi ki tulipa sen simbolo de Nederi.
Sentence: Daisy tells Fredi that tulips are a symbol of the Netherlands.

Jumle: Xali, ete anda cel canal.
Sentence: Then, they walk to the canal.

Jumle: Sui sen mingu ji trankwilo.
Sentence: The water is clear and calm.

Jumle: Navi hanman flota per sui.
Sentence: Boats float gently on the water.

Jumle: Fredi ji Deyzi sidecu ner fe canal ji ete oko navi hu da pasa.
Sentence: Fredi and Daisy sit by the canal and watch the boats pass by.

Jumle: Xanxwi sen xantipul ji laxogine.
Sentence: The view is peaceful and relaxing.

Jumle: Finili, Deyzi gida Fredi cel dehagwancan.
Sentence: Finally, Daisy takes Fredi to the village square.

Jumle: Gwancan sen pul fe insan ji dukan.
Sentence: The square is full of people and shops.

Jumle: Hay rotidukan, kafedom, ji yuxituldukan.
Sentence: There is a bakery, a café, and a toy store.

Jumle: Fredi ganjon hox ji konfortapul.
Sentence: Fredi feels happy and at home.

Jumle: Fredi xukra Deyzi kos waone turi.
Sentence: Fredi thanks Daisy for the wonderful tour.

Jumle: Te sen hox na trasogar cel kaway deha.
Sentence: He is glad to move to such a lovely village.

Jumle: Fredi joxugitay multi hox din in sesu neo ogar.
Sentence: Fredi looks forward to many happy days in his new home.

Jumle: Dragon hu da no abil na exhawa atex
Sentence: The Dragon Who Could Not Breathe Fire

Jumle: In xantipul drevogeo te jiwa, dragon har name Drako.
Sentence: In a quiet forest, there lives a dragon named Drako.

Jumle: Drako sen alopul fe moy alo dragon.
Sentence: Drako is different from other dragons.

Jumle: Te no abil na exhawa atex.
Sentence: He cannot breathe fire.

Jumle: Hinto sengi Drako daymo hazuni.
Sentence: This makes Drako very sad.

Jumle: Te multi juhudi fe moy din, mas sol sui excu of tesu munte.
Sentence: He tries hard every day, but only water comes out of his mouth.

Jumle: Alo dragon coxo te.
Sentence: The other dragons laugh at him.

Jumle: Ete namegi te "Suidragon."
Sentence: They call him "Water Dragon."

Jumle: Drako ganjon bursolo.
Sentence: Drako feels lonely.

Jumle: Te sidecu jali fe hosu ji te oko sesu aynaya.
Sentence: He sits by the lake and looks at his reflection.

Jumle: "Mi no abil na exhawa atex kom alo ete keseba?" te jixivole.
Sentence: "Why can't I breathe fire like the others?" he wonders.

Jumle: Un din, durki Drako sen jali fe hosu, te ore day bursoti.
Sentence: One day, while Drako is by the lake, he hears a loud noise.

Jumle: Te oko hoy super ji te oko dudan.
Sentence: He looks up and sees smoke.

Jumle: Drevogeo atex!
Sentence: The forest is on fire!

Jumle: Alo dragon sen teli.
Sentence: The other dragons are far away.

Jumle: Ete no abil na sahay.
Sentence: They cannot help.

Jumle: Drako fobi, mas te jixi ki te musi na fale banto.
Sentence: Drako feels scared but knows he must do something.

Jumle: Te fley cel atexne drevogeo.
Sentence: He flies to the burning forest.

Jumle: Te buka sesu munte ji te esprey sui cel atexxeto.
Sentence: He opens his mouth and sprays water on the flames.

Jumle: Atex xoru na lilcu.
Sentence: The fire starts to die down.

Jumle: Drako fley fronpul ji rupul, fe na preporta sui cel atex.
Sentence: Drako flies back and forth, bringing water to the fire.

Jumle: Hanman, atexxeto awcu.
Sentence: Slowly, the flames disappear.

Jumle: Hewan exidi sangudom.
Sentence: The animals come out of hiding.

Jumle: Ete afarin Drako.
Sentence: They cheer for Drako.

Jumle: "Yu le juyuen imi!" ete loga.
Sentence: "You saved us!" they say.

Jumle: Drako tabasum fe unyum mara xafe lungo watu.
Sentence: Drako smiles for the first time in a long time.

Jumle: Alo dragon ruata ji ete oko to hu Drako le fale da.
Sentence: The other dragons return and see what Drako has done.

Jumle: Ete no haji coxo te.
Sentence: They no longer laugh at him.

Jumle: Drako xoraham muhim banto.
Sentence: Drako realizes something important.

Jumle: Na sen alopul no sen bur.
Sentence: Being different is not bad.

Jumle: Tesu sui-exhawa sen espesyal ji faydapul.
Sentence: His water breath is special and useful.

Jumle: Xorfe den din, Drako sen fahuri tem se.
Sentence: From that day on, Drako is proud of who he is.

Jumle: Te sahay drevogeo na resta anjen.
Sentence: He helps keep the forest safe.

Jumle: Te xwexi ki moyun te sen solunpul, ji na sen solunpul sen faydapul.
Sentence: He learns that everyone is unique, and being unique is useful.

Jumle: Folsomnoli huhu
Sentence: Sleepwise Owls

Jumle: In xantipul drevogeo, dua huhu ogar in day baluta.
Sentence: In a quiet forest, two owls live in a big oak tree.

Jumle: Name de huhupatre sen Oliver, ji name de tesu fembete sen Luna.
Sentence: The father owl's name is Oliver, and his daughter's name is Luna.

Jumle: Oliver suki na ergo fe noce ji na somno dur nuru.
Sentence: Oliver likes to work at night and sleep during the day.

Jumle: Mas Luna vole na resta jage dur total noce.
Sentence: Luna, however, wants to stay awake all night.

Jumle: Oliver loga, "Luna, eger yu no somno fe noce, yu xa sen pilodo."
Sentence: "Luna, if you do not sleep at night, you will be tired," Oliver says.

Jumle: Luna jawabu, "Mas mi suki na ergo fe noce, Papa. Mi sen energipul."
Sentence: "But I like working at night, Dad. I feel full of energy," Luna replies.

Jumle: Oliver kapi-noya mas te karar na izin ki Luna awtonom seleti.
Sentence: Oliver shakes his head but decides to let Luna make her own choice.

Jumle: Jaxali din, Oliver idi cel ergo kom fe xugwan.
Sentence: The next day, Oliver goes to work as usual.

Jumle: Te pasa total nuru fe na fley fe jowey, na bujo maux, ji na jawgu drevogeo.
Sentence: He spends the whole day flying around, catching mice, and watching over the forest.

Jumle: Xafe ergo, te ruata cel ogar. Te sen daypilodo.
Sentence: After work, he returns home, feeling very tired.

Jumle: Denwatu hu Oliver finfley per drevoxube, te xoroko Luna.
Sentence: As Oliver lands on the tree branch, he sees Luna.

Jumle: Te sen daymo jage ji energipul.
Sentence: She is wide awake and full of energy.

Jumle: Oliver swal, "Luna, yu no sen pilodo keseba?"
Sentence: "Luna, why are you not tired?" Oliver asks.

Jumle: Luna xomin, "Mi somno dur nuru denwatu hu mi hisi haja, Papa."
Sentence: "I sleep during the day when I feel the need to, Dad," Luna explains.

Jumle: "Mi rahatu denwatu hu misu jismu loga tas mi na fale to."
Sentence: "I rest when my body tells me to."

Jumle: Oliver fikir tem hinto.
Sentence: Oliver thinks about this.

Jumle: Te moywatu xorsomno fe sama satu fe moy din, mas Luna jui sesu jismu ji te somno denwatu hu te haja na fale to.
Sentence: He always sleeps at the same time every day, but Luna listens to her body and sleeps when she needs to.

Jumle: Oliver loga har tabasum, "Ible, maxim bon momento cel na somno sen denwatu hu yu haja to."
Sentence: "Maybe the best moment to sleep is when you need it," Oliver says with a smile.

Jumle: Xorfe den din, Oliver xidu na rahatu denwatu hu te sen pilodo, preciso kom Luna.
Sentence: From that day on, Oliver tries to rest when he feels tired, just like Luna.

Jumle: Moydua ete le xwexi ki maxim bon satu cel na somno sen denwatu hu etesu jismu loga tas ete na fale to.
Sentence: They both learn that the best time to sleep is when their bodies tell them to.

Jumle: Tongo, ete ergo hox, fe nuru or noce, yon na ore sesu suli ritmo.
Sentence: Together, they work happily, day or night, listening to their own rhythms.

Jumle: Xansebon orenenabil maymun
Sentence: The Lucky Deaf Monkey

Jumle: In centro de jungla, espesyal maymun namedo Ap ogar.
Sentence: In the heart of the jungle lives a special monkey named Ap.

Jumle: Ap sen alopul fe alo maymun.
Sentence: Ap is different from the other monkeys.

Jumle: Te no abil na ore.
Sentence: He cannot hear.

Jumle: Alo maymun simpati Ap.
Sentence: The other monkeys feel sorry for Ap.

Jumle: Ete fikir ki te yakin sen hazuni koski te no abil na ore soti de jungla.
Sentence: They think he must be sad because he cannot hear the sounds of the jungle.

Jumle: Mas Ap total no sen hazuni.
Sentence: But Ap is not sad at all.

Jumle: Ap befuraha sesu jiwa.
Sentence: Ap enjoys his life.

Jumle: Te urjuha of drevo cel drevo har day hoxya.
Sentence: He swings from tree to tree with great joy.

Jumle: Te lubi na yuxi ji na yam jusupul fruta hu da xunjan in gao xube.
Sentence: He loves to play and eat the juicy fruits that grow high up in the branches.

Jumle: Ap moywatu sen hox ji energipul.
Sentence: Ap is always happy and full of energy.

Jumle: Te no walaganjon banto hu te le nilwatu hare da.
Sentence: He does not miss what he never had.

Jumle: Jungla sen daymo sotibur.
Sentence: The jungle is very noisy.

Jumle: Piu piusa, koncun koncunsa, ji alo hewan dayhewansa dur total nuru ji noce.
Sentence: Birds chirp, insects buzz, and other animals roar and howl all day and night.

Jumle: Bursoti dumarali lawfen alo maymun.
Sentence: The noise sometimes annoys the other monkeys.

Jumle: Ete koberi sesu ore ji ete xidu na ewreka sotikal loka cel na rahatu.
Sentence: They cover their ears and try to find quiet spots to rest.

Jumle: Mas Ap no hare hin problema.
Sentence: But Ap does not have this problem.

Jumle: Te ogar in globa fe xanti ji sotikalya.
Sentence: He lives in a world of peace and quiet.

Jumle: Te bon somno ji te nilwatu belawfen.
Sentence: He sleeps soundly and is never disturbed.

Jumle: Alo maymun oko Ap ji ete jixivole ku te sen daydenmo hox kemaner.
Sentence: The other monkeys watch Ap and wonder how he can be so happy.

Jumle: Ete oko ki te tabasum ji yuxi, moywatu yolyukal.
Sentence: They see him smiling and playing, always carefree.

Jumle: Bannumer maymun xoru na aham ki Ap fatoli sen xansebon.
Sentence: Some monkeys begin to understand that Ap is actually lucky.

Jumle: Te no ore kostante bursoti de jungla.
Sentence: He does not hear the constant noise of the jungle.

Jumle: Te oko sol meliya de sesu jowey.
Sentence: He only sees the beauty around him.

Jumle: Ap alim muhim darsu tas alo maymun.
Sentence: Ap teaches the other monkeys an important lesson.

Jumle: Hoxya precu of inya, ji ren no abil na walaganjon banto hu ren le nilwatu hare da.
Sentence: Happiness comes from within, and you cannot miss what you never had.

Jumle: Jungla sen sotibur, mas globa de Ap sen trankwilo ji hoxyapul.
Sentence: The jungle is noisy, but Ap's world is calm and joyful.

Jumle: Ji dento sengi te maxim xansebon maymun of moyte.
Sentence: And that makes him the luckiest monkey of all.

Jumle: Balena ji tesu lilsoxo
Sentence: The Whale and Her Figurines

Jumle: Balena Walis daysuki na lari lilsoxo.
Sentence: Walis the whale loves to collect figurines.

Jumle: Moy din, te xerca neo oto.
Sentence: Every day, she searches for new ones.

Jumle: Te suyon cel multi dukan ji te kari to hu te vole da.
Sentence: She swims to many stores and buys the ones she wants.

Jumle: Tesu lari duregi na xunjan.
Sentence: Her collection keeps growing.

Jumle: Tesu maxim day roya sen na kompletogi lari.
Sentence: Her biggest dream is to complete the entire collection.

Jumle: Un din, Walis ewreka nadir lilsoxo hu da bemaydo sol in teli konferensi.
Sentence: One day, Walis finds a rare figurine that is only sold at a faraway convention.

Jumle: Te suyon dur multi din cel na xorata denloka.
Sentence: She swims for many days to get there.

Jumle: Denwatu hu te preata, te kari nadir lilsoxo, ji te ganjon daymo fahuri.
Sentence: When she arrives, she buys the rare figurine and feels very proud.

Jumle: Mas jaleli, firma xupan neo, maxmo espesyal ji kimapul lilsoxo.
Sentence: But just before, the company releases a new, more exclusive, and expensive figurine.

Jumle: Walis jixi ki te haja to cel na kompletogi sesu lari.
Sentence: Walis knows she needs it to complete her collection.

Jumle: Te hifazi sesu pesa ji te suyon cel alo teli konferensi.
Sentence: She saves her money and swims to another distant convention.

Jumle: Dao sen lungo ji pilone, mas Walis sen kararpul.
Sentence: The journey is long and tiring, but Walis is determined.

Jumle: Preciso denwatu hu Walis jaxa kari neo lilsoxo, firma gongaw maxpul watulimitedo lilsoxo.
Sentence: Just as Walis is about to buy the new figurine, the company announces another limited edition.

Jumle: Hinto sen maxim nadir to finfe nunya.
Sentence: This one is the most exclusive yet.

Jumle: Walis xorjui ki te no hare kufi pesa cel na kari to or cel na dao cel konferensi.
Sentence: Walis realizes she doesn't have enough money to buy it or travel to the convention.

Jumle: Walis le sencu pesakal.
Sentence: Walis became poor.

Jumle: Te le dayergo cel na lari moy lilsoxo, mas tesu pesa le awcu, ji tesu lari sen haji nenkompleto.
Sentence: She worked hard to collect all the figurines, but her money is gone, and her collection is still incomplete.

Jumle: Te ganjon cipendo koski firma duregi na krea neo lilsoxo cel na cudu max pesa of te.
Sentence: She feels cheated because the company keeps making new figurines to get more money from her.

Jumle: Walis le sen fahuri fe sesu day lari, mas fe nunya, te ganjon bujodo denpul kom burdavayen.
Sentence: Walis was proud of her large collection, but now she feels trapped like an addict.

Jumle: Te haji vole na kompletogi lari, mas te le xorwala vole na duregi xidu.
Sentence: She still wants to complete the collection, but she has lost the will to keep trying.

Jumle: Jixifil swini
Sentence: The Curious Pigs

Jumle: In day serye-nongyodom, hay swinilari.
Sentence: In a large battery farm, there is a group of pigs.

Jumle: Ete ogar in lil kafas.
Sentence: They live in small pens.

Jumle: Ete duoko sol insan ji alo swini.
Sentence: They only see humans and other pigs.

Jumle: Un din, swini har name 1112 ore fumbun.
Sentence: One day, a pig named 1112 hears a rumor.

Jumle: Te xorjixi ki alo tipo fe hewan sonzay.
Sentence: He hears that other animals exist.

Jumle: Te jixivole ku kam to sen sati.
Sentence: He wonders if it is true.

Jumle: 1112 loga tas sesu doste, "Kam uyu le ore? Hay hewan maxus insan ji swini."
Sentence: 1112 tells his friends, "Have you heard? There are animals besides humans and pigs."

Jumle: Tesu doste haha.
Sentence: His friends laugh.

Jumle: "Dento no abil na sen sati," ete loga.
Sentence: "That can't be true," they say.

Jumle: Mas 1112 sen jixifil.
Sentence: But 1112 is curious.

Jumle: Te vole na max jixi.
Sentence: He wants to know more.

Jumle: 1112 pala tas swini namedo 0044.
Sentence: 1112 talks to pig named 0044.

Jumle: 0044 sen sofipul.
Sentence: 0044 is wise.

Jumle: 1112 swal tas te, "0044, kam alo hewan sonzay?"
Sentence: 1112 asks him, "0044, do other animals exist?"

Jumle: 0044 hanman kapi-siya.
Sentence: 0044 nods slowly.

Jumle: "Si, mi le ore hikaye. Hay mumu, kuku, ji hata meme. Ete ogar in alo nongyodom."
Sentence: "Yes, I have heard stories. There are cows, chickens, and even sheep. They live on other farms."

Jumle: Oko de 1112 max buka.
Sentence: 1112's eyes widen.

Jumle: "Ete okocu kemaner?" te swal.
Sentence: "What do they look like?" he asks.

Jumle: 0044 tabasum.
Sentence: 0044 smiles.

Jumle: "Mumu sen day har plu tyan. Kuku sen lil har yumawlari. Meme sen belopul har yanmo."
Sentence: "Cows are big with spots. Chickens are small with feathers. Sheep are fluffy with wool."

Jumle: 1112 loga tas sesu doste dento hu 0044 le loga da.
Sentence: 1112 tells his friends what 0044 said.

Jumle: Fe nunya, pia ete sen jixifil.
Sentence: Now, they are curious too.

Jumle: Ete xoru na swal maxpul swal.
Sentence: They start asking more questions.

Jumle: Un din, swini namedo 1368 swal, "Kijawi sen keto?"
Sentence: One day, a pig named 1368 asks, "What is green?"

Jumle: Moyete jixivole.
Sentence: They all wonder.

Jumle: Ete le nilwatu oko kolor kijawi.
Sentence: They have never seen the color green.

Jumle: 0044 xomin, "Kijawi sen kolor de gras. To sen narem ji bardilil."
Sentence: 0044 explains, "Green is the color of grass. It is soft and cool."

Jumle: Swini imaje hin kijawi gras.
Sentence: The pigs imagine this green grass.

Jumle: Ete roya na oko to fe ban din.
Sentence: They dream of seeing it one day.

Jumle: Swini duregi na pala tem alo hewan ji tem kolor kijawi.
Sentence: The pigs continue to talk about other animals and the color green.

Jumle: Ete disgi fumbun.
Sentence: They spread the rumors.

Jumle: Nongyodom sencu loka fe roya ji jixifilya.
Sentence: The farm becomes a place of dreams and curiosity.

Jumle: Fe hataya ki ete le nilwatu oko hin plu xey, swini duregi na onxala.
Sentence: Though they have never seen these things, the pigs keep hoping.

Jumle: Mas xafe bankwanti watu, swini xoru na fikir ki to sen sol komploto-teori.
Sentence: But after some time, some pigs begin to think it's just a conspiracy theory.

Jumle: "Eger to sen sati, swini ger ruata ji onexa jenmin. Imi, swini, sol hare godo imajeya," ete loga.
Sentence: "If it were true, pigs would come back and show some proof. We pigs just have too much imagination," they say.

Jumle: Day problema
Sentence: A Big Problem

Jumle: Big sen daymo day baru.
Sentence: Big is a very large bear.

Jumle: Fe fato, te sen maxim day baru hu da sonzay.
Sentence: Actually, he is the biggest bear that exists.

Jumle: Big no sen tesu real name.
Sentence: Big is not his real name.

Jumle: Tesu real name sen Alfonso.
Sentence: His real name is Alfonso.

Jumle: Mas moyte namegi te Big, ji moyte kone te kom Big.
Sentence: But everyone calls him Big, and everyone knows him as Big.

Jumle: Insan nadir oko Big koski te le sencu daydenmo day ki te eskaso abil na pasa pas dwer.
Sentence: People rarely see Big because he has grown so large he can hardly fit through the door.

Jumle: Dento sen day problema, koski Big no haji abil na visita sesu preferido restoran.
Sentence: That's a big problem, because Big can't visit his favorite restaurant anymore.

Jumle: Fe folo, Big karar na sencu minmo day.
Sentence: So, Big decided to become less big.

Jumle: Te vole na xoru dyeta!
Sentence: He wants to start a diet!

Jumle: In teve, Big oko multi reklama.
Sentence: On television, Big sees many ads.

Jumle: Te fikir, "Eger mi yam den yamxey har min sukeri ji min yow, mi xa sencu maxmo dambo!"
Sentence: He thinks, "If I eat those foods with less sugar and less fat, I will become thinner!"

Jumle: Fe folo, fe tayti fe normali cipsu, Big kari "wazenlil" cipsu.
Sentence: So instead of normal chips, Big buys "light" chips.

Jumle: Oto bedeliver cel tesu ogar.
Sentence: They are delivered to his house.

Jumle: Dur un total mesi, Big yam sol wazenlil yamxey.
Sentence: For a whole month, Big eats only light food.

Jumle: Mas Big sencu hata maxmo day!
Sentence: But Big grows even bigger!

Jumle: "To no funsyon!"
Sentence: "It doesn't work!"

Jumle: Fe folo, Big xerca aloto na yam.
Sentence: So Big looks for something else to eat.

Jumle: "Ible, to sen yozay de karbonhidrato!" Big fikir xafe na oko alo reklama tem karbonhidrato.
Sentence: "Maybe it's the carbohydrates' fault!" thinks Big after watching another ad about carbohydrates.

Jumle: Fe folo, Big xoru “keton”-dyeta ji te kari multi “keton”-tadikudo yamxey.
Sentence: So, Big starts a Keto diet and buys a lot of Keto-certified food.

Jumle: Un mesi pasa.
Sentence: One month passes.

Jumle: Big sen hata maxmo day.
Sentence: Big is even bigger.

Jumle: Eger tesu dayrapul muka sen candru, tesu fubu ger sen planeta.
Sentence: If his round face were the moon, his belly would be a planet.

Jumle: "Mi no aham. Wal jui tem ku mi yam keto, mi haji sencu maxmo day!"
Sentence: "I don't understand. No matter what I eat, I still get bigger!"

Jumle: Voka de Big sotikalcu kos cibo in tesu gawlu.
Sentence: Big's voice is muffled by the fat in his throat.

Jumle: Fe hin fase, te fikir ki tesu jiwa fe baru sen tahamulnenible.
Sentence: At this point, he finds his bear life unbearable.

Jumle: "Mi xa sol sangu in gufa, teli of sosyaltim."
Sentence: "I will just hide in a cave, far away from society."

Jumle: Ji Big fale preciso dento.
Sentence: And Big does just that.

Jumle: Un total mosem pasa.
Sentence: A full season passes.

Jumle: Big sencu daymo suikal ji te idi cel exya de gufa cel na ewreka bankwanti sui.
Sentence: Big becomes very thirsty and goes outside the cave to find some water.

Jumle: Jali fe suibirke, te oko sesu aynaya per perya.
Sentence: Next to a pool of water, he sees his reflection on the surface.

Jumle: "Kam mi le sencu maxmo dambo?"
Sentence: "Did I get thinner?"

Jumle: Bante oko Big.
Sentence: Someone sees Big.

Jumle: "Wao, Big, yu le finili mosemsomno!"
Sentence: "Wow, Big, you finally hibernated!"

Jumle: Na seleti keto?
Sentence: What to Choose?

Jumle: Olaf side fe mesa de kokikamer.
Sentence: Olaf sits at the kitchen table.

Jumle: Te jixivole ku te ingay na ergo fe ke ergoxey.
Sentence: He wonders which job he should do.

Jumle: Te oko hoy sesu lista fe ible seleti.
Sentence: He looks at his list of choices.

Jumle: Hay multi ergoxey na kolyo.
Sentence: There are many jobs to consider.

Jumle: Moyun to sen alopul.
Sentence: Each one is different.

Jumle: Moyun to teyan neo banto.
Sentence: Each one offers something new.

Jumle: Unyum, Olaf kolyo na sencu alimyen.
Sentence: First, Olaf thinks about being a teacher.

Jumle: Te suki na sahay aloete na xwexi.
Sentence: He likes helping others learn.

Jumle: Te memori sesu preferido alimyen of eskol.
Sentence: He remembers his favorite teachers from school.

Jumle: Ete le sengi xwexi amusane.
Sentence: They made learning fun.

Jumle: Mas te yolyu tem lungo ergowatu.
Sentence: But he worries about the long hours.

Jumle: Na alim sen katina ergo.
Sentence: Teaching is hard work.

Jumle: Jaxali, Olaf kolyo na sencu medisyen.
Sentence: Next, Olaf thinks about being a doctor.

Jumle: Te vole na sahay insan na resta seha.
Sentence: He wants to help people stay healthy.

Jumle: Te imaje se in sefide kotu, fe na kanho bemedisyen.
Sentence: He imagines himself in a white coat, caring for patients.

Jumle: Mas te fikir pia tem multi nyan fe estudi.
Sentence: But he also thinks about the many years of study.

Jumle: Na sencu medisyen no sen asan.
Sentence: Becoming a doctor is not easy.

Jumle: Xafe dento, Olaf kolyo na sencu eskriyen.
Sentence: Then, Olaf considers being a writer.

Jumle: Te lubi na hikaye.
Sentence: He loves telling stories.

Jumle: Na eskri izin te na yongu sesu imajeya.
Sentence: Writing lets him use his imagination.

Jumle: Mas te jixi ki to abil na sen bursolo ergoxey.
Sentence: But he knows it can be a lonely job.

Jumle: Eskriyen pimpan ergo solo dur lungo watu.
Sentence: Writers often work alone for long hours.

Jumle: Olaf kolyo pia na sencu kokikef.
Sentence: Olaf also thinks about being a chef.

Jumle: Te suki na koki.
Sentence: He enjoys cooking.

Jumle: Na krea xetocubon yam pregi hoxya tas te.
Sentence: Making delicious food brings him joy.

Jumle: Mas kokikamer sen bursotipul, estresne loka.
Sentence: But the kitchen is a busy, stressful place.

Jumle: Na sen kokikef no moywatu sen amusane.
Sentence: Being a chef is not always fun.

Jumle: Fe fini, Olaf kolyo na sencu injeneriyen.
Sentence: Lastly, Olaf thinks about being an engineer.

Jumle: Te suki na hala problema.
Sentence: He likes solving problems.

Jumle: Injeneriyen kosa ki xey maxmo bon funsyon.
Sentence: Engineers make things work better.

Jumle: Mas te yolyu tem matemati ji syensi.
Sentence: But he worries about the math and science.

Jumle: Injeneri abil na sen daymo teknikali.
Sentence: Engineering can be very technical.

Jumle: Olaf amiku innafasu.
Sentence: Olaf takes a deep breath.

Jumle: Te jixi ki te musi na seleti.
Sentence: He knows he has to choose.

Jumle: Mas te no suki dento.
Sentence: But he doesn't like that.

Jumle: Te loga, "Mi ingay na seleti ergoxey hu in da mi no musi na multi seleti."
Sentence: "I should choose a job where I don't have to choose much," he says.

Jumle: Safe Rubahe
Sentence: The Clean Fox

Jumle: Hinte sen juni rubahe.
Sentence: This is a young fox.

Jumle: Tesu belo sen totalmo sefide kom wadi xafe taze dutaluji.
Sentence: Their (sg.) fur is completely white, like a valley after a fresh snowfall.

Jumle: He nil bruno or syahe burtyan sen okoible.
Sentence: Absolutely no brown or black stain is visible.

Jumle: In rubahelari, nilto sen maxmo safe kom tesu belo, ji te sen daymo fahuri tem to.
Sentence: In the fox community, nothing is cleaner than their (sg.) fur, and they (sg.) are very proud of that.

Jumle: Kos to, te name Safe Rubahe.
Sentence: Because of it, they (sg.) are called "the clean fox".

Jumle: Bardimosem ata.
Sentence: Winter arrives.

Jumle: Fe soba, denwatu hu rubahe exidi sesu ogar, ete oko xanxwi hu da sen imanuneniblemo sefide.
Sentence: In the morning, when the foxes leave their den, they see a landscape which is incredibly white.

Jumle: Juni rubahe, hu da le nilwatu oko taluji, fori vole na yuxi fe to.
Sentence: The young foxes, who have never seen snow before, immediately want to play in it.

Jumle: Ete tyao, goyu, gulun.
Sentence: They jump, dig and roll.

Jumle: Taluji sen yukwe ji amusane.
Sentence: The snow is pleasant and entertaining.

Jumle: Hin juni rubahe vole pia na oko ku taluji le alogi etesu jowey kemaner.
Sentence: The young foxes also want to see how the snow has changed their environment.

Jumle: Lildrevo ji daypetra, bax talujili cengu, no haji sen aloyagiible.
Sentence: Bushes and boulders, under a layer of snow, are no longer distinguishable.

Jumle: Pia perya de hosu no haji sen okoible.
Sentence: Also, the surface of lakes is no longer visible.

Jumle: Moyto sen sefide, sefidemo safe, har safeya sim sol kom dento de safe rubahe.
Sentence: Everything is white, whitely clean, with a cleanness similar only to that of the clean fox.

Jumle: Plu rubahe le yuxi fe exya dur total nuru.
Sentence: The foxes played outside all day.

Jumle: Noce xoru, ji atre voka juni rubahe.
Sentence: Night falls, and the parents call the young foxes.

Jumle: Moyte ruata, minus safe rubahe.
Sentence: Everyone returns, except the clean fox.

Jumle: Te le godomo teli kentan.
Sentence: They (sg.) had explored too far.

Jumle: Te no haji rukone ku te ata of keloka.
Sentence: They (sg.) no longer recognize the place they came from.

Jumle: Te sen sonxido.
Sentence: They (sg.) are lost.

Jumle: Moy alo rubahe xerca te, mas kos sefide safeya de tesu belo, ete no sukses.
Sentence: The other foxes search for them (sg.), but because of the white cleanness of their (sg.) fur, they fail.

Jumle: Totalmo luminkal.
Sentence: It is completely dark.

Jumle: Safe rubahe fe nunya sol ore plu kaospul rusoti.
Sentence: The clean fox now hears only confused echoes.

Jumle: Haulsa tayti rubahesa.
Sentence: Cries of wolves have replaced cries of foxes.

Jumle: Te befobi.
Sentence: They (sg.) are afraid.

Jumle: Tesu unyum somno ex ogar xa sen fobipulmo bardipul.
Sentence: Their (sg.) first night outside the den will be fearfully cold.

Jumle: Rubahe sangu ji bolcu fe comen de daypetra.
Sentence: The fox hides and curls up into a ball beside a boulder.

Jumle: Fe onxala, tesu ewrekanenibleya pia xa funsyon anti rubaheyamfil haul.
Sentence: Hopefully, their (sg.) unfindability will also work against the fox-eating wolves.

Jumle: Fe fini, soba.
Sentence: Finally, morning comes.

Jumle: Haul sen sotikal.
Sentence: The wolves are silent.

Jumle: Safe rubahe musi na bonyongu kurto luminpul watu cel na riewreka sesu famil.
Sentence: The clean fox must take advantage of the short daylight (lit. bright time) to find their (sg.) family.

Jumle: Fe asif, le hay hata max taluji dur noce, ji fe folo, he ban pedamarka sen koberido.
Sentence: Unfortunately, there was even more snow during the night, so any tracks are covered.

Jumle: Rubahe haja idey.
Sentence: The fox needs an idea.

Jumle: ji te ewreka!
Sentence: and they (sg.) find it!

Jumle: Okonenible, yon velosi tyao, safe rubahe sukses na bujo kargux.
Sentence: Invisible, with a quick leap, the clean fox manages to catch a rabbit.

Jumle: Yon sesu denta, te kata gardan.
Sentence: With their (sg.) teeth, they (sg.) cut its throat.

Jumle: Per mor kargux, rubahe gulun, celki tesu belo bekoberi taze, roso damu.
Sentence: On the dead rabbit, the fox rolls, so that their (sg.) fur is covered with fresh red blood.

Jumle: Rubahe fikir, "Hinmaner, mi xa sen okoible!"
Sentence: "This way, I will be visible!" thinks the fox.

Jumle: Sipul, xafe watumon, un te of familyen de rubahe xoroko roso figura hu da harka fe teliya.
Sentence: Indeed, after a while, one of the fox’s family members notices a red shape moving in the distance.

Jumle: Mas, koski te le nilwatu oko sim banto, ji koski te oko multi damu, familyen xoru na awpawbu ji na dayloga, "Am awpawbu, hay kayvutu!"
Sentence: But, having never seen anything like it before, and seeing so much blood, the family member flees and cries out: “Run away, there is a monster!”

Jumle: Gao Drevo
Sentence: The Tall Tree

Jumle: Hay wadi hu denloka moy planta armonipul jiwa.
Sentence: There is a valley where all plants live in harmony.

Jumle: Denloka, hay sosyal regula, hu planta no haki na sencu maxmo gao kom tiga metro.
Sentence: There, a social rule exists: no plant is allowed to grow taller than three meters.

Jumle: Dento yakingi, ki moy plantali bioyen abil na taslum kufi lumin cel na bon jiwa.
Sentence: This ensures that every plant life form can receive enough sunlight to live well.

Jumle: Fe hataya, ban din, dayvento preporta bija of teli loka.
Sentence: However, one day, a strong wind brings a seed from a distant place.

Jumle: Xafe watumon, bija kufi xunjan, fe folo ki ren abil na oko ki bija sen of jongu fe dahunli drevo hu da sen totalmo nenkonedo in hin wadi.
Sentence: After some time, the seed has grown enough for it to be seen that it belongs to a species of leafy tree entirely unknown in the valley.

Jumle: Fe xoru, planta hu da ogar in wadi hoxcu tem hin preata.
Sentence: At first, the plant inhabitants of the valley are happy about the newcomer.

Jumle: Folki jowey sen maxmo doyan fe jongu, to max abil na tahamul ji adate fol alocu.
Sentence: The more diverse an environment is in species, the better it can resist and adapt to changes.

Jumle: Hin neo drevo xunjan ji xunjan.
Sentence: The new tree grows and grows.

Jumle: Mas neo drevo no esto na xunjan lefe limite fe tiga metro.
Sentence: But the new tree does not stop growing at the three-meter limit.

Jumle: Te multi suki lumin, ji te moywatu vole max to.
Sentence: They (sg.) really love light and always want more.

Jumle: Te xoru na krea day sistema fe xube ji dahun, cel na bujo max sola-lumin.
Sentence: They (sg.) begin to form a large system of branches and leaves to capture more sunlight.

Jumle: Jali planta loga tas neo drevo: "Fe lutuf, am esto na xunjan, imi no haji taslum kufi lumin."
Sentence: Nearby plants say to the new tree: "Please stop growing, we no longer get enough light."

Jumle: Gao drevo jawabu: "Eger uyu vole lumin, am xunjan. Mi layeya lumin koski mi le xunjan."
Sentence: The tall tree replies: "If you want light, grow. I deserve the light because I grew."

Jumle: Mas no moy planta abil na xunjan, ji no moy planta vole na jento cel lumin.
Sentence: But not all plants can grow, and not all plants want to fight for light.

Jumle: Fe bonxanse, den drevo sen solo te hu da no ehtiram alote.
Sentence: Fortunately, that tree is the only one that doesn’t respect the others.

Jumle: Fe folo, alo planta karar na posjui hin sefil unyen.
Sentence: The plants then decide to ignore this selfish individual.

Jumle: Ban din, hay bofun.
Sentence: One day, a storm occurs.

Jumle: Multi bala vento pasidi wadi.
Sentence: Strong winds pass through the valley.

Jumle: Planta tongo fleksi fol ventoli pel.
Sentence: Plants bend together with the force of the wind.

Jumle: Nerya de bante ton alote sahay ete na no sokutu.
Sentence: Their closeness to one another helps them avoid falling.

Jumle: Mas gao drevo, kos sesu gaoya, no abil na taslum sahay.
Sentence: But the tall tree, due to its height, cannot receive help.

Jumle: Te musi na solo tahamul moy ventoli pel hu da presyon moy tesu xube samawatu.
Sentence: They (sg.) must resist all the gusts alone, which press on all their (sg.) branches at once.

Jumle: Gao drevo peti sahay: "Am sahay mi! Mi fikir ki mi nerxali sokutu!"
Sentence: The tall tree asks for help: "Help me! I think I’m about to fall!"

Jumle: Alo planta, hu da no real abil na sahay, loga: "Am posxunjan! Am posxunjan!" Mas posxunjan no sen ible.
Sentence: The other plants, who can’t truly help, say: "Shrink! Shrink!" But shrinking isn’t possible.

Jumle: And in the end, the tree falls.
Sentence: And in the end, the tree falls.

Jumle: Xafe bofun, Sola ruata.
Sentence: After the storm, the sun returns.

Jumle: Moy planta abil na oko kanu de gao drevo hu da nun total leta per geo.
Sentence: All the plants can see the trunk of the tall tree, now lying completely on the ground.

Jumle: Te morcu, ji tesu dahun ji bija awfley.
Sentence: They (sg.) died, and their (sg.) leaves and seeds flew away.

Jumle: Bannumer planta morcu kos sokutu, mas minimum fe nunya, dom sen totalmo koberido yon lumin.
Sentence: Some plants died from the fall, but at least now the area is completely covered in light.

Jumle: Arteyen
Sentence: The Artist

Jumle: Hay maymun hu da multi suki na rasamu.
Sentence: There is a monkey who really loves to draw.

Jumle: Fe moy din, te rasamu plu neo xey.
Sentence: Every day, they (sg.) draw new things.

Jumle: Te suki na rasamu asman, natura, hewan.
Sentence: They (sg.) love to draw the sky, nature, animals.

Jumle: Te suki na rasamu moyto, ji te suki na rasamu moywatu.
Sentence: They (sg.) love to draw everything, and they (sg.) love to draw all the time.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Denwatu hu mi sen day, mi xa sen arteyen. Dento sen misu roya."
Sentence: They (sg.) think: "When I grow up, I’ll be an artist. That’s my dream."

Jumle: Atre de maymun hifazi pesa tas sesu bete.
Sentence: The monkey’s parents save money for their child.

Jumle: Yon pesa, maymun abil na estudi in xohrapul arteli eskol.
Sentence: With the money, the monkey can study at a famous art school.

Jumle: In eskol, maymun multi estudi.
Sentence: At school, the monkey studies hard.

Jumle: Te vole na dadal sesu roya, mas te pia no vole na malyongu pesa de sesu atre.
Sentence: They (sg.) want to achieve their dream, but they (sg.) also don’t want to waste their (sg.) parents' money.

Jumle: Maymun pimpan musi na onexa sesu rasamu tas alimyen.
Sentence: The monkey often has to show their (sg.) drawings to teachers.

Jumle: Alimyen multi komenta: "Yusu rasamu sen bon, mas kam yu abil na alogi den bage?"
Sentence: The teachers give many comments: "Your drawing is good, but could you change that part?"

Jumle: Duli mara, ete loga ki rasamu haja detale.
Sentence: Sometimes, they say the drawing needs more details.

Jumle: Duli mara, ete loga ki hay godo detale.
Sentence: Sometimes, they say it has too many details.

Jumle: Duli mara, ete loga ki no hay kufi kolor.
Sentence: Sometimes, they say there are not enough colors.

Jumle: Duli mara, ete loga ki hay godo kolor.
Sentence: Sometimes, they say there are too many colors.

Jumle: Moywatu, ete no sen kufimo truti.
Sentence: They are never quite satisfied.

Jumle: Maymun sukses fe finili eksame, ji te taslum eskoldoku.
Sentence: The monkey passed the final exams and got a diploma.

Jumle: Te sen hox, koski te nun sen huru.
Sentence: They (sg.) are happy, because now they (sg.) are free.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Mi nun abil na rasamu dento hu mi vole da, denmaner hu mi vole!"
Sentence: They (sg.) think: "Now I can draw what I want, how I want!"

Jumle: Mas maymun haja na cudu pesa.
Sentence: But the monkey needs to earn money.

Jumle: Fe folo, te xerca person hu da vole na kari rasamu.
Sentence: So they (sg.) look for people who want to buy drawings.

Jumle: Fe bonxanse, maymun ewreka kliente.
Sentence: Luckily, the monkey finds a client.

Jumle: Maymun vole na fale daymo bon ergo tas sesu unyum kliente.
Sentence: The monkey wants to do a very good job for their (sg.) first client.

Jumle: Eger klientelari sen truti, te xa hare max xohra ji te xa hare max kliente.
Sentence: If clients are satisfied, they (sg.) will become more famous and get more clients.

Jumle: Xafe multi ergo, te fahuri onexa sesu rasamu tas kliente.
Sentence: After much work, they (sg.) proudly present their drawing to the client.

Jumle: Kliente jawabu: "Yusu rasamu sen bon, mas kam yu abil na alogi den bage?"
Sentence: The client replies: "Your drawing is good, but could you change that part?"

Jumle: Maymun karar na rifale total rasamu.
Sentence: The monkey decides to redo the entire drawing.

Jumle: Fe hataya ki maymun sen daymo talentopul, te haja xugwanpul kliente cel na taslum kufi pesa.
Sentence: Although the monkey is very talented, they (sg.) need regular clients to earn enough money.

Jumle: Te moywatu fikir: "Eger kliente no sen truti, te xa no ruata.
Sentence: They (sg.) always think, "If the client isn’t satisfied, they won’t come back."

Jumle: Pimpan, te musi na rasamu he sama xey dur total nuru.
Sentence: Often, they (sg.) have to draw the same things all day long.

Jumle: Te pimpan no haji hare energi dur axam.
Sentence: They (sg.) often have no energy left in the evening.

Jumle: Denmaner, maymun jiwa dur plu nyan.
Sentence: And so the monkey lives for several years.

Jumle: Mas ban din, te karar na fale wakufa.
Sentence: But one day, they (sg.) decide to take a break.

Jumle: Te le sukses na hifazi kufi pesa cel to.
Sentence: They (sg.) managed to save enough money for that.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Mi nun abil na rasamu dento hu mi vole da, denmaner hu mi vole!"
Sentence: They (sg.) think, "Now I can draw what I want, how I want!"

Jumle: “Mi xa rahatu yon na huru rasamu, denmaner hu mi le fale denwatu hu mi le sen daymo juni."
Sentence: "I’ll relax by drawing freely, like I did when I was very young."

Jumle: Te side ner fe sefide paper, har pentu-broxa ji inku.
Sentence: They (sg.) sit in front of a blank sheet of paper, with brush and ink.

Jumle: Te oko paper.
Sentence: They (sg.) look at the paper.

Jumle: Te xidu na imaje banto.
Sentence: They (sg.) try to imagine something.

Jumle: Te oko paper.
Sentence: They (sg.) look at the paper.

Jumle: Te xidu na imaje he banto.
Sentence: They (sg.) try to imagine anything at all.

Jumle: Paper resta sefide.
Sentence: The paper stays blank.

Jumle: Te fale plu linea.
Sentence: They (sg.) draw lines.

Jumle: Mas nil menapul to precu.
Sentence: But nothing meaningful appears.

Jumle: Te no sukses na rasamu dur total din.
Sentence: They (sg.) didn’t manage to draw anything all day.

Jumle: Te le wanji denmaner hu na rasamu yon furaha ji huruya.
Sentence: They (sg.) forgot how to draw with joy and freedom.

Jumle: Na rasamu no haji sen dayfilya, mas sol ergo.
Sentence: Drawing is no longer a passion, only a job.

Jumle: Multi nyan pasa.
Sentence: Many years pass.

Jumle: Maymun nun sen lao.
Sentence: The monkey is now old.

Jumle: Te ergo in nongyodom hu te le warisa da.
Sentence: They (sg.) work on the farm they inherited.

Jumle: Te le no pifu broxa dur lungo watu.
Sentence: They (sg.) haven’t touched a brush in a long time.

Jumle: Kos jaxne, maymun bevisita sodar ji tesu bete.
Sentence: During a celebration, the monkey is visited by their sibling and their sibling’s children.

Jumle: Un juni bete vole na onexa rasamu fe ajabu hewan tas maymun Tie.
Sentence: One young child wants to show a drawing of a strange animal to their (sg.) aunt/uncle monkey.

Jumle: Maymun Tie swal: "Hinte sen ke hewan?
Sentence: Aunt/Uncle Monkey: "What is that animal?"

Jumle: Bete jawabu: "Te sen mumu!"
Sentence: Child: "It’s a cow!"

Jumle: Maymun Tie loga: "O, mimbay, mi nun aham."
Sentence: Aunt/Uncle Monkey: "Oh of course, now I see."

Jumle: Bete swal: "Kam yu suki misu rasamu, Tie?"
Sentence: Child: "Do you like my drawing, aunt/uncle?"

Jumle: Maymun Tie jawabu yon swal: "Kam yu suki yusu rasamu, Bete?"
Sentence: Aunt/Uncle Monkey: "Do you like your drawing, Child?"

Jumle: Bete jawabu: "Si! Mi sen hox tem to."
Sentence: Child: "Yes! I’m happy with it."

Jumle: Maymun Tie loga: "Fe folo, yusu rasamu sen perfeto. Am alogi nilto."
Sentence: Aunt/Uncle Monkey: "Then your drawing is perfect. Change nothing."

Jumle: Bete dayloga: "Xukra! Denwatu hu mi sen day, mi xa sen arteyen!"
Sentence: Child: "Thanks! When I grow up, I’ll be an artist!"

Jumle: Maymun Tie dayloga: "Yu uje sen!"
Sentence: Uncle Monkey: "You already are!"

Jumle: Dragon ji Panda
Sentence: The Dragon and the Panda

Jumle: Ner fe kapi de gao jabal hay gufa.
Sentence: Near the peak of a high mountain lies a cave.

Jumle: Dragon ogar in to solo ton sesu hazina.
Sentence: A dragon lives alone in it with their (sg.) treasure.

Jumle: Te hare multi dahabu, jawheri ji alo jacipulxey hu te le cudu da of plu jali xaher.
Sentence: They (sg.) have lots of gold, jewels, and other valuables, which they (sg.) took from nearby cities.

Jumle: Dragon ganjon ki te haji wala xey, ji ki jali xaher no haji sen interesne.
Sentence: The dragon feels that something is still missing, and the nearby cities are no longer interesting.

Jumle: Fe folo, te karar na fley cel teli loka cel na ewreka neo xey cel na maxusgi tas sesu hazina.
Sentence: So they (sg.) decide to fly to a faraway place to find new things to add to their (sg.) treasure.

Jumle: Xafe lungo fley, fe fini, dragon ewreka xaher.
Sentence: After a long flight, the dragon finally finds a city.

Jumle: To sen nenpimpan xaher hu da loka in drevolari.
Sentence: It is an unusual city, located in a forest.

Jumle: Koski moyto sen sangudo bax dahun, dragon karar na pergeo.
Sentence: Since everything is hidden under the leaves, the dragon decides to land.

Jumle: Per geo, te oko panda hu da kwasi hare nil fobi kos presen de dragon.
Sentence: On the ground, they (sg.) see a panda, who seems to have no fear of the dragon’s presence.

Jumle: Te swal tas panda: "Kastilo feya keloka?"
Sentence: They (sg.) ask the panda, "Where is the castle?"

Jumle: Panda jawabu: "Kastilo? No hay kastilo hinloka."
Sentence: The panda replies, "Castle? There’s no castle here."

Jumle: Surprisado dragon swal: "Fe folo, keloka uyu hifazi uyusu jacipul xey? Kam uyu hare banko or hata jandan inplasidom?
Sentence: The surprised dragon asks, "Then where do you keep your valuable things? Do you have a bank or even a simple storage place?"

Jumle: Panda loga: "No, no. Imi no hare denpul dom."
Sentence: The panda says, "No, no. We don’t have such a thing."

Jumle: Dragon sen okoiblemo konhwokudo.
Sentence: The dragon is visibly confused.

Jumle: Panda maxpul loga: "Imi no hifazi. Moyto hu imi haja da uje sen cuduible fe jowey."
Sentence: The panda continues, "We don’t keep things. Everything we need is already around us."

Jumle: Panda loga: "Mi nun sen yamkal, fe folo, mi le toncudu bambu. Kam yu ger suki na yam ton mi?"
Sentence: The panda says, "I’m hungry now, so I gathered bamboo. Would you like to eat with me?"

Jumle: Dragon, hu da sen pilodo kos sesu lungo daoya, swikara.
Sentence: The dragon, who is tired from the long journey, accepts.

Jumle: Panda sen hox, ji te loga: "Eger yu haja banto, am jandan peti. Denmaner, moyto funsyon hinloka."
Sentence: The panda smiles and says, "If you need something, just ask. That’s how things work here."

Jumle: Ete yam xetocubon supa, ji ete pala dur lungo watu.
Sentence: They eat delicious bamboo soup and talk for a long time.

Jumle: Panda, hu da sen daymo dostefil, hikaye multi tem sesu jiwa.
Sentence: The panda, who is very friendly, shares a lot about their life.

Jumle: Pia te hare soloyapul jiwa.
Sentence: They (sg.) too have a rather solitary life.

Jumle: Dragon loga fe fini: "Mi nun musi na awidi."
Sentence: Finally, the dragon says, "I must go now."

Jumle: Panda loga: "Kam uje?"
Sentence: "Already?" says the panda.

Jumle: Dragon jawabu: "Si, mi haja na gardi misu hazina."
Sentence: "Yes, I need to protect my treasure."

Jumle: Panda nercu cel dragon, ji te gibe tas te lungo weygebo.
Sentence: The panda walks up to the dragon and gives them (sg.) a long hug.

Jumle: Dragon le nilwatu taslum weygebo fe leya. Te loga: "Dento mena keto?"
Sentence: "What does this mean?" asks the dragon, who had never received a hug before.

Jumle: Panda jawabu: "To sen maner na onexa ki mi le suki hin momento ton yu. Kam yu ger vole na jaribi?"
Sentence: The panda replies: "It’s a way to show that I enjoyed this moment with you. Would you like to try?"

Jumle: Dragon plasi sesu bala gebo wey panda, ji te xoru na harka sesu fleytul.
Sentence: The dragon wraps their (sg.) strong arms around the panda and begins to move their (sg.) wings.

Jumle: Panda swal: "Yu fale keto fe nunya?"
Sentence: "What are you doing now?" asks the panda.

Jumle: Dragon jawabu: "Mi porta yu cel misu gufa, koski yu sen misu hazina."
Sentence: "I’m taking you to my cave, because you are my treasure."

Jumle: Kolorokobimar Piu
Sentence: The Colorblind Bird

Jumle: Hay jongu fe piu hu da multi suki blue xey.
Sentence: There is a species of bird that really loves blue things.

Jumle: Den piu multi suki na plasi blue xey in sesu ogar ji in jali jarden.
Sentence: These birds love placing blue objects in their nests and in the surrounding garden.

Jumle: Folki jarden sen maxmo dekorado yon bluexey, to sen maxmo magnetosim fe piuli tonyen.
Sentence: The more the garden is decorated with blue items, the more attractive it is to bird partners.

Jumle: Mas un te of piu sen kolorokobimar.
Sentence: But one of the birds is colorblind.

Jumle: Te no oko aloya intre blue ji jalo xey.
