Sentence: They (sg.) can’t tell the difference between blue and yellow things.

Jumle: Fol te, blue flura ji jalo dahun hare sama kolor.
Sentence: To them (sg.), a blue flower and a yellow leaf have the same color.

Jumle: Fe resulta, te ixikal toncudu xey fe moydua kolor.
Sentence: As a result, they (sg.) unknowingly collect items of both colors.

Jumle: Moy alo piu suki na haha tem den normakal piu.
Sentence: The other birds like to laugh at this unusual bird.

Jumle: Ete loga: "Am oko, te le ripul seleti mal kolor!"
Sentence: They say "Look, they (sg.) picked the wrong color again!"

Jumle: "Tesu jarden sen daydenmo colo!"
Sentence: "Their (sg.) garden is so ugly!"

Jumle: "Te xa nilwatu ewreka lubiyen."
Sentence: "They (sg.) will never find a partner."

Jumle: Fe xoru, den coxo lawfen kolorokobimar piu.
Sentence: At first, these taunts bother the colorblind bird.

Jumle: Mas xafe watumon, te posjui ete.
Sentence: But after a while, they (sg.) ignore them.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Fol mi, misu xey sen blue."
Sentence: "To me, my things are blue."

Jumle: “Misu xey sen colo fol ete, mas oto sen meli fe mi."
Sentence: "My things are ugly to them, but beautiful to me."

Jumle: Alo piu xorjui ki kolorokobimar piu posjui ete.
Sentence: The other birds notice that the colorblind bird ignores them.

Jumle: Na coxo te no haji sen amusane koski te no ruaksyon.
Sentence: Mocking them (sg.) is no longer fun because they (sg.) don’t react.

Jumle: Fe folo, ete esto na lawfen.
Sentence: So they stop bothering them (sg.).

Jumle: Ete ripul idi na xerca blue xey tas sesu suli ogar.
Sentence: They go back to searching for blue things for their own nests.

Jumle: Hay xosu blue xey, mas hay multi piu hu da vole oto.
Sentence: There are few blue items, but many birds who want them.

Jumle: Piu pimpan musi na jento cel bluexey.
Sentence: Birds often have to fight over blue objects.

Jumle: To pimpan okur ki piu cori xey de alo piu.
Sentence: It often happens that a bird steals from another’s nest.

Jumle: Dento finikal okurgi konflito.
Sentence: This endlessly creates conflicts.

Jumle: Kolorokobimar piu no rol in den konflito.
Sentence: The colorblind bird does not participate in these conflicts.

Jumle: Te trankwilo ergo tas sesu suli jarden hu te dekora da fol sesu suli suki.
Sentence: They (sg.) calmly work on their own garden, decorating it according to their own taste.

Jumle: Tas sesu jarden, te maxusgi multi meli petra ji jozi hu alo piu posjui da.
Sentence: To their (sg.) garden, they (sg.) add many beautiful stones and nuts that other birds ignore.

Jumle: Ban din, visitane piu pergeo in jarden de kolorokobimar piu.
Sentence: One day, a visiting bird (VB) lands in the garden of the colorblind bird (CB).

Jumle: Visitane piu loga: "Yu hare maxim meli jarden of moyto hu mi le oko da!"
Sentence: VB: "You have the most beautiful garden I’ve ever seen!"

Jumle: Kolorokobimar piu sen surprisado.
Sentence: The colorblind bird is surprised.

Jumle: Dento sen unyum mara hu bante loga dento tas te.
Sentence: It’s the first time anyone has said that to them (sg.).

Jumle: Kolorokobimar piu swal: "Xukra. Mas yu suki misu jarden keseba?"
Sentence: CB: "Thank you. But why do you like my garden?"

Jumle: Visitane piu jawabu: "To sen daymo day ji jalo. Mi suki jalo kolor."
Sentence: VB: "It’s so large and yellow. I love the color yellow."

Jumle: Kolorokobimar piu loga: "O, mi fikir ki misu jarden sen blue."
Sentence: CB: "Oh, I think my garden is blue."

Jumle: Visitane piu loga: "Ha ha, yu sen amusane. Jalo ji blue sen samamenalexi! Den dua lexi mena sama to!"
Sentence: VB: "Haha, you’re funny. Yellow and blue are synonyms! Those two words mean the same thing!"

Jumle: Fe fato, pia visitane piu sen kolorokobimar!
Sentence: In fact, the visiting bird is also colorblind!

Jumle: Leli Watuyen Wazo
Sentence: Wazo the Out-of-Timer

Jumle: Wazo sen name de lao piu.
Sentence: Wazo is the name of an old bird.

Jumle: Wazo fikir ki denwatu hu te sen juni, moyto le sen perfeto.
Sentence: Wazo thinks that when they (sg.) were young, everything was perfect.

Jumle: Moy hewan le sen maxmo ehtiramfil.
Sentence: "Animals were more respectful."

Jumle: Moy hewan le hare maxmo bon suki.
Sentence: "Animals had better taste overall."

Jumle: Fol te, globa le sen bon, mas fe nunya, globa sen bur.
Sentence: According to them (sg.), the world used to be good, but now, the world is awful.

Jumle: Fe fato, Wazo no sen daymo lao, mas tesu ijen sen yakinmo denpul.
Sentence: In fact, Wazo isn’t that old, but their (sg.) opinions certainly are.

Jumle: Wazo hare dua bete.
Sentence: Wazo has two children.

Jumle: Ete sen normapul junipiu hu da hare normapul ninili suki.
Sentence: They are normal bird children with normal childlike tastes.

Jumle: Fe ban din, ete peti tas atre izin na idi cel musikaxow.
Sentence: One day, they ask their parent for permission to go to a concert.

Jumle: Bete swal: "Kam imi harizin na idi cel musikaxow de Jonimo?"
Sentence: Children: "Can we go to Jonimo’s concert?"

Jumle: Wazo swal: "Den Jojo sen kete?"
Sentence: Wazo: "Who is that clown?"

Jumle: Bete loga: "Te sen xohrapul rapuyen!"
Sentence: Children: "He's a famous rapper!"

Jumle: Wazo loga: "Uyu no harizin."
Sentence: Wazo: "You may not go."

Jumle: Bete swal: "Keseba???"
Sentence: Children: "Why???"

Jumle: Wazo multi belawfen den nenhajado swal.
Sentence: Wazo is very annoyed by this unnecessary question.

Jumle: Fol te, jawabu sen mingumo mimbay.
Sentence: To them (sg.), the answer is obviously clear!

Jumle: Rapuyen wakil bur jiwali maner.
Sentence: Rappers represent a bad way of life.

Jumle: Ete populergi dududan, alkohol ji alo burdava.
Sentence: They promote smoking, alcohol, and other drugs.

Jumle: Ete hata loga tem possantoxey!
Sentence: They even talk about unholy things!

Jumle: Mas maxim swikaranenible masele sen ki ete fale antinormadokuli musika.
Sentence: But the most unacceptable thing is that they make anti-fundamental music.

Jumle: To sen nefralaye ji basabur ki ete presenta lexili dukaku denpul kom arte.
Sentence: It is hateful and ungrammatical that they present word-vomiting as art.

Jumle: Musikali normatim le nilwatu aproba dento.
Sentence: The musical academy never approved of that.

Jumle: Bete musi na resta teli fe ete.
Sentence: Children must stay away from them.

Jumle: Eger no, ete xa hare bur suki.
Sentence: If not, they’ll develop bad taste.

Jumle: Kultura xa besonxi, ji sosyaltim xa dissokutu.
Sentence: Culture will be lost, and society will collapse.

Jumle: Wazo swal: "Kam uyu no abil na ore klasiko musika denmaner hu normapul bete fale?"
Sentence: Wazo: "Can’t you listen to classical music like normal children do?"

Jumle: Bete dayloga: "Feka!"
Sentence: Children: "Shit!"

Jumle: Wazo loga: "Am no loga feka! Am loga dyabol!"
Sentence: Wazo: "Don’t say ‘Shit!’ Say ‘Damn!’"

Jumle: Bete dayloga: "Dyabol!"
Sentence: Children: "Damn!"

Jumle: Wazo loga: "Am no loga dyabol. Dento sen dambipul!"
Sentence: Wazo: "Don’t say ‘Damn!’ That’s sinful too!"

Jumle: Denwatu, bete xoru na wawa.
Sentence: And then, the children begin to cry.

Jumle: Xafe watumon, Wazo aham ki te le sen godomo xucyofil.
Sentence: After a while, Wazo realizes they (sg.) were too harsh.

Jumle: Cel na peti mafu, te jeni tas sesu bete na tongo idi cel hewandom.
Sentence: To ask forgiveness, they (sg.) offer to take their children to the zoo.

Jumle: Multi doyan hewan loka in hewandom.
Sentence: Many different animals are at the zoo.

Jumle: Wazo real no suki den kolorpul hwanjin hu te ijen da cufampul tas sesu suki.
Sentence: Wazo really doesn’t like the colorful atmosphere, which they (sg.) find aggressive to their taste.

Jumle: Mas tesu bete kwasisen daymo hox, ji ete bewao moy hewan.
Sentence: However, their (sg.) children seem very happy and marvel at all the animals.

Jumle: Famil juioko taco:
Sentence: The family looks at ostriches:

Jumle: Wazo loga: "Hey, bete, am oko ki den piu sen daydenmo simpatilaye. Ete no abil na fley."
Sentence: Wazo: "Hey kids, look how pathetic those birds are. They can’t fly."

Jumle: Bete loga: "Mas ete pawbu daymo velosi!"
Sentence: Children: "But they run really fast!"

Jumle: Famil juioko hufax:
Sentence: The family looks at bats:

Jumle: Wazo loga: "Hey, uyu! Uyu fley keseba? Uyu sen mamoyen! Mamoyen no fley!"
Sentence: Wazo: "Hey you! Why are you flying? You’re mammals! Mammals don’t fly!"

Jumle: Hufax loga: "Am resta imi trankwilo, laoyen!"
Sentence: Bats: "Leave us alone, old man!"

Jumle: Bete belawfen xekayefilya de sesu atre.
Sentence: The children are embarrassed by their parent’s constant complaining.

Jumle: Wazo no esto.
Sentence: Wazo doesn’t stop.

Jumle: Te xekaye.
Sentence: They (sg.) complain.

Jumle: Te sahigi.
Sentence: They (sg.) correct.

Jumle: Te poscosan.
Sentence: They (sg.) criticize.

Jumle: Te sen posyukwe.
Sentence: They (sg.) are unpleasant.

Jumle: Folki watu max pasa, xekayefilya de Wazo max magneto jui de neryen.
Sentence: The more time passes, the more Wazo’s complaining draws attention from others.

Jumle: Lil grupo fe hewan le toncudu ner fe Wazo:
Sentence: A small group of animals gathers near Wazo:

Jumle: Hewanli grupo loga: "O, am oko! Mi le no jixi ki hewandom hare pia fosil!"
Sentence: Animal group: "Oh look! I didn’t know the zoo also had a fossil!"

Jumle: Wazo dayloga: "Fekali dyabol!"
Sentence: Wazo: "Goddammit!"

Jumle: Okresim Solo-krabe Okreyen
Sentence: Okrulo the Ochre Hermit Crab

Jumle: Hay sahel denloka hu multi meli solo-krabe ogar.
Sentence: There is a beach where many beautiful hermit crabs live.

Jumle: Moy solo-krabe labas sadafa hu da ofata mor sadafa-hewan.
Sentence: Each crab carries a shell that comes from a dead shell animal.

Jumle: Bannumer sadafa sen sol sefide, bannumer sadafa sen kolorpul.
Sentence: Some shells are just white; some shells are multicolored.

Jumle: Un solo-krabe hare okresim sadafa.
Sentence: One crab has an ochre shell.

Jumle: Kos to, te name Okreyen.
Sentence: Because of that, the crab is named Ochre.

Jumle: Hin sadafa no sen daymo espesyal, mas Okreyen multi suki to.
Sentence: The shell is not very special, but Ochre really likes it.

Jumle: Fe moy nyan hay day merasem.
Sentence: Every year, a big ceremony takes place.

Jumle: Kriban moy solo-krabe idi cel to.
Sentence: Almost all the crabs go to it.

Jumle: To sen merasem fe sadafali porgi.
Sentence: It is the shell exchange ceremony.

Jumle: Fol cwenton, moy solo-krabe am gibe sesu sadafa tas solo-krabe hu da sen minmo lao fe un nyan.
Sentence: According to tradition, each crab gives their shell to a crab who is one year younger.

Jumle: Denmaner, komuntim riyongu bon sadafa.
Sentence: That way, the community reuses good shells.

Jumle: Pia, solo-krabe suki na jaribi neo baytu.
Sentence: Crabs also like to try new homes.

Jumle: Mas Okreyen, te no suki.
Sentence: But Ochre, they (sg.) don't like it.

Jumle: Okreyen le no rol in merasem dur tiga nyan.
Sentence: Ochre hasn’t taken part in the ceremony for three years.

Jumle: Te fikir, "Misu sadafa sen perfeto. To sen bage of mi. To sen misu to."
Sentence: They (sg.) think: "My shell is perfect. It is part of me. It is mine."

Jumle: Xafe bannumer mesi, Okreyen kentan baxbaharili jabal.
Sentence: After a few months, Ochre explores an underwater mountain.

Jumle: Abruto, Okreyen ewreka mor xarke.
Sentence: Suddenly, Ochre finds a dead shark.

Jumle: To kwasisen xetocubon.
Sentence: It looks delicious.

Jumle: Nil maso-yamne hewan ner loka cel na konkure.
Sentence: No meat-eating animal is nearby to compete.

Jumle: Denpul kihoy okur sol fe un mara in jiwa de solo-krabe.
Sentence: Such an opportunity happens only once in a crab's life.

Jumle: Okreyen loga, "Daydenkwanti yamxey! Mi xa yam moyto!"
Sentence: Ochre says: "Abundant food! I’ll eat it all!"

Jumle: Okreyen xoru na yam.
Sentence: Ochre starts eating.

Jumle: Te yam ji yam.
Sentence: They (sg.) keep eating.

Jumle: Te hisi ki te maxmo ji maxmo katina abil na harka.
Sentence: They (sg.) feel that they (sg.) can move less and less easily.

Jumle: Mas te durepul yam.
Sentence: But they (sg.) keep eating.

Jumle: Abruto, okresim sadafa de Okreyen kasiru.
Sentence: Suddenly, Ochre’s ochre shell breaks.

Jumle: Te oko ki tesu baytu awsokutu fe multi bage.
Sentence: They (sg.) see their home fall apart into many pieces.

Jumle: Te sen godomo lil.
Sentence: It was too small.

Jumle: Te dayloga: "No! Misu sadafa! Misu baytu!"
Sentence: "No! My shell! My home!"

Jumle: Sadafakal solo-krabe paniko.
Sentence: The shell-less crab panics.

Jumle: Solo-krabe haja bala dalutul cel na gardi sesu daifu ji xetocubon fubu.
Sentence: A crab needs a strong shield to protect their soft and tasty abdomen.

Jumle: Ji fe nunya plu maso-yamne hewan ata.
Sentence: And now, meat-eating animals are coming.

Jumle: Fori hala behaja cel na no morcu.
Sentence: An immediate solution is needed in order not to die.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Kwasi, mi no haji hare alo opsyon."
Sentence: "Apparently I no longer have another option."

Jumle: Ji sadafakal solo-krabe inidi jali plastikoli botela.
Sentence: And the shell-less crab enters a nearby plastic bottle.

Jumle: Botela no sen konfortane.
Sentence: The bottle is not comfortable.

Jumle: Botela pia sen daymo xorjuiible.
Sentence: The bottle is also very noticeable.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Ible, eger mi sangu intre awjetixey, ren xa no xorjui mi."
Sentence: They (sg.) think: “Maybe if I hide between the trash, no one will notice me."

Jumle: Protesta de axolotle
Sentence: The Axolotle’s Protest

Jumle: Salamandra sen daymo dinifil jongu.
Sentence: Salamanders are a very religious species.

Jumle: Etesu dini inhare multi gixiki.
Sentence: Their religion consists of many rituals.

Jumle: Un gixiki sen gixiki fe baligucu.
Sentence: One of the rituals is the coming-of-age ritual.

Jumle: Denwatu hu salamandra dadal especifi laoje, te musi na glu espesyal bruno likwido.
Sentence: When a salamander reaches a certain age, they (sg.) must drink a special brown liquid.

Jumle: Denwatu, salamandra xorwala sesu nabxox, ji tesu forma total alocu.
Sentence: Then, the salamander loses their (sg.) gills, and their (sg.) form completely changes.

Jumle: Denwatu, salamandra no haji abil na jiwa in sui, mas te abil na jiwa per geo.
Sentence: After that, the salamander can no longer live in water, but they (sg.) can live on land.

Jumle: Fe leya, nilte le demoli xekaye tem cwenton.
Sentence: In the past, no one publicly complained about the tradition.

Jumle: Mas fol pasa de watu, max ji max salamandra vyata anti to.
Sentence: But as time passed, more and more salamanders spoke out against it.

Jumle: "Hosu sen termopul ji konfortane."
Sentence: "The lake is warm and comfortable."

Jumle: "Mi uje suki maner feki mi okocu."
Sentence: "I already like how I look."

Jumle: "Ren am no alogi mi."
Sentence: "No one should change me."

Jumle: Salamandra hu da posswikara na glu baligugine likwido cuyo sen axolotle.
Sentence: The salamanders who refuse to drink the adulting liquid are mostly axolotls.

Jumle: "Misu jismu, misu karar."
Sentence: "My body, my choice."

Jumle: Baligu salamandra no sen truti tem juniyen hu da no vole na alogi sesu forma.
Sentence: Adult salamanders are not pleased with the children who do not want to change their form.

Jumle: Baliguyen fikir ki to sen cufam tas ete ji tas etesu baligu meliya.
Sentence: The adults think it is an insult to adults, to their beauty.

Jumle: Baliguyen loga ki to sen cufam tas etesu teo.
Sentence: The adults say it is an insult to their gods.

Jumle: "Teo xa seza uyusu posehtiram."
Sentence: "The gods will punish your disrespect."

Jumle: Mas maxori axolotle uje no haji glu likwido.
Sentence: But by now, the majority of axolotls no longer drink it.

Jumle: "Imi uje sen baliguyen denmaner hu imi uje sen."
Sentence: "We are already adults as we already are."

Jumle: Plu nyan pasa.
Sentence: Years pass.

Jumle: Hosu hu denloka salamandra jiwa sencu maxmo ji maxmo trasokonenible.
Sentence: The lake where the salamanders live becomes more and more murky.

Jumle: Salamandra no jixi ku keseba.
Sentence: The salamanders do not know the reason.

Jumle: Fol multi te, sui nun hare bur nasacu.
Sentence: According to many, the water now has a bad smell.

Jumle: Na xikar in hosu sencu maxmo ji maxmo katina.
Sentence: Hunting in the lake becomes more and more difficult.

Jumle: Baliguyen loga: "Uyu am no resta in sui!"
Sentence: The adults say: "You shouldn’t stay in the water!"

Jumle: "Am glu, ji am ata na jiwa ton imi per geo!"
Sentence: "Drink, and come live with us on land!"

Jumle: Mas axolotle duregi na posswikara na glu bruno baligugine likwido.
Sentence: But the axolotls continue to refuse to drink the brown liquid to grow up.

Jumle: Xafe watumon, hosu le sencu totalmo trasokonenible.
Sentence: After some time, the lake becomes completely opaque.

Jumle: Alo salamandra no jixi kama axolotle haji jiwa in to.
Sentence: The other salamanders don’t know whether axolotls still live in it.

Jumle: Salamandra awanda.
Sentence: The salamanders walk away.

Jumle: Sui de hosu no haji sen laye cel etesu bebe.
Sentence: The lake water is no longer suitable for their babies.

Jumle: "Tas ete hu da posswikara na folo dini imi xa pala tem lanetudo axolotle."
Sentence: "To those who refuse to follow the religion, we will speak of the damned axolotls."

Jumle: Mas banwatu, gao maymun ewreka hin hosu.
Sentence: But eventually, tall apes discover the lake.

Jumle: In hosu, maymun ewreka bannumer axolotle.
Sentence: In the lake, the apes find some axolotls.

Jumle: Maymun fikir ki hin hewan sen interesne ji meli.
Sentence: The apes think these animals are interesting and beautiful.

Jumle: Maymun kolyo ki axolotle sen lil teo.
Sentence: The apes consider the axolotls to be little gods.

Jumle: Fe nunya, moy axolotle jiwa in kubo fe safe sui.
Sentence: Now, every axolotl lives in a cube of clean water.

Jumle: Ji ete beewreka moyloka in Dunya.
Sentence: And they are found all over the world.

Jumle: Maymun gibe tas ete moyto hu ete haja da.
Sentence: The apes give them everything they need.

Jumle: Axolotle swal tas se ku keto le okur tas alo salamandra.
Sentence: The axolotls wonder what happened to the other salamanders.

Jumle: Mitin de piu
Sentence: The Meeting of the Birds

Jumle: Suidaraje sen maxmo ji maxmo gao, ji to no esto na maxgaocu.
Sentence: The water level is getting higher and higher, and it does not stop rising.

Jumle: Nerxali, sui xa koberi moy bage de Dunya.
Sentence: Soon, all parts of the land will be covered by water.

Jumle: Nerxali, moy piu xa no haji hare loka cel na pergeocu.
Sentence: Soon, birds will no longer have anywhere to land.

Jumle: Cel na bloki morcu de moy piu, xohrapul piu organisa day mitin.
Sentence: To avoid the death of all birds, a famous bird organizes a great meeting.

Jumle: Xohrapul piu salom moy piu hu da rol in mitin.
Sentence: The famous bird greets all the birds who attend the meeting.

Jumle: "Bonata. Imi sen hinloka cel na ewreka xaya tas piulari."
Sentence: "Welcome. We are here to find a future for birdkind."

Jumle: Imi le ultrajiwa plu daybur okurxey.
Sentence: "We survived catastrophes."

Jumle: Imi le ultrajiwa meteor-petra.
Sentence: "We survived the meteor."

Jumle: Imi le ultrajiwa insanlari.
Sentence: "We survived humanity."

Jumle: Imi xa ultrajiwa fini de geo.
Sentence: "We will survive the end of land."

Jumle: Xohrapul piu swal:
Sentence: The famous bird asks:

Jumle: "Kam un te of uyu hare idey cel na sahay imi na ultrajiwa? Imi musi na juiore idey de moyte.
Sentence: "Does anyone here have an idea to help us survive? We must listen to everyone’s ideas."

Jumle: Barix-ababil nercu ji loga: "Imi ger abil na kostante fley! Imi xa no haji haja geo!"
Sentence: A swift approaches and says: "We can fly constantly! We will no longer need land!"

Jumle: Moy alo piu no suki hin idey.
Sentence: The other birds don’t like the idea.

Jumle: Ete loga ki na fley dur lungo watu sen godomo katina.
Sentence: They say it’s too hard to fly for a long time.

Jumle: Ete loga ki ete haja ogar cel na plasi sesu ovo.
Sentence: They say they need a place to lay their eggs.

Jumle: Gotas-piu nercu ji loga: "Imi abil na ogar per sui! Imisu ovo ger abil na sen per flotane kyota!"
Sentence: A grebe approaches and says: "We can live on water! Our eggs could be on floating nests!"

Jumle: Bannumer piu suki hin idey, mas maxoriya no suki to.
Sentence: Some birds like the idea, but the majority don’t.

Jumle: He ban kayvutu abil na sangu in daybahari.
Sentence: Any monster could be hiding in the great ocean.

Jumle: "Godomo hataripul!"
Sentence: "Too dangerous!"

Jumle: Huhu nercu ji loga: "Imi abil na ogar in baxsuili gufa!"
Sentence: An owl approaches and says: "We can live in underwater caves!"

Jumle: Bannumer piu suki idey, mas maxoriya fikir ki to sen swikaranenible.
Sentence: Some birds like the idea, but most find it unacceptable.

Jumle: Ete loga ki piu haja lumin.
Sentence: They say a bird needs light.

Jumle: Ji gufa xa velosi no haji hare oksigen.
Sentence: And the cave would soon run out of oxygen.

Jumle: Pengwin nercu ji loga: "Imi abil na ogar per ayse!"
Sentence: A penguin approaches and says: "We can live on ice!"

Jumle: Kriban moy piu haha.
Sentence: Almost all the birds laugh.

Jumle: "Denloka sen godomo bardipul!"
Sentence: "Too cold there!"

Jumle: Xohrapul piu oko ki haji nilte le jeni bon idey.
Sentence: The famous bird sees that no one has yet proposed a good idea.

Jumle: Te nercu ji loga sesu idey: "Imi abil na fley cel alo planeta!"
Sentence: They (sg.) approach and say their (sg.) idea: "We can fly to another planet!"

Jumle: Moy alo piu surprisa.
Sentence: The other birds are surprised.

Jumle: Ete no jixi ku na ruaksyon kemaner.
Sentence: They don’t know how to react.

Jumle: Mas hin piu sen xohrapul.
Sentence: But the bird is famous.

Jumle: Fe folo, ete vyata aproba yon afarin.
Sentence: So they express their approval with applause.

Jumle: Ji ete loga: "Xohrapul piu sen daycinonyen!"
Sentence: And they say: "The famous bird is a genius!"

Jumle: Sahay tas haul
Sentence: The Help for the Wolves

Jumle: Haul sencu maxmo ji maxmo nadir.
Sentence: Wolves are becoming rarer and rarer.

Jumle: In total dexa, sol bannumer te jula resta.
Sentence: In the whole country, only a few remain, scattered and isolated.

Jumle: Maymun vole na sahay ete.
Sentence: The apes want to help them.

Jumle: Maymun krea day kafas.
Sentence: The apes build a large cage.

Jumle: Cel in to, ete inplasi multi drevo ji nahir ji gufa jmt.
Sentence: Inside it, they place many trees, rivers, caves, etc.

Jumle: Ete karar na namegi hin meli kafas "hewandom".
Sentence: They decide to name this beautiful cage a “zoo.”

Jumle: Maymun fikir ki haul xa sen hox hinloka.
Sentence: The apes think the wolves will be happy there.

Jumle: Haul xa hare multi xey cel na amusa, ji ete xa no haji sen solo.
Sentence: The wolves will have much to entertain themselves with, and they will no longer be alone.

Jumle: Ji fe onxala, haul xa hare bebe, denmaner max haul xa hay in dexa.
Sentence: And hopefully, the wolves will have babies, so there will be more wolves in the country.

Jumle: Mas fe nunya, maymun haja na ewreka haul, bujo ete, ji inporta ete cel hewandom.
Sentence: But now, the apes need to find the wolves, capture them, and bring them to the zoo.

Jumle: Cel to, ete organisa totalnasyonli misyon.
Sentence: For that, they organize a nationwide mission.

Jumle: Multi maymun suki hin projeto, ji ete vole na sahay kom voluntiryen.
Sentence: Many apes like the project and help a lot as volunteers.

Jumle: Ete fikir ki to sen bon tas haul.
Sentence: They think it’s good for the wolves.

Jumle: In kafas, haul xa no abil na xigoli morcu in natura.
Sentence: In a cage, the wolves can no longer accidentally die in the wild.

Jumle: Misyon sen suksespul, ji moy lima haul in dexa nun loka in kafas.
Sentence: The mission is successful, and the five wolves of the country are now in the cage.

Jumle: Jawguyen de kafas velosi xorjui ki multi maymun vole na oko haul.
Sentence: The caretakers of the cage quickly notice that many apes want to look at the wolves.

Jumle: Multi maymun sen jumbi na multi paya cel na oko yesen hewan yon seli oko.
Sentence: Many apes are willing to pay a lot to see a wild animal with their own eyes.

Jumle: Fe folo, multi turiyen ata, ji ton ete, multi maydoyen ata, hu da le ewreka interesne mamba fe klientelari.
Sentence: So many tourists come, and with them come many vendors who have found an interesting source of customers.

Jumle: Mas fe ban din, dua haul le firaru cel ex kafas.
Sentence: But one day, two wolves escape from the cage.

Jumle: Xorhay paniko.
Sentence: Panic breaks out.

Jumle: Haul abil na sen moyloka.
Sentence: The wolves could be anywhere.

Jumle: Ji haul uje sen yesen hewan.
Sentence: And the wolves are still wild animals.

Jumle: Ji maymun abil na sen interesne yam tas yampeldo haul.
Sentence: And an ape can be an interesting meal for a hungry wolf.

Jumle: Neo misyon beorganisa: na bujo hin dua nenkrasido haul maxim velosi.
Sentence: A new mission is organized: to capture the two uncontrolled wolves as quickly as possible.

Jumle: To sen cel bonya tas haul.
Sentence: It is for the good of the wolves.

Jumle: Ex kafas, haul abil na xigoli morcu kos hatari fe globa de maymun.
Sentence: Outside the cage, the wolves could accidentally die due to the dangers of the ape world.

Jumle: Haul sen velosi ribujodo, ji riplasido in kafas. Uf.
Sentence: The wolves are quickly recaptured and returned to the cage. Phew.

Jumle: Jawguyen finili abil na rahatu xafe hin bala ji estrespul okurxey.
Sentence: The caretakers can finally rest after this intense and stressful event.

Jumle: Mas, xafe bannumer din, ete xorjui ki muhim banto le okur dur noce.
Sentence: But, after a few days, they notice that something serious happened during the night.

Jumle: Un te of hin dua haul, hu da le firaru, le morcu.
Sentence: One of the two wolves who escaped has died.

Jumle: Un te of hin dua haul, hu da le firaru, muhim bejuruha alo haul.
Sentence: One of the two wolves who escaped is seriously wounded by a wolf who did not escape.

Jumle: Hewanmedisyen finrasona ki unyum te le morcu kos estres.
Sentence: A veterinarian concludes that the first one died from stress.

Jumle: Hin dua haul no beswikara nor besuki in haullari.
Sentence: The two wolves were not accepted or liked by the wolf group.

Jumle: Ji ete le fale moyto, hu ete abil na fale da, cel na resta nenton alo haul.
Sentence: And they did everything they could to stay away from the other wolves.

Jumle: Fe asif, ete le no beaham.
Sentence: Unfortunately, they were not understood.

Jumle: Yon na ribujo ete, hin dua haul le beriporta cel sesu problema, cel grupoli problema, cel morcu.
Sentence: By recapturing them, the wolves were brought back to their problems, to group conflicts, and to death.

Jumle: Jawguyen fikir: "Dento sen asiflaye, mas imi le real xidu na sahay."
Sentence: The caretakers think: "That is unfortunate, but we really tried to help."

Jumle: "Fe jaxali mara, imi sahay maxmo bon."
Sentence: "Next time, we’ll help better."

Jumle: Hero de kargux
Sentence: The Hero of the Rabbits

Jumle: Komuntim fe kargux ogar in wadi.
Sentence: A community of rabbits lives in a valley.

Jumle: To sen daymo trankwilo.
Sentence: It is very peaceful.

Jumle: No hay multi okurxey.
Sentence: Not many things happen.

Jumle: Nilwatu hay problema.
Sentence: No problems ever occur.

Jumle: Nilwatu hay hatari.
Sentence: No danger ever arises.

Jumle: Ji hinloka, juni-kargux multi posamusa.
Sentence: And the young rabbits here are very bored.

Jumle: Un te of kargux de komuntim sen xogyoyen.
Sentence: One of the rabbits in the community is a merchant.

Jumle: Fe dumara, te dao cel teli dexa cel na porgi nadir xey.
Sentence: From time to time, they (sg.) travel to distant lands to trade rare goods.

Jumle: Ji denwatu hu te ruata, moy juniyen tonata wey te.
Sentence: And when they (sg.) return, the children always gather around them (sg.).

Jumle: Ji denwatu, xogyoyen hikaye sesu plu aventur tas ete.
Sentence: And then, the merchant tells them stories of their (sg.) adventures.

Jumle: Xogyoyen hikaye tem waopul loka.
Sentence: The merchant speaks of wondrous places.

Jumle: Ku keloka hay posasan tyojan ji ku kemaner te le yunki ji sukses.
Sentence: Where there are difficult challenges, and how they (sg.) acted bravely and succeeded.

Jumle: Ku keloka te le jento velosi kayvutu denpul kom leopar ji bala kayvutu denpul kom baru.
Sentence: Where they (sg.) fought against monsters fast as leopards and monsters strong as bears.

Jumle: Ahamible, hikaye multi inxo juniyen.
Sentence: Naturally, the stories deeply impress the children.

Jumle: Fe hataya fe na yongu sahi name de xogyoyen, ete loga "hero".
Sentence: Instead of using the merchant’s real name, they say “the hero.”

Jumle: Mas, mimbay, hikaye maxori sen nensati.
Sentence: But, of course, the stories are mostly untrue.

Jumle: Xogyoyen le nilwatu oko kayvutu.
Sentence: The merchant has never seen monsters.

Jumle: Dur sesu dao, te sol pala tem kima ton alo xogyoyen.
Sentence: During their (sg.) travels, they (sg.) only discuss prices with other merchants.

Jumle: Hero fikir: "Dento sen sol lil kadiba."
Sentence: The hero thinks: “Well, it’s just a little lie.”

Jumle: "Dento amusa juniyen, ji dento amusa mi.
Sentence: “It entertains the children, and it entertains me.”

Jumle: Mas juniyen pala, multi ji estokal.
Sentence: But children talk, a lot and constantly.

Jumle: Hikaye de hero le populercu intre moy juniyen.
Sentence: The hero’s stories become popular among all the children.

Jumle: Ji oto populercu intre etesu atre.
Sentence: And they become popular among their parents.

Jumle: Ji oto populercu intre alo membro de komuntim.
Sentence: And they become popular among the other members of the community.

Jumle: Fe ban din, paniko okur in komuntim de kargux.
Sentence: One day, panic strikes the rabbit community.

Jumle: Rubahe le hataripul nercu cel kyotalari.
Sentence: A fox is dangerously approaching the nests.

Jumle: Fe ruaksyon, grupo fe kargux velosi idi cel kyota de hero cel na peti sahay.
Sentence: In response, a group of rabbits quickly goes to the hero’s nest to ask for help.

Jumle: "Hero!"
Sentence: “Hero!”

Jumle: "Kayvutu nercu!"
Sentence: “A monster is approaching!”

Jumle: "Imi haja yunkipul bante!"
Sentence: “We need someone brave!”

Jumle: "Velosi bante!"
Sentence: “Someone fast!”

Jumle: "Bala bante!"
Sentence: “Someone strong!”

Jumle: "Imi jixi ki yu abil na bawe moy imi!"
Sentence: “We know you can defend us all!”

Jumle: Hero jagecu ji xorixi halulari.
Sentence: The hero wakes up and realizes the situation.

Jumle: Te estres.
Sentence: They (sg.) panic.

Jumle: Te jixi ki te no abil na jento kayvutu.
Sentence: They (sg.) know they (sg.) can’t fight a monster.

Jumle: Te ger suki na firaru, mas godo munte ji oko vole ki te xekaste rubahe.
Sentence: They (sg.) would like to run, but too many mouths and eyes want them (sg.) to defeat the fox.

Jumle: Xafe watumon, te fikir: "Mi sen xogyoyen, mi ible abil na zakere ton kayvutu celki te no atake."
Sentence: After a while, they (sg.) think: “Well, I’m a merchant, maybe I can negotiate with the monster so they (sg.) won’t attack.”

Jumle: Hero idi, ji fe nunya, te sen solo fe fronta de rubahe.
Sentence: The hero goes and now stands alone before the fox.

Jumle: Hero: "Kayvutu, mi peti ki yu no maxpul idi cel fronta"
Sentence: Hero: “Monster, I ask that you go no farther.”

Jumle: Rubahe: "Mi no sen kayvutu, mi sen rubahe"
Sentence: Fox: “I’m not a monster, I’m a fox.”

Jumle: Hero: "Eger yu xa no yam imi, imi abil na vada harepulya tas yu"
Sentence: Hero: “If you don’t eat us, we can promise you riches.”

Jumle: Rubahe: "O, mi sen vegetariyen. Uyu, kargux... uyu hare multi malhukimu... Dento no sen lutufpul."
Sentence: Fox: “Oh, I’m vegetarian. You rabbits… you have so many prejudices… That’s not very kind.”

Jumle: Eger ren sen vegetariyen, dento mena ki ren no yam maso.
Sentence: When someone is vegetarian, that means they don’t eat meat.

Jumle: Fe folo, dento mena ki ren no yam kargux.
Sentence: So that also means they won’t eat a rabbit.

Jumle: Hero exhawa kos trankwilocu.
Sentence: The hero exhales in relief.

Jumle: Te fikir ki te le multi estres kos nilto.
Sentence: They (sg.) think they (sg.) were stressed over nothing.

Jumle: Te fikir: "Mi nun abil na ruata tas alo kargux.
Sentence: They (sg.) think: “Now I can return to the other rabbits.”

Jumle: " "Mi xa loga tas ete ki mi le dongwigi kayvutu na no atake imi.
Sentence: “I’ll tell them I convinced the monster not to attack us.”

Jumle: "Misu reputasi denpul kom xogyoyen xa sencu hata maxmo gao!"
Sentence: “My reputation as a negotiator will become even greater!”

Jumle: Kargux rota sesu kapi, ji xoru na anda hoy komuntim.
Sentence: The rabbit turns their head and begins walking back toward the community.

Jumle: Mas fori xafe dento, rubahe tyao cel kargux, ji kata tesu gardan.
Sentence: But just after that, the fox leaps onto the rabbit and slashes their [rabbit’s] throat.

Jumle: Rubahe fahuri loga: "Lil kadiba, day ofresulta!"
Sentence: The fox proudly says: “Little lie, big consequences!”

Jumle: Swimo ji plastikoli lilbao
Sentence: The Jellyfish and the Plastic Bag

Jumle: Swimo ji plastikoli lilbao xijere.
Sentence: A jellyfish and a plastic bag are arguing.

Jumle: Swimo loga ki te sen maxmo inxone kom lilbao.
Sentence: The jellyfish claims to be more impressive than the bag.

Jumle: Fe oposya, lilbao loga ki to sen maxmo inxone kom swimo.
Sentence: On the contrary, the bag claims to be more impressive than the jellyfish.

Jumle: Ete no samaijen.
Sentence: They can’t agree.

Jumle: Hin sotipul xijere lawfen dolfin hu da ner ogar.
Sentence: Their noisy argument annoys a dolphin who lives nearby.

Jumle: Dolfin hare idey: Swimo ji lilbao musi na loga ku ete abil na fale keto.
Sentence: The dolphin has an idea: the jellyfish and the bag must each say what they are capable of.

Jumle: Dolfin xa newtral tatmini.
Sentence: The dolphin will judge neutrally.

Jumle: Eger te fikir ki abilxey sen inxone, te gibe golmon tas dente.
Sentence: If they (sg.) think that one’s ability is impressive, they (sg.) will award a point to that one.

Jumle: Xafe xatumon, dente (swimo or lilbao) hu da hare maxori golmon xa triunfa.
Sentence: After a while, the one (the jellyfish or the bag) who has more points than the other will win.

Jumle: Swimo (S): "Mi le precu lefe kriban moy bioyen!"
Sentence: Jellyfish (J): "I appeared before almost all living creatures!"

Jumle: Plastikoli lilbao (PL): "Mi xa awcu xafe moy bioyen!"
Sentence: Plastic Bag (PB): "I will disappear after all living creatures!"

Jumle: Swimo (S): "Mas kom unxey yu xa awcu. Swimo fe bannumer jongu abil na finikal jiwa."
Sentence: J: "But individually, you’ll disappear someday. Some jellyfish species can live forever."

Jumle: Dolfin, hu da ger multi suki na abil na finikal jiwa, gibe golmon tas swimo.
Sentence: The dolphin, who would really like to live forever, gives a point to the jellyfish.

Jumle: S: "Mi sen in moy daybahari!"

Sentence: J: "Even in the deepest abysses and on the highest mountains?"

Sentence: PB: "Absolutely."

Jumle: Dolfin, hu da memori na oko plastiko moyloka, gibe golmon tas plastikoli lilbao.
Sentence: The dolphin, who remembers seeing plastic everywhere, gives a point to the plastic bag.

Jumle: S: "Mi sen hataripul hewan!"
Sentence: J: "I’m a dangerous animal!"

Jumle: PL: "Ha ha. Yu sol flota."
Sentence: PB: "Lol. You just float."

Jumle: S: "Am sotikalcu, mi bekoberi dokya-kantaka!"
Sentence: J: "Silence, I’m covered in venomous stingers!"

Jumle: PL: "Mas, eger yu yongu oto?"
Sentence: PB: "But do you use them?"

Jumle: S: "Si, moywatu. Mi xikar."
Sentence: J: "Yes, always. I hunt."

Jumle: PL: "Kam yu morgi hata insan?"
Sentence: PB: "Do you even kill humans?"

Jumle: S: "Dumara."

Jumle: S: "Kam sati? Yu abil na fale dento kemaner?"

Sentence: The dolphin has heard enough.

Sentence: They (sg.) give a point to the plastic bag, which truly is much more frightening because of its invisible danger.

Sentence: The plastic bag has more points than they (sg.) do.

Sentence: The jellyfish doesn’t answer. The jellyfish has escaped!

Sentence: The dolphin looks for the jellyfish and can’t find them (sg.).

Jumle: Kontrata de Remora
Sentence: The Remora’s Contract

Jumle: Remora suyon in bahari.
Sentence: A remora swims in the sea.

Jumle: Hin mahi xerca baharili hewan.
Sentence: The fish is searching for marine animals.

Jumle: Fe ban mara, te oko xarke.
Sentence: At some point, they (sg.) see a shark.

Jumle: Te nercu cel xarke.
Sentence: They (sg.) approach the shark.

Jumle: Xarke: "Yu vole keto?"
Sentence: Shark: "What do you want?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi vole na tonidi yu."
Sentence: Remora: "I want to accompany you."

Jumle: Xarke: "To ger fayda mi kemaner?"
Sentence: Shark: "How would that benefit me?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi abil na safegi yusu pifu."
Sentence: Remora: "I can clean your skin."

Jumle: Xarke: "Kam yu loga ki mi sen colo?"
Sentence: Shark: "Are you saying I’m ugly?"

Jumle: Remora: "No!"
Sentence: Remora: "No!"

Jumle: Xarke: "Am awidi."
Sentence: Shark: "Go away."

Jumle: Remora sen hazuni, ji awidi.
Sentence: The remora is unhappy and leaves.

Jumle: Fe ban mara, te oko balena.
Sentence: At some point, they (sg.) see a whale.

Jumle: Te nercu cel balena.
Sentence: They (sg.) approach the whale.

Jumle: Balena: "Yu vole keto?"
Sentence: Whale: "What do you want?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi vole na tonidi yu.
Sentence: Remora: "I want to accompany you."

Jumle: Balena: "To ger fayda mi kemaner?"
Sentence: Whale: "How would that benefit me?"

Jumle: Remora: "Yu xa sen minmo solo.
Sentence: Remora: "You will be less alone."

Jumle: Balena: "Mi no sen solo. Fe fato, plu remora uje folo mi."
Sentence: Whale: "I am not alone. In fact, several remoras already follow me."

Jumle: Remora: "Fe hataya, kam mi harizin na tonidi yu?"
Sentence: Remora: "Can I still accompany you?"

Jumle: Balena: "No."
Sentence: Whale: "No."

Jumle: Remora: "Okey."
Sentence: Remora: "Okay."

Jumle: Remora sen hazuni.
Sentence: The remora is unhappy.

Jumle: Fe ban mara, te oko kacupa.
Sentence: At some point, they (sg.) see a turtle.

Jumle: Remora umumi no suki kacupa.
Sentence: The remora generally doesn’t like turtles.

Jumle: Mas, na tonidi kacupa sen maxmo bon kom na sen solo.
Sentence: But it’s better to be with a turtle than to be alone.

Jumle: Kacupa: "Yu folo mi keseba?"
Sentence: Turtle: "Why are you following me?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi haja gardi anti xikaryen."
Sentence: Remora: "I need protection from predators."

Jumle: Kacupa: "Kam yu fikir ki mi abil na sahay yu?"
Sentence: Turtle: "Do you think I can help you?"

Jumle: Remora: "Si, yu hare bala sadafa."
Sentence: Remora: "Yes, you have a strong shell."

Jumle: Kacupa: "Mas, yu abil na fale keto pro mi?"
Sentence: Turtle: "But what can you do for me?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi abil na yam kexru-hewan hu da xunjan per yu."
Sentence: Remora: "I can eat the crustaceans that grow on you."

Jumle: Ji denmaner, yu xa sen maxmo meli fol alo kacupa.
Sentence: Remora: "And that way you’ll be more beautiful to the other turtles."

Jumle: Kam yu swikara kontrata?"
Sentence: Remora: "Do you accept the contract?"

Jumle: Kacupa: "Eger mi swikara, keto ger okur?"
Sentence: Turtle: "What happens if I accept?"

Jumle: Remora: "Mi ger binde misu jismu cel yu yon susutul per misu ruke!"
Sentence: Remora: "I’ll attach my body to you with the sucker on my back!"

Jumle: Kacupa no xorjui ku te ger sonxi keto.
Sentence: The turtle doesn’t see what they (sg.) would lose.

Jumle: Kacupa swikara.
Sentence: The turtle accepts.

Jumle: Remora binde se cel sadafa per fubu de kacupa.
Sentence: The remora attaches to the shell on the turtle’s belly.

Jumle: Kacupa ji remora bla.
Sentence: The turtle and the remora chat.

Jumle: Ete xoru na soho suki alo te.
Sentence: Both start to like each other.

Jumle: Mas abruto, kacupa hisi ki remora multi pospel.
Sentence: But suddenly, the turtle feels that the remora is pulling hard.

Jumle: Kacupa: "Yu fale keto?"
Sentence: Turtle: "What are you doing?"

Jumle: Remora: "Banto pospel mi yon misu koda."
Sentence: Remora: "Something is pulling me by my tail."

Jumle: Sipul, lungo xilo binde koda de remora tas lilnavi de mahi-bujoyen.
Sentence: In fact, a long line connects the remora’s tail to a fisherman’s boat.

Jumle: Fe leya, mahi-bujoyen le bujo remora.
Sentence: The fisherman had caught the remora earlier.

Jumle: Mahi-bujoyen le plasi rinjon wey koda, ji te le binde xilo tas hin rinjon.
Sentence: The fisherman placed a ring around the tail, and tied a line to the ring.

Jumle: Eger remora binde se tas baharili hewan, mahi-bujoyen ger abil na pospel xilo cel na bujo hin hewan.
Sentence: When the remora attaches to a sea creature, the fisherman can pull the line to catch the animal.

Jumle: Kacupa: "Keto okur? Kam yu sahay mahi-bujoyen?"
Sentence: Turtle: "What’s happening? Are you helping the fisherman?"

Jumle: Remora: "No.
Sentence: Remora: "No. I want to free myself!"

Jumle: Mi vole na hurugi mi! Am suyon maxmo velosi! Imi abil na kasiru xilo!"
Sentence: Remora: "Swim faster! We can break the line!"

Jumle: Kacupa: "Mi no abil na suyon maxmo velosi! Am esto na woju mi! Mi vole na jiwa!"
Sentence: Turtle: "I can’t swim faster! Stop holding onto me! I want to live!"

Jumle: Remora duregi na woju kacupa yon sesu susutul.
Sentence: The remora keeps holding onto the turtle with their (sg.) sucker.

Jumle: Kacupa paniko.
Sentence: The turtle panics.

Jumle: Remora sen sotikal.
Sentence: The remora is silent.

Jumle: Xafe kurto watu, mahi-bujoyen abil na cudu kacupa yon sesu hanta.
Sentence: After a while, the fisherman can take the turtle with his hands.

Jumle: Mahi-bujoyen morgi kacupa.
Sentence: The fisherman kills the turtle.

Jumle: Remora finili esto na susu, ji te posbinde se of kacupa.
Sentence: The remora finally stops sucking and detaches from the turtle.

Jumle: Mahi-bujoyen: "Bon bujo, remora. Prehay bankwanti yam."
Sentence: Fisherman: "Nice catch, remora. Here’s some food."

Jumle: Remora: "Am nun ofplasi rinjon. Misu koda guton!"
Sentence: Remora: "Now remove the ring. My tail hurts!"

Jumle: Mahi-bujoyen: "No, yu no haji preporta tas mi kufi baharili hewan."
Sentence: Fisherman: "No, you still haven’t brought me enough sea creatures."

Jumle: Remora fikir: "Mahi-bujoyen le cipen mi.
Sentence: The remora thinks: "The fisherman tricked me."

Jumle: Te le loga ki un hewan xa sen kufi.
Sentence: "They (sg.) said one animal would be enough."

Jumle: Na swikara kontrata de nenbekoneyen le no sen bon idey!"
Sentence: "Accepting a contract from a stranger wasn’t a good idea!"

Jumle: Utaravento ji Sola
Sentence: The North Wind and the Sun

Jumle: Utaravento ji Sola debate ku kete sen maxmo bala, denwatu hu daoyen preata koberido in termopul kapa.
Sentence: The North Wind and the Sun were disputing which was the stronger, when a traveler came along wrapped in a warm cloak.

Jumle: Ete sohovada ki dente hu da unyum kosa ki daoyen ofplasi sesu kapa ingay na beganci na sen maxmo bala kom alo te.
Sentence: They agreed that the one who first succeeded in making the traveler take his cloak off should be considered stronger than the other.

Jumle: Denwatu, Utaravento vento yon sesu total balaya, mas folki te max vento, daoyen maxmo tange koberi se yon kapa; ji fe fini, Utaravento esto na xidu.
Sentence: Then the North Wind blew as hard as he could, but the more he blew the more closely did the traveler fold his cloak around him;     and at last the North Wind gave up the attempt.

Jumle: Denwatu, Sola termopul xorbrila, ji fori, daoyen ofplasi sesu kapa; ji fe folo, Utaravento bexucyo na etiraf ki Sola sen maxim bala te of dua te.
Sentence: Then the Sun shined out warmly, and immediately the traveler took off his cloak.     And so the North Wind was obliged to confess that the Sun was the stronger of the two.

Jumle: Singa ji Maux
Sentence: The Lion and the Mouse

Jumle: Ban mara, denwatu hu singa somno, lil maux xoru na pawbu cel super ji infer per te.
Sentence: Once, when a Lion was asleep, a little Mouse began running up and down upon him.

Jumle: Nerxali, hinto jagegi singa, hu da plasi sesu dayday peda per te, ji da buka sesu day jabare cel na nigalu te.
Sentence: This soon wakened the Lion, who placed his huge paw upon him, and opened his big jaws to swallow him.

Jumle: Lil maux dayloga, "Mafu, gao wangu. Am awmafu mi hin mara, mi xa nilwatu wanji to! Ible, mi abil na rugibe lutuf ban nerxali din."
Sentence: "Pardon, O King," cried the little Mouse, "forgive me this time, I shall never forget it! I may be able to return the favor one of these day?"

Jumle: Singa denmo multi begude idey feki maux ger abil na sahay te, ki fe folo, te lifti sesu peda ji te izin tas maux na idi.
Sentence: The Lion was so tickled at the idea of the Mouse being able to help him that he lifted up his paw and let him go.

Jumle: Banwatu fe xaya, singa bebujo in bujotul, ji xikaryen, hu da vole na porta singa jiwane cel wangu, binde hinte tas drevo, durki denete idi na xerca wagon cel na porta singa.
Sentence: Some time after, the Lion was caught in a trap, and the hunters, who desired to carry him alive to the King, tied him to a tree while they went in search of a wagon to carry him on.

Jumle: Den preciso momento, lil maux folpasa fe xanse, ji fe na oko hazuni burxanse de singa, dente nercu cel hinte, ji nerxali, maux awyao kordo hu da binde wangu de hewan.
Sentence: Just then the little Mouse happened to pass by, and seeing the sad plight of the Lion, went up to him and soon gnawed away the ropes that bound the King of the Beasts.

Jumle: Lil maux loga, "Kam mi le no sahiloga?"
Sentence: "Was I not right?" said the little Mouse.

Jumle: Lil doste abil, fe fini, na sen daybon doste.
Sentence: Little friends may prove great friends.

Jumle: Rubahe ji Kraw
Sentence: The Fox and the Crow

Jumle: Banwatu, rubahe oko kraw na awfley har bage fe jubin in sesu conce ji na esto per xube de drevo.
Sentence: A Fox once saw a Crow fly off with a piece of cheese in its beak and settle on a branch of a tree.

Jumle: Rubahe loga, "Dento sen tas mi." Te anda cel peda de drevo, ji te dayloga, "Bonnuru, senyor kraw, yu okocu daydenmo bon nundin: yusu yumaw sen daydenmo brilapul; yusu oko sen daydenmo luminpul. Mi sen yakin ki yusu voka xankakal ultrapasa dento de plu alo piu, sama kom yusu figura. Am izin tas mi na ore sol un lala fal yu, celki mi am salom yu denpul kom wangu de piu."
Sentence: "That's for me," said the Fox, and he walked up to the foot of the tree. "Good day, Mistress Crow," he cried. "How well you are looking today: how glossy your feathers; how bright your eyes. I feel sure your voice must surpass that of other birds, just as your figure does. Let me hear but one song from you that I may greet you as the Queen of Birds."

Jumle: Kraw lifti sesu kapi, ji te xoru na krawsa fol sesu otimaya, mas fe momento hu fe da te buka sesu munte, bage fe jubin sokutu cel geo, sol celki rubahe awbujo to.
Sentence: The Crow lifted up her head and began to caw her best, but the moment she opened her mouth the piece of cheese fell to the ground, only to be snapped up by the Fox.

Jumle: Te loga, "Hinto sen kufi. Hinto le sen moyto hu mi vole da. Por yusu jubin, mi xa gibe tas yu nasiha cel xaya: am no xinloy tamalukuyen."
Sentence: "That will do," said he. "That was all I wanted. In exchange for your cheese I will give you a piece of advice for the future: Do not trust flatterers."

Jumle: Kargux ji Kroa
Sentence: The Hares and the Frogs

Jumle: Plu kargux denmo multi bebohay plu alo hewan, ki fe folo denete no jixi ku na idi cel keloka.
Sentence: The Hares were so persecuted by the other beasts they did not know where to go.

Jumle: Fori xaki ete oko un solo hewan na nercu cel ete, ete awpawbu.
Sentence: As soon as they saw a single animal approach them, off they used to run.

Jumle: Ban din, ete oko yesen umalari hu da daypawbu fe jowey, ji fe real paniko, moy kargux awajela cel ner hosu, kararpul na garaku fe tayti fe na jiwa in denmo fobipul jotay.
Sentence: One day they saw a troop of wild Horses stampeding about, and in quite a panic all the Hares scuttled off to a nearby lake, determined to drown themselves rather than live in such a continual state of fear.

Jumle: Mas preciso momento feki ete nercu cel byen de hosu, kroalari, fobido fe turno fal nercu de kargux, awajela ji tyao cel in sui.
Sentence: But just as they got near the bank of the lake, a troop of Frogs, frightened in their turn by the approach of the Hares, scuttled off, and jumped into the water.

Jumle: Un te of kargux loga, "Sati, imisu halulari no sen denmo bur kom to kwasisen: moywatu hay bante in maxmo bur halulari kom yu."
Sentence: "Truly," said one of the Hares, "things are not so bad as they seem: there is always someone worse off than yourself."

Jumle: Baru ji Dua Daoyen
Sentence: The Bear and The Two Travelers

Jumle: Dua insan tongo dao pas drevogeo denwatu hu baru abruto precu in etesu dao.
Sentence: Two people were traveling together through a forest when a bear suddenly appeared in their path.

Jumle: Un te of daoyen velosi supraidi cel drevo, ji te sangu se intre xube.
Sentence: One of the travelers quickly climbed a tree and hid himself among the branches.

Jumle: Alo te oko ki te xa beatake. Fe folo, te infrajeti se cel geo.
Sentence: The other saw that he would be attacked, so he threw himself on the ground.

Jumle: Baru ata cel te, ji dente plasi sesu nasa ner fe tesu ore, ji te nasa insan fe totalya.
Sentence: The bear came up to him and put its snout close to his ear and smelled him all over.

Jumle: Mas fe fini, baru restagi te, koski nil baru yam mor maso.
Sentence: But at last he left him, because bears do not eat dead meat.

Jumle: Jaxali, alo daoyen infraidi of drevo ji, fe na haha, te swal tas sesu doste ku baru le lilloga keto tas tesu ore.
Sentence: Then the other traveler descended from the tree and, laughing, asked his friend what the bear had whispered in his ear.

Jumle: Tonyen jawabu, "Te le gibe tas mi hin nasiha: Am nilwatu xinloy doste hu da awrestagi yu denwatu hu hatari nercu."
Sentence: "He gave me this advice," the companion replied, "Never trust a friend who abandons you at the approach of danger."

Jumle: Dahabutofa ji Tiga Baru
Sentence: Goldilocks and the Three Bears

Jumle: Banwatu, tiga baru ogar in lil baytu in drevolari.
Sentence: Once upon a time, three bears dwelled in a small house in the forest.

Jumle: Ete sen Baru Papa, Baru Mama, ji Baru Bebe.
Sentence: They were Papa Bear, Mama Bear and Baby Bear.

Jumle: Baru Mama fale yamxey cel sobayam.
Sentence: Mama Bear made food for breakfast.

Jumle: Te plasi to per dayday dyex, per mididay dyex, ji per daylil dyex.
Sentence: She placed it on a huge dish, a medium dish and a tiny dish.

Jumle: Mas yamxey sen godomo termopul.
Sentence: But the food was too hot.

Jumle: Fe folo, baru awidi cel na sampo durki to bardicu.
Sentence: Thus, the bears left so as to go on a walk while it cools.

Jumle: Lil femnini hu da name Dahabutofa sampo pas drevolari.
Sentence: A little girl named Goldilocks strolled through the forest.

Jumle: Denwatu hu te ewreka baytu de tiga baru, te nasa yamxey, ji te inidi.
Sentence: When she found the house of the three bears, she smelled food, and entered.

Jumle: Unyum, te xidu na yam of dayday dyex, mas to sen godomo termopul! Jaxali, te xidu na yam of mididay dyex, mas to sen godomo bardipul! Jaxali, te xidu na yam of daylil dyex.
Sentence: First, she tried to eat from the huge plate, but it was too hot! Then, she tried to eat from the medium plate, but it was too cold! Then, she tried to eat from the tiny plate.

Jumle: To sen perfeto, fe folo, te awyam moykwanti to!
Sentence: It was perfect, thus, she ate it all up!

Jumle: Denwatu hu te fini, Dahabutofa hisicu yampul.
Sentence: When she finished, Goldilocks felt stuffed.

Jumle: Fe folo, te karar na side.
Sentence: Thus, she decided to sit.

Jumle: Unyum, te side per dayday kursi de Baru Papa, mas to sen godomo gao! Jaxali, te side per mididay kursi de Baru Mama, mas to sen godomo pahna! Jaxali, te side per daylil kursi de Baru Bebe.
To sen perfeto! Mas Dahabutofa sen godomo wajenpul, ji kursi kasiru!
Dahabutofa supraidi cel somnodom de baru.
Unyum, te leta per dayday bistar de Baru Papa, mas to sen godomo sakate! Jaxali, te leta per mididay bistar de Baru Mama, mas to sen godomo narem! Jaxali, te leta per daylil bistar de Baru Bebe.
To sen perfeto.
Sentence: It is perfect.

Jumle: Dahabutofa jale xorsomno denwatu hu baru ruata ji ete sidecu cel na yam.
Baru Papa dayloga, "Bante le yam bankwanti to of misu yamxey!"
Baru Mama dayloga, "Bante le yam bankwanti to of misu yamxey!"
Baru Bebe dayloga, "Bante le yam misu yamxey.
Ji te le awyam moykwanti to!"
Baru Papa idi na sidecu per sesu dayday kursi.
Baru Papa dayloga, "Bante le side per misu kursi!"
Baru Mama dayloga, "Bante le side per misu kursi!"
Baru Bebe dayloga, "Bante le side per misu kursi.
Ji te le kasiru to!"
Tiga baru supraidi cel somnodom.
Baru Papa dayloga, "Bante le somno per misu bistar!"
Baru Mama dayloga, "Bante le somno per misu bistar!"
Baru Bebe dayloga, "Bante le somno per misu bistar.
Ji te haji sen hinloka!"
Denwatu hu Dahabutofa jagecu ji oko tiga baru, te multi bexorfobi, fe folo, te pawbu total watu durki te ruidi cel sesu ogar, ji te nilwatu ruata!

Sentence: My disease strengthened my senses.

Jumle: To le no destrui or daifugi oto.

Sentence: My strongest sense was my hearing.

Jumle: Mi le abil na ore moyto in Janatu ji in Dunya.
Sentence: I could hear everything in Heaven and on Earth.

Jumle: Mi le ore multi xey in Jahanom.
Sentence: I heard many things in Hell.

Jumle: Finto, mi sen majnuni kemaner?
Sentence: So, how am I crazy?

Jumle: Am juiore, ji am jui ku mi abil na kemo trankwilo ji mingu loga tas yu total hikaye.
Sentence: Listen up, and pay attention to how calmly and clearly I can tell you the whole story.

Jumle: Mi no jixi ku idey le ofata keloka, mas denwatu hu to le precu, to le kostante lawfen mi.
Sentence: I don't know where the idea came from, but when it appeared, it constantly bothered me.

Jumle: Le no hay seba kos to.
Sentence: There was no reason for it.

Jumle: Le no hay bala ganjon tem to.
Sentence: There was no strong feeling about it.

Jumle: Fe fato, mi le suki lao manixu.
Sentence: I actually liked the old man.

Jumle: Te le nilwatu guton mi.
Sentence: He never hurt me.

Jumle: Te le nilwatu burganjongi mi.
Sentence: He never made me upset.

Jumle: Mi le no vole tesu pesa.
Sentence: I didn't want his money.

Jumle: Mi fikir ki seba le sen tesu oko!
Sentence: I think that it was because of his eye!

Jumle: Si, dento le sen seba!
Sentence: Yes, it was that!

Jumle: Un to of tesu oko okocu sim kom to de nasru, sefidemo blue oko har dambo cengu per to.
Sentence: One of his eyes looked like a vulture's, a light blue eye with a thin layer over it.

Jumle: Denwatu hu to le oko mi, mi le ganjoncu fobido, ji mi le karar xosu xafe xosu na morgi lao manixu cel na awgi tesu oko cel moywatu.
Sentence: Whenever it looked at me, I felt scared, and I very slowly decided to kill the old man to get rid of his eye forever.

Jumle: Prehay cuyotyan.
Sentence: Here's the point.

Jumle: Yu fikir ki mi sen majnuni.
Sentence: You think that I'm crazy.

Jumle: Majnuniyen jixi nilto.
Sentence: Crazy people know nothing.

Jumle: Mas yu le ingay na oko mi.
Sentence: But you should've seen me.

Jumle: Yu le ingay na oko ku mi le aksyon kemo gomyo; daymo juipul, daymo cinonpul, daymo sirili, mi le ergo!
Sentence: You should've seen how cleverly I acted; very carefully, very smartly, very secretly, I worked!

Jumle: Mi le nilwatu sen maxmo lutufpul tas lao manixu kom dur total safta leki mi le morgi te.
Sentence: I was never nicer to the old man than during the whole week before I killed him.

Jumle: Ji fe moy noce daju fe midinoce, mi le rota hantatul de tesu dwer, ji mi le buka to: o, daydenmo narem!
Sentence: And every night at about midnight, I turned the latch of his door and opened it: oh, so gently!

Jumle: Ji jaxali, denwatu hu mi le fale kufimo day bukaxey tas misu kapi, mi le ingi luminkal lenterna, kompletomo klosido celki nil lumin brila, ji jaxali, mi le pasgi misu kapi.
Sentence: And then, when I made a hole big enough for my head, I put in a dark lantern, completely closed so no light shined out, and then I put my head through.

Jumle: O, yu le ingay na oko ku mi le pasgi to kemo gomyo!
Sentence: Oh, you should've seen how cunningly I put it through!

Jumle: Mi le harka to hanman, daymo, daymo hanman, celki mi no jundwan somno de manixu.
Sentence: I moved it slowly, very, very slowly, so I wouldn't disrupt the old man's sleep.

Jumle: Mi le pasa un satu cel na kufi pasgi misu kapi celki mi abil na oko te durki te le leta per sesu bistar.
Sentence: It took me an hour to put my head through enough so that I could see him as he laid on his bed.

Jumle: Ha!
Sentence: Hah!

Jumle: Kam majnuniyen ger le sen denmo gomyo kom hinto?
Sentence: Would a crazy person have been as clever as this?

Jumle: Ji jaxali, denwatu hu misu kapi le kompleto sen in kamer, mi le buka lenterna juipul, daymo juipul (koski bisagra le soti); mi le kufi buka to celki dambo radya fe lumin celidi oko de nasru.
Sentence: And then when my head was fully in the room, I opened the lantern carefully, very carefully (because the hinges made noise); I opened it just enough for a thin ray of light to reach the vulture eye.

Jumle: Ji mi le fale hinto dur sabe noce, moy noce preciso fe midinoce, mas mi le oko ki oko moywatu sen klosido; fe folo, na fale ergo le sen nenible.
Sentence: And I did this for seven long nights, every night at exactly midnight, but I saw that the eye was always closed, so it was impossible to do the work.

Jumle: To le no sen lao manixu hu da le lawfen mi; to le sen tesu Bur Oko.
Sentence: It wasn't the old man that bothered me; it was his Evil Eye.

Jumle: Ji fe moy soba, denwatu hu dinlumin le ata, mi le sexinloypul inidi kamer, ji mi le yunkipul pala tas te, le kweho voka tesu name ji le swal ku tesu noce sen kepul.
Sentence: And every morning, when the daylight came, I confidently entered the room and spoke boldly to him, cheerfully calling him by name, and asked how his night was.

Jumle: Te ger le musi na sen daymo cinonpul cel na gixim ki fe moy noce preciso fe midinoce, mi juioko te durki te somno.
Sentence: He'd have to be really smart to find out that every night at exactly midnight, I looked at him while he slept.

Jumle: Fe ocoyum noce, mi le sen maxmo juipul kom xugwanpul denwatu hu mi le buka dwer.
Sentence: On the eighth night, I was more cautious than usual when I opened the door.

Jumle: Mi le harka misu hanta maxmo hanman kom minuto-ixara de satumeter.
Sentence: I moved my hand more slowly than a watch's minute hand.

Jumle: Mi le nilwatu xoraham daraje de misu abilya ji sofi denpul kom fe den noce.
Sentence: I never realized the extent of my abilities and wisdom like I did that night.

Jumle: Mi le eskaso abil na krasi misu ganjon fe triunfa.
Sentence: I could hardly contain my feeling of triumph.

Jumle: Am imaje mi fe na buka dwer xosu xafe xosu, ji te fe na sen ixikal fe misu sirili aksyon ji fikir.
Sentence: Imagine me opening the door little by little, and him being unaware of my secret actions and thoughts.

Jumle: Mi le bankwanti lilhaha kos den idey, ji te le ible ore mi koski te le abruto harka per sesu bistar kwasimo surprisado.
Sentence: I somewhat chuckled at the idea, and he might have heard me because he suddenly moved on the bed as if startled.

Jumle: Yu ible fikir ki mi le rukadam, mas no.
Sentence: You might think that I retreated, but no.

Jumle: Tesu kamer le sen kompletomo luminkal (janela le sen tangemo klosido kos fobi fe ofcoriyen), ji kos to, mi le jixi ki te no abil na oko dwer fe na buka, ji mi le duregi na pel to hanman, hanman.
Sentence: His room was completely dark (the windows were tightly closed because of a fear of robbers), and so I knew that he couldn't see the door opening, and I kept pushing it steadily, steadily.

Jumle: Misu kapi le sen fe inya, ji mi le jaxa buka lenterna, denwatu hu misu dayxuji deleza per estanoli liftitul, ji lao manixu le sidecu per bistar, fe na dayloga, "Kete sen denloka!?"
Sentence: My head was inside, and I was about to open the lantern when my thumb slipped on the tin lever, and the old man sat up in the bed, shouting, "Who's there!?"

Jumle: Mi le resta totalmo harkakal ji le loga nilto.
Sentence: I kept quite still and said nothing.

Jumle: Fe total satu, mi le no harka adola, ji fe durya, mi le no ore te na letacu.
Sentence: For a whole hour I did not move a muscle, and in the meantime, I did not hear him lie down.

Jumle: Te le haji side per bistar, fe na ore, preciso denmaner hu mi le fale to fe moy noce, dur na ore gubangu in divar.
Sentence: He still sat in the bed, listening, just as I did night after night, listening to the beetles in the wall.

Jumle: Nerxali, mi le ore daifu exnafasu, ji mi le jixi ki to sen exnafasu fe teror.
Sentence: Soon, I heard a weak exhale, and I knew that it was the exhale of terror.

Jumle: To le no sen exnafasu fe guton or hazuniya, o no!
Sentence: It wasn't an exhale of pain or sadness, oh no!

Jumle: To le sen sotilil, inhifazido soti hu da exata of amikuya de ruho denwatu hu to sen pul fe fobi.
Sentence: It was the quiet, held-in sound that comes from the bottom of the soul when filled with fear.

Jumle: Mi le kone hin soti bon.
Sentence: I knew that sound well.

Jumle: Fe multi noce, preciso fe midinoce, denwatu hu moyte le somno, to le xunjan in misu cati, fe na maxgi fobi hu da le lawfen mi yon sesu rusoti.
Sentence: Many nights, at exactly midnight, when everyone was asleep, it grew in my chest, increasing the fears that bothered me with its frightening echo.

Jumle: Mi loga tas yu, mi le kone to bon.
Sentence: I tell you, I knew it well.

Jumle: Mi le jixi ku lao manixu ganjon keto, ji mi le ganjon simpati tas te, fe hataya ki mi le sirili fikir ki to sen humorpul.
Sentence: I knew what the old man felt, and pitied him, although I secretly thought that it was funny.

Jumle: Mi le jixi ki te sen jage xorfe unyum lil soti hu denwatu te le jwan in bistar.
Sentence: I knew that he had been awake since the first slight noise when he turned in bed.

Jumle: Tesu plu fobi le xunjan xorfe denwatu.
Sentence: His fears had been growing since then.

Jumle: Te le xidu na imanugi se ki oto sen basikal, mas te le no sukses.
Sentence: He had tried to convince himself that they were baseless, but he couldn't.

Jumle: Te le loga tas se, "To sen sol vento in dudantubo, to sen sol maux hu da trasidi dixan," or "To sen sol krigiri hu da le fale un solo krigirisa." Si, te le xidu na anwi se yon hin plu jadin, mas te le no xorhare sukses.
Sentence: He had been telling himself, "It's just the wind in the chimney, it's just a mouse crossing the floor," or "It's just a cricket that made a single chirp." Yes, he has been trying to comfort himself with these suppositions, but he had no success.

Jumle: To le no funsyon koski Morya, durki te le nercu cel te, le fale sesu luminkal saye fe fronta de te, ji Morya le lifafa te in to.
Sentence: It didn't work because Death, as he approached him, made his dark shadow in front of him and wrapped him in it.

Jumle: Ji den nenokodo saye le kosa ki te ganci misu presen in kamer, fe hataya ki te le noro oko nor ore mi.
Sentence: And that unseen shadow made him sense, although he neither saw nor heard, my presence in the room.

Jumle: Xafe na intizar daymo sabar dur lungo watu wal na ore te na letacu, mi le karar na buka daylil daraki in lenterna.
Sentence: After waiting very patiently for a long time without hearing him lie down, I decided to open a very small crevice in the lantern.

Jumle: Mi le buka to daymo, daymo juipul finki un solo luminlil radya, denpul kom xilo de kumi, le exidi daraki ji le celidi nasruli oko.
Sentence: So I opened it very, very carefully until a single dim ray, like the thread of a spider, came out of the crevice and reached the vulture eye.

Jumle: To le sen pahnamo bukado, ji mi le sencu gadibu denwatu hu mi le juioko to.
Sentence: It was widely open, and I got angry when I looked at it.

Jumle: Mi le oko to perfeto.
Sentence: I saw it perfectly.

Jumle: To le sen daifumo blue har ajabu koberi per to hu da le day fobi mi, mas mi le no abil na oko resta de muka or jismu de lao manixu koski mi le lide radya preciso cel sahi lokabage wal na musi na fikir.
Sentence: It was a dull blue with a strange covering over it that really frightened me, but I couldn't see the rest of the old man's face or body because I directed the ray at exactly the right spot without having to think.

Jumle: Ji kam yu memori to hu denwatu mi le loga ki dento hu yu fikir ki da sen majnuniya sen sol maxboncu fe gancikowa?
Sentence: And remember when I said that what you think is craziness is just increased senses?

Jumle: Nunto, mi le ore lil, velosi soti, denpul kom satumeter lifafado in koton.
Sentence: Well, I heard a brief little sound, like a watch wrapped in cotton.

Jumle: Mi le kone pia den soti.
Sentence: I knew that sound well, too.

Jumle: To le sen nabiza de tutum de lao manixu.
Sentence: It was the beating of the old man's heart.

Jumle: To le sengi mi maxmo gadibu, denmaner hu darbe fe drumu yunki askeriyen.
Sentence: It made me angrier, like how the beating of a drum encourages a soldier.

Jumle: Mas fe hataya fe dento, mi le estowoju mi ji le resta harkakal.
Sentence: But despite that, I resisted and stayed still.

Jumle: Mi le eskaso nafasu.
Sentence: I barely breathed.

Jumle: Mi le restagi lenterna harkakal.
Sentence: I kept the lantern still.

Jumle: Mi le jaribi ku mi abil na restagi radya kemo harkakal per oko.
Sentence: I tested how still I could keep the ray on the eye.

Jumle: Fe durya, nabiza de tutum le maxbalacu.
Sentence: Meanwhile, the beating of the heart increased.

Jumle: To le sencu maxmo ji maxmo velosi, maxmo ji maxmo sotipul, sekundo xafe sekundo.
Sentence: It became faster and faster, louder and louder, every moment.

Jumle: Manixu le dayible sen kompletomo dayfobido!
Sentence: The man must have been absolutely terrified!

Jumle: To le sencu maxmo sotipul, mi riloga, maxmo sotipul, fol moyun sekundo!
Sentence: It grew louder, I repeat, louder, every second!

Jumle: Kam yu aham mi?
Sentence: Do you understand me?

Jumle: Mi le uje zekaru ki mi asan sencu fobido, to sen sati.
Sentence: I already mentioned that I easily get scared, and I am.

Jumle: Ji fe midiya de noce, in fobine sotikalya de den lama baytu, daydenmo ajabu soti le kompleto fobi mi.
Sentence: And in the middle of the night, in the dreadful silence of that old house, such a strange noise completely terrified me.

Jumle: Hatali, mi le resta harkakal dur bannumer maxpul minuto.
Sentence: Even so, I kept still for a few more minutes.

Jumle: Mas nabiza le sencu maxmo ji maxmo sotipul!
Sentence: But the beating got louder and louder!

Jumle: Mi le fikir ki tutum xa pom.
Sentence: I thought the heart would burst.

Jumle: Ji jaxali, neo banto le yolyu mi: soti ible beore jara!
Sentence: And then something new worried me: the sound might be heard by a neighbor!

Jumle: Watu fe morcu de lao manixu le preata!
Sentence: The time of the old man's death had come!

Jumle: Ton sotipul cihe, mi le buka lenterna ji le tyao cel in kamer.
Sentence: With a loud yell, I opened the lantern and jumped into the room.

Jumle: Te le ayay un mara, ji sol un mara.
Sentence: He screamed once, and only once.

Jumle: Jaxali momento, mi le pospel te cel dixan ji le plasi wazenpul bistar per te.
Sentence: The next moment, I pulled him to the floor and put the heavy bed on top of him.

Jumle: Jaxali, mi le tabasum kweho, fe na jixi ki fale kriban sen finido.
Sentence: Then I smiled cheerfully, knowing that the deed was almost finished.

Jumle: Mas dur multi minuto, tutum le duregi na nabiza har koberido soti.
Sentence: But for many minutes, the heart kept beating with a muffled sound.

Jumle: Hatali, hinto le no lawfen mi koski to ger no beore pas divar.
Sentence: This, however, didn't bother me, as it wouldn't be heard through the wall.

Jumle: Fe fini, to le esto.
Sentence: Finally, it stopped.

Jumle: Lao manixu le sen mor.
Sentence: The old man was dead.

Jumle: Mi le harka bistar ji le moni morjismu.
Sentence: I moved the bed and examined the corpse.

Jumle: Si, te le sen kompletomo, kompletomo mor.
Sentence: Yes, he was completely, completely dead.

Jumle: Mi le plasi misu hanta per tesu tutum ji le restagi to denloka dur multi minuto.
Sentence: I put my hand on his heart and kept it there for many minutes.

Jumle: Le no hay nabiza.
Sentence: There was no pulse.

Jumle: Te le sen kompletomo mor.
Sentence: He was completely dead.

Jumle: Tesu oko le no haji lawfen mi.
Sentence: His eye would not bother me anymore.

Jumle: Eger yu haji fikir ki mi sen majnuni, yu xa no haji fikir dento denwatu hu mi xa tosifu gomyo xey hu mi le fale da cel na sangu jismu.
Sentence: If you still think I'm crazy, you won't think that anymore when I describe the clever things I did to hide the body.

Jumle: Durki noce le pasa, mi le ergo velosi mas sotikal.
Sentence: As the night passed, I worked quickly but quietly.

Jumle: Mi le ofplasi tiga tahta of dixan de kamer ji le plasi moyto in neo bukaxey.
Sentence: I removed three planks from the floor of the room and put everything in the opening.

Jumle: Jaxali, mi le ruplasi tahta daydenmo gomyo, ki fe folo nil insanli oko, no hata tesu to, ger abil na xorjui mal banto.
Sentence: Then, I put the boards back so cunningly that no human eye, not even his, could have noticed anything wrong.

Jumle: Le hay nilto na safegi.
Sentence: There was nothing to clean.

Jumle: Nil burtyan, nil damuplax.
Sentence: No stains, no blood splatters.

Jumle: Mi le sen godomo juipul tem dento.
Sentence: I was too cautious for that.

Jumle: Xaki mi le fini misu ergo, to le sen satu care, haji denmo luminkal kom midinoce.
Sentence: After I finished my work, it was four o'clock, still as dark as midnight.

Jumle: Denwatu hu satu le rinjon, le hay toka per dwer fe fronta.
Sentence: When the bell rang at the hour, there was a knock at the front door.

Jumle: Mi le joxupul idi cel na buka to, koski mi le hare keto na befobi fe nunya?
Sentence: I cheerfully went to open it, because what did I have now to fear?

Jumle: Tiga manixu le inidi, hu da adebupul xorkonegi se denpul kom polisiyen.
Sentence: Three men entered, who politely introduced themselves as police officers.

Jumle: Ayay le beore jara dur noce hu da maxgi fikir ki bur banto le befale; informe le begibe tas polisidom, ji polisiyen le beirsal cel na ofxerca zona.
Sentence: A scream had been heard by a neighbor during the night, increasing suspicions that something bad was done; information was given to the police station, and they (the officers) were sent to search the area.

Jumle: Mi le tabasum, koski mi le hare keto na befobi?
Sentence: I smiled, because what did I have to fear?

Jumle: Mi le bonatagi manixu.
Sentence: I welcomed the men.

Jumle: Mi le loga tas ete ki cihe le sen kos misu roya, ji ki lao manixu sen awsenli in nongyogeo.
Sentence: I told them that the scream was from my dream, and that the old man was away in the countryside.

Jumle: Mi le gida misu visitayen wey baytu.
Sentence: I guided my visitors around the house.

Jumle: Mi le loga tas ete ki ete am xerca, ji am xerca bon.
Sentence: I told them to search, and to search well.

Jumle: Fe fini, mi le gida ete cel tesu kamer.
Sentence: Finally, I guided them to his room.

Jumle: Mi le onexa tas ete tesu jacipulxey, anjen ji nenharkado.
Sentence: I showed them his valuables, safe and unmoved.

Jumle: Daymo sexinloypul, mi le preporta kursi cel in kamer ji le teyan ki ete am sidecu ji laxocu, durki mi, fe na ganjoncu triunfapul, le plasi misu kursi supra to hu denloka morjismu de korbani le leta.
Sentence: Very confidently, I brought chairs into the room and offered them to sit down and relax, while I, feeling victorious, placed my chair above where the victim's corpse lay.

Jumle: Polisiyen le sen truti.
Sentence: The officers were satisfied.

Jumle: Misu konduta le imanugi ete.
Sentence: My behavior convinced them.

Jumle: Mi le sen juilayemo estreskal.
Sentence: I was remarkably unstressed.

Jumle: Ete le sidecu, ji durki mi le jawabu kweho, imi le intrepala ordinari.
Sentence: They sat down, and while I responded cheerfully, we conversed casually.

Jumle: Mas nerxali, mi le xoru na sencu cambay ji le vole ki ete am awidi.
Sentence: But soon, I started to become pale and wanted them to leave.

Jumle: Misu kapi le guton, ji mi le fikir ki mi ore rinjon in misu ore; mas ete le duregi na pala.
Sentence: My head hurt, and I thought that I heard a ringing in my ears; but they kept talking.

Jumle: Rinjon le sencu maxmo ji maxmo xorjuiible.
Sentence: The ringing became more and more noticeable.

Jumle: Mi le pala maxmo huru cel na esto ganjon, mas to le dure ji sencu hata maxmo xorjuiible, finki finili, mi le xoraham ki soti no ofata misu ore.
Sentence: I talked more freely to stop the feeling, but it continued and became even more noticeable, until finally, I realized that the noise did not come from my ears.

Jumle: Mi le xankakal sencu cambay, mas mi le pala maxmo velosi ji sotipul.
Sentence: I definitely became very pale, but I talked more quickly and loudly.

Jumle: Soti le sencu maxmo sotipul, ji mi le no jixi ku na fale keto.
Sentence: The sound became louder, and I didn't know what to do.

Jumle: To le sen sotikal, nenmingu, velosi soti, denpul kom satumeter koberido in koton.
Sentence: It was a quiet, covered, fast sound, like a watch wrapped in cotton.

Jumle: Mi le velosi nafasu, fe hataya ki polisiyen le no ore to.
Sentence: I breathed quickly, even though the officers didn't hear it.

Jumle: Mi le pala maxmo velosi ji maxmo joxupul, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
Sentence: I spoke faster and more passionately, but the sound gradually became louder.

Jumle: Mi le estaycu ji xijere tem nenmuhim xey, sotipul ji yon day jestu, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
Sentence: I stood up and argued about unimportant things loudly and with big gestures, but the noise gradually became louder.

Jumle: Ete xa no awidi keseba?
Sentence: Why wouldn't they leave?

Jumle: Mi le anda suo ji kanan yon day kadam, kwas mi le sencu gadibu kos etesu komenta, mas soti le foldarajeli sencu maxmo sotipul.
Sentence: I walked back and forth with heavy steps, as if I got angry with their comments, but the sound gradually became louder.

Jumle: O Teo!
Sentence: Oh God!

Jumle: Mi ger abil na fale keto?
Sentence: What could I do?

Jumle: Per total Dunya hay un basa ji un pala.
Sentence: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

Jumle: Durki ete dao hoy dongu, ete ewreka pangugeo in dexa Xinar, ji ete xorogar denloka.
Sentence: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and settled there.

Jumle: Ete soho loga tas se, “Am ata, imi am fale ituka, ji imi atex oto finfe na sen jumbi.” Ete hare ituka fe tayti fe petra, ji ete yongu taru fe tayti fe milatu.
Sentence: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and fire them thoroughly.” They used brick instead of stone, and used tar instead of mortar.

Jumle: Jaxali, ete loga, “Am ata, imi am kostrui tas imi xaher, har towa hu dasu kapi dadal asman, celki imi am supraidi cel xohra; fe alo kaso, imi xa discu cel in alodexa per total Dunya.”
Sentence: Then they said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make ourselves famous, otherwise we will be scattered over the whole earth.”

Jumle: Mas Prabu infraidi cel na oko xaher ji towa hu insan le kostrui da.
Sentence: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the people had built.

Jumle: Prabu loga, “Am oko, ete sen un demo, ji moyete hare un basa, ji hinto sen dento hu ete xoru na fale da. Fe nunya, nilto hu ete nyatu na fale da xa sen nenible fe etesu kaso.
Sentence: The Lord said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing which they intend to do will be impossible for them.

Jumle: Am ata, imi am infraidi, ji denloka imi am disordenu etesu basa, celki ete no abil na soho aham sesu pala.”
Sentence: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

Jumle: Fe folo, Prabu disgi ete xorfe denloka cel perya de total Dunya, ji ete esto na kostrui xaher.
Sentence: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there over the whole earth, and they stopped building the city.

Jumle: Denseba, ren namegi tas to Babel, koski denloka Prabu disordenu basa de total Dunya. Xorfe denloka, Prabu disgi ete cel perya de total Dunya.
Sentence: Therefore it was called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of the whole earth. From there, the Lord scattered them over the whole earth.
