Jumle: Fe folo ki swikara fe benjili sungen ji fe egal ji awcudunenible haki de moy membro de insanli famil sen basi de huruya, adilya ji xanti in globa,
Sentence: Whereas recognition of the inherent dignity and of the equal and inalienable rights of all members of the human family is the foundation of freedom, justice and peace in the world,

Jumle: Fe folo ki posjui ji posjacigi fe insanli haki le resulta daybawlupul fale hu da bala cufam yoxin de insanlari, ji fe folo ki realcu de globa hu in da insan xa befuraha huruya fe vyata ji fe imanu ji pia huruya of fobi ji of haja le begongaw denpul kom maxim gao cele de ordinari insan,
Sentence: Whereas disregard and contempt for human rights have resulted in barbarous acts which have outraged the conscience of mankind, and the advent of a world in which human beings shall enjoy freedom of speech and belief and freedom from fear and want has been proclaimed as the highest aspiration of the common people,

Jumle: Fe folo ki to sen daymuhim, eger insan am no bemusigi, denpul kom finili seleti, na panlan anti bawlukrasi ji infragi, ki insanli haki am begardi yon lega,
Sentence: Whereas it is essential, if man is not to be compelled to have recourse, as a last resort, to rebellion against tyranny and oppression, that human rights should be protected by the rule of law,

Jumle: Fe folo ki to sen daymuhim, na frongi evolu fe dostefil gwanxi intre nasyon,
Sentence: Whereas it is essential to promote the development of friendly relations between nations,

Jumle: Fe folo ki demo de Uncudo Nasyonlari le rideklara in reguladoku sesu bala imanu fe basili insanli haki, fe sungen ji layeya de insanli personya ji fe egal haki de moy femyen ji manyen, ji pia le daykarar na frongi sosyal fronkadam ji maxmo bon jiwali jotay in maxmo day huruya,
Sentence: Whereas the peoples of the United Nations have in the Charter reaffirmed their faith in fundamental human rights, in the dignity and worth of the human person and in the equal rights of men and women and have determined to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom,

Jumle: Fe folo ki Membroli Dexa le sohovada na dadal, in tonaksyon ton Uncudo Nasyonlari, frongi fe moyli ehtiram ji folo fe insanli haki ji basili huruya,
Sentence: Whereas Member States have pledged themselves to achieve, in co-operation with the United Nations, the promotion of universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms,

Jumle: Fe folo ki komun aham tem hin haki ji huruya sen maxim muhim cel pul realgi fe hin vada,
Sentence: Whereas a common understanding of these rights and freedoms is of the greatest importance for the full realization of this pledge,

Jumle: Fe folo, fe nunya, Umumi Tonatatim gongaw hin Globatotal Deklara tem Insanli Haki denpul kom komun cele fe dadal tas moy demo ji moy nasyon, celki moy person ji moy organo de sosyaltim, fe na kostante jui hin deklara, yon alim ji eskolya, juhudi na frongi ehtiram fe hin haki ji huruya, ji yon darajeli kadam, nasyonli ji intrenasyonli oto, na yakingi otosu moyli ji fatoli swikara ji folo, egal intre demo de Membroli Dexa, kom intre demo de teritori bax otosu jurisdiksi.
Sentence: Now, therefore, The General Assembly, Proclaims this Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a common standard of achievement for all peoples and all nations, to the end that every individual and every organ of society, keeping this Declaration constantly in mind, shall strive by teaching and education to promote respect for these rights and freedoms and by progressive measures, national and international, to secure their universal and effective recognition and observance, both among the peoples of Member States themselves and among the peoples of territories under their jurisdiction.

Jumle: Mon 1
Sentence: Article 1

Jumle: Moy insan xencu huru ji egal fe sungen ji haki.
Sentence: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.

Jumle: Ete hare rasona ji yoxin, ji ete ingay na soho konduta fol ruho fe sodarya.
Sentence: They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

Jumle: Mon 2
Sentence: Article 2

Jumle: Moy haki ji huruya hu da bedingya in hin deklara deya moy insan, nenhar he banpul aloyagi, kama fol rasa, pifuli kolor, jensi, basa, dini, politili or alo ijen, nasyonli or sosyal asel, kam ekonomili, xenculi or alo jotay.
Sentence: Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status.

Jumle: Maxpul, nil aloyagi am befale fe basi de politili, jurisdiksili or intrenasyonli daraje de dexa or teritori hu den person deya da, kama to sen ikawkal, bax jawgutimya, nensekrasine, kam bax he alo limitexey fe soberenya.
Sentence: Furthermore, no distinction shall be made on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status of the country or territory to which a person belongs, whether it be independent, trust, non-self-governing or under any other limitation of sovereignty.

Jumle: Mon 3.
Sentence: Article 3

Jumle: Moyte haki jiwa, huruya ji personli anjenya.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.

Jumle: Mon 4.
Sentence: Article 4

Jumle: Nilte am bewoju in gulamya or servimusiya; gulamya ji gulamli xogyo am beposizin fe moy sesu tipo.
Sentence: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms.

Jumle: Mon 5.
Sentence: Article 5

Jumle: Nilte am suferi xikenje nor kruel, burinsanli or sungenkal doyday or seza.
Sentence: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.

Jumle: Mon 6.
Sentence: Article 6

Jumle: Moyte haki na beswikara denpul kom person fe oko de lega moyloka.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to recognition everywhere as a person before the law.

Jumle: Mon 7.
Sentence: Article 7

Jumle: Moyte sen egal fe oko de lega, ji moyte haki, nenhar diskrimina, egal legali gardi.
Sentence: All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law.

Jumle: Moyte haki egal gardi anti he ban diskrimina hu da posfolo hin deklara, ji anti he ban provoka cel denpul diskrimina.
Sentence: All are entitled to equal protection against any discrimination in violation of this Declaration and against any incitement to such discrimination.

Jumle: Mon 8.
Sentence: Article 8

Jumle: Moyte haki efetoabil xuli fal kompeten nasyonli hukimutim kos aksyon hu da posfolo basili haki gibedo tas te fal krasidoku or lega.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to an effective remedy by the competent national tribunals for acts violating the fundamental rights granted him by the constitution or by law.

Jumle: Mon 9.
Sentence: Article 9

Jumle: Nilte am suferi sebakal aresto, poshurugi or exdexagi.
Sentence: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.

Jumle: Mon 10.
Sentence: Article 10

Jumle: Moyte haki, har pul egalya, adil ji demoli saypan fal ikawkal ji tarafkal hukimutim, cel na karar tesu haki ji musiya, ji he ban krimenli iteham anti te.
Sentence: Everyone is entitled in full equality to a fair and public hearing by an independent and impartial tribunal, in the determination of his rights and obligations and of any criminal charge against him.

Jumle: Mon 11.
Sentence: Article 11

Jumle: (1) Moyte itehamdo kos sezaible krimen haki na bejadin yozaykal finfe na bejenmin yozaypul fol lega in demoli saypan, hu in da te le taslum moy garanti hajado cel sesu bawe.
Sentence: Everyone charged with a penal offence has the right to be presumed innocent until proved guilty according to law in a public trial at which he has had all the guarantees necessary for his defence.

Jumle: (2) Nilte am bejadin yozaypul fe he ban sezaible krimen kos fale or nenfale hu da le no monkrea sezaible krimen, fol nasyonli or intrenasyonli lega, denwatu hu to le beokurgi.
Sentence: No one shall be held guilty of any penal offence on account of any act or omission which did not constitute a penal offence, under national or international law, at the time when it was committed.

Jumle: Maxmo bala seza am pia no begibe kom dento hu da le sen aplikaible denwatu hu sezaible krimen le beokurgi.
Sentence: Nor shall a heavier penalty be imposed than the one that was applicable at the time the penal offence was committed.

Jumle: Mon 12.
Sentence: Article 12

Jumle: Nilte am suferi sebakal ganxopu fe sesu privatoya, famil, ogar or posta, nor atake anti sesu xerafu or reputasi.
Sentence: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary interference with his privacy, family, home or correspondence, nor to attacks upon his honour and reputation.

Jumle: Moyte haki legali gardi anti denpul ganxopu or atake.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks.

Jumle: Mon 13.
Sentence: Article 13

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki huruya fe harka ji ogar fe inya de byen de moyun dexa.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each state.

Jumle: (2) Moyte haki na exidi he ban dexa, fe inkludi fe suli to, ji na ruata cel sesu dexa.
Sentence: (2) Everyone has the right to leave any country, including his own, and to return to his country.

Jumle: Mon 14.
Sentence: Article 14

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki na peti ji na taslum in alo dexa binan of bohay.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution.

Jumle: (2) Hin haki no sen celvokaible fe kaso fe hukimuli bohay hu da real asel of nenpolitili krimen or of fale antipul fe cele ji principi de Uncudo Nasyonlari.
Sentence: (2) This right may not be invoked in the case of prosecutions genuinely arising from non-political crimes or from acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

Jumle: Mon 15.
Sentence: Article 15

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki nasyonya.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to a nationality.

Jumle: (2) Of nilte, ren am sebakal awcudu tesu nasyonya, ji tas nilte, ren am noya haki na alogi tesu nasyonya.
Sentence: (2) No one shall be arbitrarily deprived of his nationality nor denied the right to change his nationality.

Jumle: Mon 16.
Sentence: Article 16

Jumle: (1) Moy ixu, nenhar he ban limitexey kos rasa, nasyonya or dini, haki na gamicu ji xoru famil.
Sentence: (1) Men and women of full age, without any limitation due to race, nationality or religion, have the right to marry and to found a family.

Jumle: Ete hare egal haki fe gamicu, dur gamiya ji fe posgamicu.
Sentence: They are entitled to equal rights as to marriage, during marriage and at its dissolution.

Jumle: (2) Gamicu am okur sol fol huru ji pul dongwi de nyatune gamiduayen.
Sentence: (2) Marriage shall be entered into only with the free and full consent of the intending spouses.

Jumle: (3) Famil sen naturali ji basili grupoli unxey de sosyaltim, ji te haki na taslum gardi fal sosyaltim ji dexa.
Sentence: (3) The family is the natural and fundamental group unit of society and is entitled to protection by society and the State.

Jumle: Mon 17.
Sentence: Article 17

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki na suya milki, iji solo ji fe asosya ton alote.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to own property alone as well as in association with others.

Jumle: (2) Of nilte, ren am sebakal awcudu tesu milki.
Sentence: (2) No one shall be arbitrarily deprived of his property.

Jumle: Mon 18.
Sentence: Article 18

Jumle: Moyte haki huruya fe fikir, yoxin ji dini; hin haki inkludi huruya na alogi sesu dini or imanu, ji huruya, solo or in komuntim ton alote, ji demoli or privato, na vyata sesu dini or imanu yon alim, pratika, ibada ji jaxne.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion; this right includes freedom to change his religion or belief, and freedom, either alone or in community with others and in public or private, to manifest his religion or belief in teaching, practice, worship and observance.

Jumle: Mon 19.
Sentence: Article 19

Jumle: Moyte haki huruya fe ijen ji vyata; hin haki inkludi huruya na hare ijen nenhar ganxopu fal alote, ji na peti, taslum ji komunika informe ji idey yon he ban medya ji nenhar kolyo tem dexa-byen.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression; this right includes freedom to hold opinions without interference and to seek, receive and impart information and ideas through any media and regardless of frontiers.

Jumle: Mon 20.
Sentence: Article 20

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki huruya fe xantipul tonata ji asosya.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to freedom of peaceful assembly and association.

Jumle: (2) Nilte am bemusigi na deya asosyatim.
Sentence: (2) No one may be compelled to belong to an association.

Jumle: Mon 21.
Sentence: Article 21

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki na rol in krasi fe sesu dexa, oro jinji or yon hurumo seletido wakilyen.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to take part in the government of his country, directly or through freely chosen representatives.

Jumle: (2) Moyte haki egal celidi fe demoli servi in sesu dexa.
Sentence: (2) Everyone has the right of equal access to public service in his country.

Jumle: (3) Vole de demo am sen basi de awtorita de krasitim; hin vole am bevyata yon watumonli ji awtenti tupyoli seleti hu da am okur yon moyli ji egal tupyoli haki, ji yon sirili tupyo or egaljacipul proceso fe huru tupyo.
Sentence: (3) The will of the people shall be the basis of the authority of government; this will shall be expressed in periodic and genuine elections which shall be by universal and equal suffrage and shall be held by secret vote or by equivalent free voting procedures.

Jumle: Mon 22.
Sentence: Article 22

Jumle: Moyte, kom membro de sosyaltim, haki sosyal anjenya ji, yon nasyonli juhudi ji intrenasyonli tonaksyon ji fe dongwi ton organisa ji resurso de moy nasyon, moyte haki pia realgi fe den ekonomili, sosyal ji kulturali haki beharemusi cel tesu sungen ji cel huru evolu fe tesu personya.
Sentence: Everyone, as a member of society, has the right to social security and is entitled to realization, through national effort and international co-operation and in accordance with the organization and resources of each State, of the economic, social and cultural rights indispensable for his dignity and the free development of his personality.

Jumle: Mon 23.
Sentence: Article 23

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki ergo, huru seleti fe sesu ergoxey, adil ji propul ergoli halu ji pia gardi anti ergokalya.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to work, to free choice of employment, to just and favourable conditions of work and to protection against unemployment.

Jumle: (2) Moyte, nenhar he ban diskrimina, haki egal paya por egal ergo.
Sentence: (2) Everyone, without any discrimination, has the right to equal pay for equal work.

Jumle: (3) Moyte hu da ergo haki adil ji propul bocan hu da am yakingi, tas seli te ji tesu famil, sonzay laye fe insanli sungen, ji bucundo, fol haja, fal alo resurso fe sosyal gardi.
Sentence: (3) Everyone who works has the right to just and favourable remuneration ensuring for himself and his family an existence worthy of human dignity, and supplemented, if necessary, by other means of social protection.

Jumle: (4) Moyte haki na organisa ji na membrocu in ergoli asosyatim cel na gardi sesu muhimxey.
Sentence: (4) Everyone has the right to form and to join trade unions for the protection of his interests.

Jumle: Mon 24.
Sentence: Article 24

Jumle: Moyte haki rahatu ji huru watu, fe inkludi fe rasonapul limitexey fe ergoli satu ji watumonli jaxnedin har paya.
Sentence: Everyone has the right to rest and leisure, including reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.

Jumle: Mon 25.
Sentence: Article 25

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki jiwali jotay kufi cel sehaya ji bonjotay de seli te ji de tesu famil, fe inkludi fe engyan, labas, ogardom, medisli jawgu ji hajado sosyal servi.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to a standard of living adequate for the health and well-being of himself and of his family, including food, clothing, housing and medical care and necessary social services,

Jumle: Moyte haki pia anjenya fe okur fe ergokalya, bimarya, nenabilya, gwafuya, laoya or alo sonxi fe jiwali resurso kos halu ex sesu kowa.
Sentence: and the right to security in the event of unemployment, sickness, disability, widowhood, old age or other lack of livelihood in circumstances beyond his control.

Jumle: (2) Matreya ji niniya hakigi espesyal jawgu ji sahay.
Sentence: (2) Motherhood and childhood are entitled to special care and assistance.

Jumle: Moy nini, kama ete xencu in kam ex gamiya, am taslum sama sosyal gardi.
Sentence: All children, whether born in or out of wedlock, shall enjoy the same social protection.

Jumle: Mon 26.
Sentence: Article 26

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki eskolya.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right to education.

Jumle: Eskolya am sen kimakal, minimum fe genoli ji basili fase.
Sentence: Education shall be free, at least in the elementary and fundamental stages.

Jumle: Genoli eskolya am sen okurmusi.
Sentence: Elementary education shall be compulsory.

Jumle: Teknikali ji profesili eskolya am sen umumimo hareible, ji maxmo gao eskolya am sen egalmo hareible tas moyte fol layeya.
Sentence: Technical and professional education shall be made generally available and higher education shall be equally accessible to all on the basis of merit.

Jumle: (2) Eskolya am cele na pul evolu fe insanli personya ji na balagi ehtiram fe insanli haki ji basili huruya.
Sentence: (2) Education shall be directed to the full development of the human personality and to the strengthening of respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms.

Jumle: To am xunjan aham, tahamul ji dosteya intre moy nasyon, rasali ji dinili grupo, ji am frongi aksyon fal Uncudo Nasyonlari pro hifazi fe xanti.
Sentence: It shall promote understanding, tolerance and friendship among all nations, racial or religious groups, and shall further the activities of the United Nations for the maintenance of peace.

Jumle: (3) Atre haki fe unyum turno na seleti tipo fe eskolya hu da am begibe tas tesu bete.
Sentence: (3) Parents have a prior right to choose the kind of education that shall be given to their children.

Jumle: Mon 27.
Sentence: Article 27

Jumle: (1) Moyte haki na huru rol in kulturali jiwa de komuntim, na befuraha arte ji na rol in syensili frongi ji tosu fayda.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has the right freely to participate in the cultural life of the community, to enjoy the arts and to share in scientific advancement and its benefits.

Jumle: (2) Moyte haki gardi fe dodukuli ji maderili muhimxey hu da resulta of he ban syensili, literaturli or arteli produti hu te le krea da.
Sentence: (2) Everyone has the right to the protection of the moral and material interests resulting from any scientific, literary or artistic production of which he is the author.

Jumle: Mon 28.
Sentence: Article 28

Jumle: Moyte haki sosyal ji intrenasyonli ordenu hu in da haki ji huruya dingyado in hin deklara abil na pul berealgi.
Sentence: Everyone is entitled to a social and international order in which the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration can be fully realized.

Jumle: Mon 29.
Sentence: Article 29

Jumle: (1) Moyte hare musiya tas komuntim hu sol in da te abil na huru ji pul evolu sesu personya.
Sentence: (1) Everyone has duties to the community in which alone the free and full development of his personality is possible.

Jumle: (2) Fe aplika fe sesu haki ji huruya, moyte am bebaxplasi sol fe den limitexey hu da legali beestabli sol har cele na yakingi nasibupul swikara ji ehtiram fe haki ji huruya de alote ji na trutigi adil xucyo fe doduku, demoli ordenu ji umumi bonjiwa in demokrasili sosyaltim.
Sentence: (2) In the exercise of his rights and freedoms, everyone shall be subject only to such limitations as are determined by law solely for the purpose of securing due recognition and respect for the rights and freedoms of others and of meeting the just requirements of morality, public order and the general welfare in a democratic society.

Jumle: (3) Hin plu haki ji huruya abil fe nil kaso na beaplika antipul fe cele ji principi de Uncudo Nasyonlari.
Sentence: (3) These rights and freedoms may in no case be exercised contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

Jumle: Mon 30.
Sentence: Article 30

Jumle: Nilto in hin deklara am betafasir denpul kom anxi hu he ban nasyon, grupo or person hare he ban haki na rol fe he ban aksyonya or na okurgi he ban fale hu da cele na destrui he banto of haki ji huruya dingyado in hinto.
Sentence: Nothing in this Declaration may be interpreted as implying for any State, group or person any right to engage in any activity or to perform any act aimed at the destruction of any of the rights and freedoms set forth herein.

Jumle: Mesi tiga, 2021
Mi xidu na eskri yon ordinari lexi ji jandan jumle.
Sentence: I try to write using ordinary words and simple sentences.

Jumle: Denpul eskri sen maxmo asan na doxo, ji folki banto sen maxmo asan na doxo, doxoyen maxmo amiku intreaksyon ton to.
Sentence: That kind of writing is easier to read, and the easier something is to read, the more deeply readers will engage with it.

Jumle: Folki ete min yongu energi kos yusu eskrili estilo, ete xa hare max restado to tas yusu idey.
Sentence: The less energy they expend on your prose, the more they'll have left for your ideas.

Jumle: Ji ete xa maxmo lungo doxo.
Sentence: And the further they'll read.

Jumle: Energi de maxori doxoyen filya na daifucu xafe na doxo bage of makale or esey.
Sentence: Most readers' energy tends to flag part way through an article or essay.

Jumle: Eger doxoli motsu sen kufimo xosu, max te duregi finfe fini.
Sentence: If the friction of reading is low enough, more keep going till the end.

Jumle: Hay Italili yam hu ren namegi da saltimbocca, hu da mena “tyao cel in munte”.
Sentence: There's an Italian dish called saltimbocca, which means "leap into the mouth."

Jumle: Misu cele denwatu hu mi eskri abil na name saltintesta: idey tyao cel in yusu kapi ji yu eskaso xorjui lexi hu da le plasi oto denloka.
Sentence: My goal when writing might be called saltintesta: the ideas leap into your head and you barely notice the words that got them there.

Jumle: To sen godo na onxala ki he banwatu eskri ger abil na sen solli idey.
Sentence: It's too much to hope that writing could ever be pure ideas.

Jumle: Ible, yu no hata vole dento.
Sentence: You might not even want it to be.

Jumle: Mas tas maxori eskriyen, fe maxori mara, dento sen cele.
Sentence: But for most writers, most of the time, that's the goal to aim for.

Jumle: Kungan intre maxori eskri ji solli idey no bepulgi poemaya.
Sentence: The gap between most writing and pure ideas is not filled with poetry.

Jumle: Maxpul, na eskri jandan sen maxmo lutufpul.
Sentence: Plus it's more considerate to write simply.

Jumle: Denwatu hu yu eskri fe dekorapul maner cel na inxo insan, yu kosa ki ete maxpul ergo sol celki yu abil na kwasisen estilopul.
Sentence: When you write in a fancy way to impress people, you're making them do extra work just so you can seem cool.

Jumle: To sen sim fe na pospel lungo fustanli koda fe yusu ruke hu yusu doxoyen musi na porta da.
Sentence: It's like trailing a long train behind you that readers have to carry.

Jumle: Ji am memori, eger yu eskri in Englisa, ki multi te of yusu doxoyen xa no sen aselli Englisayen.
Sentence: And remember, if you're writing in English, that a lot of your readers won't be native English speakers.

Jumle: Ible, etesu aham fe idey sen maxmo suprali kom etesu aham in Englisa.
Sentence: Their understanding of ideas may be way ahead of their understanding of English.

Jumle: Fe folo, yu no abil na jadin ki na eskri tem katina tema mena ki yu abil na yongu katina lexi.
Sentence: So you can't assume that writing about a difficult topic means you can use difficult words.

Jumle: Mimbay, dekorapul eskri no sol sangu idey.
Sentence: Of course, fancy writing doesn't just conceal ideas.

Jumle: Pia, to abil na sangu otosu poshay.
Sentence: It can also conceal the lack of them.

Jumle: Denseba ban insan denpul dueskri, cel na sangu fato ki ete hare nilto na loga.
Sentence: That's why some people write that way, to conceal the fact that they have nothing to say.

Jumle: Fe kompara, na jandan eskri sengi yu durepulmo cipenkal.
Sentence: Whereas writing simply keeps you honest.

Jumle: Eger yu loga nilto jandan, to xa sen mimbay tas moyte, fe inkludi tas yu.
Sentence: If you say nothing simply, it will be obvious to everyone, including you.

Jumle: Jandan eskri pia maxmo bon dudure.
Sentence: Simple writing also lasts better.

Jumle: Insan hu da xa doxo yusu xey fe xaya xa sen fe banmo sama halu kom insan of alo dexa hu da doxo to nundin.
Sentence: People reading your stuff in the future will be in much the same position as people from other countries reading it today.

Jumle: Kultura ji basa xa le alocu.
Sentence: The culture and the language will have changed.

Jumle: Yu no sen burfahuri eger dento sen muhim tas yu, samamaner hu to no sen burfahuri, ki moksayyen kostrui kursi cel na dure.
Sentence: It's not vain to care about that, any more than it's vain for a woodworker to build a chair to last.

Jumle: Sipul, dudure no sen sol xigoli sifa de kursi, or de eskri.
Sentence: Indeed, lasting is not merely an accidental quality of chairs, or writing.

Jumle: To sen ixara ki yu le ergo bon.
Sentence: It's a sign you did a good job.

Jumle: Mas fe hataya ki moy hinto sen real fayda of na eskri jandan, nilto of oto sen seba hu mi fale to.
Sentence: But although these are all real advantages of writing simply, none of them are why I do it.

Jumle: Cuyo seba hu mi dueskri jandan sen ki na nenjandan eskri cufam mi.
Sentence: The main reason I write simply is that it offends me not to.

Jumle: Denwatu hu mi eskri jumle hu da kwasisen godomo fukuza, or hu da yongu hajakalmo eskolyapul lexi, to no kwasisen dekorapul tas mi.
Sentence: When I write a sentence that seems too complicated, or that uses unnecessarily intellectual words, it doesn't seem fancy to me.

Jumle: To kwasisen maharakal.
Sentence: It seems clumsy.

Jumle: Mimbay, hay mara hu denwatu yu vole na yongu fukuza jumle or dekorapul lexi cel efeto.
Sentence: There are of course times when you want to use a complicated sentence or fancy word for effect.

Jumle: Mas yu ingay na nilwatu fale to nyatukal.
Sentence: But you should never do it by accident.

Jumle: Alo seba hu misu eskri fe fini sen jandan sen to hu denmaner mi fale to.
Sentence: The other reason my writing ends up being simple is the way I do it.

Jumle: Mi velosi eskri unyum xoreskrixey, ji xafe to, mi yongu plu din na penci to, fe na xidu na kosa ki moyto am sen precisomo sahi.
Sentence: I write the first draft fast, then spend days editing it, trying to get everything just right.

Jumle: Multi to of hin penci sen na awjeti, ji dento kosa ki jandan eskri sencu hata maxmo jandan.
Sentence: Much of this editing is cutting, and that makes simple writing even simpler.

Jumle: Exkunganli Hewan
“Navikef Babur, imi preata cel Zuhura xafe kekwanti watu?” ospuro le swal.
“Xafe un safta, daju,” navikef jawabu.
“Waone! Imi velosi dao. Mi uje vole na oko den sofipul insan, mas, kam yu sen yakin ki hay insan in Zuhura?”
“Mi sen totalyakin. Am no yolyu tem to, xwexiyen ospuro.”
Telixali, denwatu hu ete preata cel den posdostefil planeta, day bofun treme etesu navi.
Ospuro cihe, “Imi xa morcu!”
Mas navikef Babur dadal na andingi navi ji to pergeocu.
Denwatu, te loga, “Kwasi, imi preata cel Zuhura fe mal mosem.”
Jaxali, injeneriyen Koala nercu ji te loga, “Navikef Babur, hay problema: imisu navi xucyo xuli.”
Xafe juipul analisi, teknikatim denya ki energimamba fe fronpel de navi sen sungaydo.
Navikef ji kentantim, har presyonkostum, excu cel na xerca insanli sahay, mas ete no ewreka insan, ji fe asif, Ospuro becudu dayvento.
Ete no abil na ewreka Ospuro; fe folo, ete ruata cel navi.
Xafe watumon, teknikatim xorganci, yon radar, ban metal-estrutur hu da hanman nercu cel navi.
Ete oko ekrin fe filmetul; fe folo, ete xorjui ki te sen bwawsunayen hu da preporta Ospuro in sesu mekanili gebo.
Den metalli bwaw kwasi vole na sahay, ji kos to, ete izin tas te na inidi navi.
Xafe dento, ete medis Ospuro hu da sen sol ixikalcudo.
Bacelor Jojiha, of Hewanli Resurso, swal tas sunayen, “Senyor, yusu name sen keto?”
Ji te jawabu, “Bwaw!”
“Nunto, senyor Bwaw, kam yu am sahay imi cel na xuli imisu navi, fe lutuf?” bacelor swal.
“Bwaw!” metalli bwaw ripul jawabu.
Ji fori, te eskan navi, te ewreka problema, ji xafe analisi, te karar na haregi sesu energi tas navi.
Jaxali, te linku sesu energimamba, yon sesu mekanili gebo, tas energimamba fe fronpel de navi.
Moyte in navi parti koski to ripul abil na fley.
Ete ruata cel sesu planeta, ji fe hataya ki ete no xorkone insan, ete ewreka neo doste.
Roya de Kiwi
Kiwi le vole na fley, denseba, te idi cel gufa de lao hufax cel na peti sahay.
“Am tonporta mi cel asman, fe lutuf. Denmaner, mi xa dadal misu roya fe abil na fley,” kiwi peti tas hufax.

Hufax ganjon simpati tas kiwi ji te loga, “Mi ger suki na fale dento, mas, mi no sen kufimo bala cel na tonporta yu; fe hataya, mi jixi ki ukabu sen bala ji te abil na sahay yu, mas, te ogar teli, tras bahari.”
Kiwi no taradudu ji, xafe dento, te sangu in navi cel na trasidi bahari, cel na peti sahay tas ukabu.
Xafe lungo dudao, kiwi preata cel teli daygeo ji te xoru na xerca ukabu moyloka.
Xafe multi duxerca, fe fini, kiwi ewreka te in gao jabal.
“Salom, senyor ukabu, mi sen kiwi ji mi ger suki na peti lutufxey tas yu.”
Ukabu jixivoleli oko kiwi ji te loga, “Kiwi, e… Mi le nilwatu oko piu hu da okocu sim kom yu. Yu peti lutufxey tas mi keseba? Kam yu no jixi ki mi abil na awyam yu?”
“Si, mi jixi dento, mas, unyum ji fe lutuf, am tonporta mi cel maximum gaoya in asman. Dento sen misu roya, na abil na gao fley. Xafe dento, yu abil na awyam mi.”
Ukabu besurprisa fobikalya de kiwi ji te loga, “Mi fikir ki dento sen majnuni roya, hatali, mi xa fale dento hu yu peti da tas mi.”
Fori xafe dento, ukabu woju kiwi yon sesu daynakun, te xorfley ji, denmaner, te dadal dayday gaoje.
“Kam yu furaha hin okoxey?” Ukabu swal dur na fley.
Kiwi xoru na wawa.
“Yu wawa keseba? Hinto sen yusu roya. Kam yu nun no suki to?”
“No, to no sen dento. Mi multi suki na fley. Mi daysuki to. Mi wawa koski mi sen daymo hox,” kiwi jawabu.
Ukabu xoru na aham neo banto hu da xorharka in sesu tutum.
Denwatu hu ete pergeocu in ban medan, kiwi swal, “Nunto, kam yu xa awyam mi?”
“No, kiwi no sen misu preferido menumon. Am awidi lefe ki mi sen yampeldo.”
Ji, fori xafe dento, ukabu ruidi cel sesu jabal.
Interviu in Kafedom
Ana le oko ban ixara in dwer de kafedom: “Kafeyen sen hajado.”
Te karar na inidi.
Suyayen presencu fe onexamesa durki ban klienteli duayen trankwilo glu kafe.
Hwanjin sen sotikal ji furahane.
Ana nercu cel suyayen.
—Bondin.
—Bondin, junisenyor. Mi abil na sahay yu kemaner?
—Mi ata kos ixara fe ergo.
—Daywaone! Imi abil na pala durki imi glu kafe, eger yu vole.
Ete side fe ban ixgalukal mesa.
Suyayen servi dua fenjan har kafe hu da sen buharne.
—Yusu name sen keto?
—Ana Lopez.
—To sen yukwe na xorkone yu, Ana. Mi sen Edwardo Montiel. Mi hare hin kafedom xorlefe des nyan. Mi haja neo kafeyen koski jaleli te le gami ji te xorogar in alo xaher. Yu sen of keloka?
—Mi sen of hinloka, of lilxaher Aloe.
—Kam yu estudi banto?
—Si, grafikali diseno ji anima, fe axam. Kos dento, mi xerca ergo fe soba or fe noce.
—Mi aham. Kam yu abil na ata xorfe lunadin finfe zuhuradin, xorfe satu sabe finfe satu des dua? Ergo no sen katina ji paya sen bon.
—To sen perfeto tas mi. Mi xoru na ergo kewatu?
—Jaxadin fe soba, eger to sen bon tas yu.
—Si, multi xukra, senyor Edwardo. Finfe xaya!
Rita ji Watu-maxina
Rita le sen universitali xwexiyen fe arkitetur hu da laoje duades (20) nyan.
Dur na side in sofa in sesu apartamen, te yuxi Moba fe Kendi yon sesu telifon.
Abruto, un femixu precu fe fronta de te.
Hin precu betonya kurto brila, lilsoti ji lilvento.
Hin nenkonedo femixu kwasisen ixu hu da laoje tigades (30) nyan.
Te labas esportuli sapatu, denimli blue xortu, orange blusa, solalense ji syahe lilgardanbendu har plu fidasim kantaka.
Tesu tofa sen pinku, kurto ji cenguli.
Rita cihe dur na velosi tatmini halulari.
Unyum, te fobi.
Jaxali, te surprisa ji jixivole ku den femixu precu kemaner.
“Yu sen kete ji yu le fale keto cel na precu in misu kamer!?”
“Xanti, Rita. Mi asif kos na fobi yu,” nenkonedoyen loga dur na tabasum.
“Misu name sen Rita Monges ji mi ata of xaya, maxmo preciso, of nyan duakilo limades un (2051).”
“Rita Monges? Mas… mas… dento sen misu name! Am intizar… Yu nyatu keto temki yu ata of xaya? Kam yu sen mi?”
“Preciso! Mi sen yu, mas of xaya.”
“Hinto sen majnuniya!”
Juni Rita no abil na imanu dento hu da okur.
Te motsu sesu pelipis ji te kurto comenli anda.
Fe na hisicu maxmo trankwilo, te karar na swikara daywaone okurxey har trankwiloya, fe folo ki te oko he nil hatari.
“'Mi of xaya', yu laoje kenumer nyan? Kam tigades (30)?”
“No, azizu te. Mi no laoje tigades nyan, mi laoje caredes lima (45) nyan,” Rita of xaya furahado loga kos den nennyatudo cosan.
“Mi fikir ki na namegi mi 'mi of xaya' no orecu bon. Kam yu ger suki na namegi mi day Rita? Kam yu ger suki na benamegi mi lil Rita?”
“Si… Day Rita… To sen bon. Mi izin yu na namegi mi lil Rita.”
Day Rita side fe comen de lil Rita.
“Yusu watumaxina sen keloka?” lil Rita swal.
“Hin lilgardanbendu sen misu watumaxina,” day Rita jawabu dur na ixara yon dari hoy sesu gardan.
Te pia xomin ki to sen cinonpul tora har multi funsyon hu da funsyon yon vokali amiru.
“Em… Lilmo ajabu… Fe gwaho, mi no vole na sen adebukal, mas yusu tofa-estilo interes mi. Yu seleti pinku kolor keseba? Mi nyatu na loga ki to nasibu yu,” lil Rita komenta.
“Xukra. Mi suki ki yu velosi xinloy mi. Nunto, mi seleti hin kolor koski mi suki to.”
“Yu dao of xaya tas hin momento keseba?”
“Mi hoxcu kos den swal.
Mi ata of xaya koski mi sen watugardiyen.
Mi ergo in sirili firma fe watu hu da xidu na anjen bongi histori.
Mas imi no harizin na ganxopu in muhim okur fe hataya ki oto sen afatupul, unyum, koski imi no abil na fale to ji, duayum, koski na fale dento ger kosa day hataripul alogi in histori.
Denseba, misu misyon sen jandan: mi musi na yakincu ki yu triunfa in ban turnamen fe xahu fe mesi des un fe hin nyan, duakilo duades sisa (2026).”
Lil Rita analisi dento hu da day Rita jale loga da ji te loga, “Mi aham, mas, ki mi am triunfa in den xahuli turnamen behaja keseba?”
“Mi xa xomin to tas yu.
Mi haja ki yu xekaste Martin Toledo in den turnamen.
Te sen xwexiyen fe injeneri.
Te no sen daymo maharapul in xahu; te hare sol kilo sabecen (1700) pwen fe ELO, mas den pwen sen kufi cel na xekaste moyte in hin xaher koski insan fe hinloka no multi yuxi xahu.
Eger te triunfa in den turnamen, te xa cudu moypayado dao cel Norge cel na konkure anti gaodarajeli xahuyen.
Kom yu abil na imaje, Martin xa velosi postriunfa moy yuxi denloka, fe folo, te daydepresicu.”
“Sol dento?” lil Rita gitayfrustrado swal.

“Yu peti tas mi ki mi xekaste Martin celki te no kingem xyuci anti usta yuxiyen? Mi no vole na kwasisen bur insan ji mi vole ki he nilte depresicu, hatali, mi no suki idey tem multi treyna kos dento.”
“Yu sahiloga tem dento, mas na bloki ki Martin depresi sen noro solo nor maxim muhim cele fe hin misyon.
Imi cele ki te fol lega postriunfa ki fe folo te vole na ultrapasa yu ban din koski te sen daymo konkurefil.
Xafe ki te maxgi sesu daraje, te xa vole na krea inhare fe YuKabel, hu da ilhamu max kom kilo juniyen cel na xwexi hin zarif esportu, mas dento haji no sen maxim muhim bage fe hin misyon.
Hin plu neo ilhamudo xahuyen xa krea xayali projeto hu da frongi jawgu fe hwanjin yon xahu.
Mi no harizin na gibe max detale tem hin projeto tas yu.”
“Mi aham, mas, he mi musi na xekaste Martin keseba? Alo insan abil na fale to, kam no?”

“Koski yu suya kwalita fe watugardiyen. Fe maxusya, mi jixi ki yu sen riskojuine ji yu jixi na hifazi siri. Ren uje fale kalkulus in misu firma fe watu ji ren finrasona ki hin ergomon sen perfeto tas yu.”
“Mi aham, mas mi no bon yuxi. Mi sol hare kilo carecen (1400) pwen fe ELO, dento no sen kufi cel na xekaste Martin.”
“Denseba, mi sen hinloka.
Mi sen Gaoalimyen fe Xahu har duakilo limacen sisades (2560) pwen fe ELO.
Mi xa istruksi yu ji, denmaner, yu xa dadal duakilo tigacen (2300) pwen fe ELO fol den logado kalkulus.
Yu xa sen Intrenasyonli Fem Alimyen fe xahu xafe sisa mesi!
Martin xa nilmaner abil na xekaste yu.”
“Den idey uje besuki mi, mas… e… mi xa bepaya?”
Day Rita haha ji loga, “Mimbay! Mas mi no harizin na gibe pesa tas yu. Mi xa kari tableta tas yu xafe turnamen. Fe maxusya, yu xa taslum jayeza fe turnamen ji titulo fe Intrenasyonli Fem Alimyen.”
“Suprem! Kam mi abil na swal tem yusu ergo?”
“Mi abil na loga sol ki misu ergo gwanxi xahu, watudao ji arkitetur. Am no fikir tem na awrestagi hin yusu profesi, nini.”
Xaki day Rita xomin cele de misyon tas lil Rita, ete tonkarar ki dente xa regulapul visita hinte cel na treyna te fe xahu.
Day Rita lilalogi sesu daraje denwatu hu te yuxi xahu anti lil Rita.
Te xomin muhim tema fe xahu tas lil Rita: beyongupul buka, bawe, motif, tatika, plasi, fini, analisi, jmt.
Xafe dua mesi fe treyna, lil Rita dadal kilo ococen (1800) pwen fe ELO.
“Hin daraje sen bon, yu uje abil na xekaste Martin, mas, imi haji musi na yakingi triunfa. Yusu triunfa musi na sen dispresyonne,” day Rita loga.
“Yu sen daydenmo bur! Kam yu vole ki mi daydenmo multi suferigi naive Martin?”
“Mimbay no, nini, mas denmaner, to sen maxmo bon cel misyon, fe maxusya, na max xwexi xa sahay yu cel yusu xayali profesi kom xahuyen.”
Dumarali, ete tongo exata cel na kari, na xafeyam or na jandan sampo.
Day Rita, moywatu, labas solalense ji kwasigi na sen teli kuzin de lil Rita hu da name Deysi.
Te kwasigi pia na sen hajul ji sotikal cel na hwepi na ganxopu fe nunli watu.
Moywatu hu ete idi cel he banloka, day Rita nostaljicu tem multi xey hu da sen bonkonedo or posamusane tas lil Rita.
Denwatu hu care mesi pasa.
Lil Rita dadal duakilo cen (2100) pwen fe ELO kos treyna.
“To sen amusane. Kos yusu darsu ji na moydinli innetoli yuxi in Lilixahu, mi hisi ki mi xorlubi hin yuxi. Yu yozay ki mi burfilya cel xahu!” lil Rita humor.
Finili, mesi des un preata.
Lil Rita dadal duakilo tigacen limades (2350) pwen fe ELO, multi maxim day to in xaher.
Fe din des dua fe mesi des un, lil Rita ineskricu in turnamen.
Te betonya Deysi (day Rita).
“Mi dayansya, to sen unyum mara ki mi rol in hinpul okurxey. Hinloka, moyte kwasisen cinonpul,” lil Rita loga.
“Am sen trankwilo, yu musi sol na resta laxo ji na fokus. Moyto xa sen bon,” day Rita yunkigi te.
“Kam mi abil na jixi ku Martin sen kete?”
“Te sen den juniyen har lungo tofa ji kijawi ite-kamisa. To xa sen maxmo bon ki yu hwepi na oko te dur lungo watu cel na hwepi na kwasisen giximlaye.”
Martin ruwojune estay yon divar, fe na intizar xoru fe turnamen.
Fe ban momento, ete soho oko, mas fori xafe to, lil Rita alogi cele de sesu oko dur na fikir, “Te kwasisen jidi ji sexinloypul.”
Fe sesu bage, Martin fikir, “To sen ajabu ki bante vole na oko mi.”
Xafe ban minuto, rolyen side cel na konkure ji unyum plu yuxi xoru.
Lil Rita asan ji velosi triunfa plu unyum yuxi, denseba, day Rita nasiha tas te na xidu na maxmo hanman yuxi.
Pia Martin velosi triunfa moy yuxi.
Fe fini, finili yuxi preata: lil Rita anti Martin.
Multi insan weycu cel na maxmo bon oko yuxi.
Lil Rita xoru yuxi har sefide xahumon yon buka fe Sistema Colle, hu da sen tesu preferido buka fe xahu.
Martin jawabu yon Bawe fe Sicilian cel na xidu na konhwoku Rita, mas, tesu estrutur sen bala har sirili estrategi.
Martin xoraham ki te no abil na kasiru tesu bawe, fe folo, te xidu na porgi xahumon, hatali, te xorwala max xahumon kom Rita in moy harka.
Finili, ete preata cel setin hu da sen totalmo triunfali pro Rita denwatu hu Martin fale malxey hu da izin ki elefan de Rita mismari waziri de Martin.
Martin no abil na imanu ki te nun postriunfa.
Ren jadin ki te sen maxim bon xahuyuxiyen in den xaher, mas nunli te no hare exidi.
Mas te no vole na postriunfa, te, minimum, vole na patu, fe folo, te no teslimu.

Te fikir dur lungo watu ku maxim bon harka sen keto ji, dur na xorjui ki te hare xosu watu in sesu watumeter, te karar na atake waziri de Rita, mas, hinte bujo waziri de Martin dur na gibe xahu tas tesu manwangu.
Martin no hare alo opsyon kom na harka sesu wangu cel gona fe xahutahta.
Fe fini, Rita gibe xahumatu hu da finigi yuxi.
Martin xoku.
Te awtomati weyhanta Rita mas te loga nilto.
Hukimuyen gongaw triunfa de Rita.
Martin sotikal estaycu ji awidi, dur na fikir, “Mi xa multi treyna cel na maxbongi misu daraje.”
Denmaner, Rita cudu moypayado dao tas Norge cel na yuxi anti ustayen fe xahu.
Xafe watumon, te sen denloka.
Te befuraha multi den dao.
Te dadal na xekaste bannumer Gaoalimyen hu da cosan tesu talento fe hataya ki te sen juni.
Day Rita le visita te sol ban dua mara finfe ki te weda cel moywatu.
“Mi xa moywatu sen ton yu koski mi sen yu,” te loga tas lil Rita.
Ete soho weygebo ji day Rita awcu.
“Ajabu weda, ajabu weda…,” lil Rita solo loga lilhazuni.
Lil Rita garizeli jixi ki te ingay na hwepi na intreaksyon ton Martin celki hinte fale resta de misyon.
Nunli, Rita sol ingay na fokus tem sesu profesi ji sesu neo hobi: xahu.
Cay ton Sofia
Ban din, Sofia le idi cel apartamen de Rita cel na bla, na glu cay ji na yuxi xahu.
“Mi besurprisa den day boncu de yu kos alim de yusu kuzin, Deysi.
Fe leya, mi moywatu xekaste yu; fe nunya, he yu moywatu xekaste mi.
Multi xahuyen haja plu nyan cel na dadal den daraje hu yu hare da.
Mi jadin ki Deysi ible hare ban lil siri fe gao alimyen,” Sofia komenta.
“Si… si… Mi jadin ki te sen daymo bon cel na alim. Ible, to sen talento,” Rita loga, dur na kwasigi yolyukal.
“Ji, hay keto tem te?” Sofia swal har nenpimpan jixifil.
“Te ruidi cel Awstrali.”
“O, Interesne! Nunto, kam yu jixi banto, Rita? Maxpul kom na sintesis molekul in misu syensidom, mi fikir ki, ible, ren abil na ewreka maner cel na dao tras watu,” Sofia loga.
Har bokado munte, Rita oko te.
Kam Sofia jixi ki Deysi fatoli sen te, mas of xaya?
No, ible dento sen tasaduf, te fikir.
Rita jixi ki Sofia sen daycinonpul syensiyen hu da pasa multi watu in tesu syensidom dur na fale kimikali jaribi, mas te nilwatu fikir temki te ger interes tem watudao.
“Watudao? Kam dento sen ible?” Rita swal.
“Mi no sen denmo yakin, mas ban sikoli hesabu, hu mi le fale dur na lilpawbu in parke, ixara tas mi ki dento sen banmo… ible,” Sofia loga, dur na xidu na memori.
“Mi jigam ki dento gwanxi fukuza mekani ji haji no poskoberido materyal, fe maner ki ren abil na ruidigi watu wey tyanli xey nenhar na yongu moy energi de kosmo, denmaner hu ban insan jeni.
Mas, denmaner hu yu abil na imaje, dento sen sol misu hipotesis.”
Rita cakarecu kos den xomin, mas te dadal na lilmo aham to.
“O, mi oko… To sen suprem ki yu fikir tem to, mas, mi no jixi ku mi abil na sahay yu kemaner.”
“Kam yu fikir ki to sen ible?” Sofia jidi swal.
“Yu swal dento tas mi keseba? He yu sen ustayen tem denoto tema, no mi.”
“Pia yu sen daycinonpul, azizuyen, ji yu pia hare day imajeya. Kam yu no kolyo to fe leya?”
“Okey, to sen bon.
Mi le jixi ki to sen idey tem fiksyon.
Eger to sen ible, imi ger abil na fale daydenmo multi bon xey, mas pia denpul tekno ger sen hataripul in mal hanta.
Nunto, ible, kosmo abil na majnunicu fe folo ki ban xey ruanda in watu or ki watu ruanda…
Mi loga keto!?
Hata mi no aham hinto hu mi jale loga da…”
Sofia tabasum.
“Yu sen rasonapul, Rita. Insanlari haji no sen jumbi tas denpul fatmin, ji pia kosmo ger abil na sangu ban regula tem dento,” Sofia estay ji maxusgi.
“To sen yukwe na hare hin bla ton yu, ji xukra kos cay ji yuxi fe xahu. Mi dupul duregi na fikir ku mi abil na xekaste yu kemaner. Finfe xaya!”
Ji te exidi.
Uje dur na sen solo, Sofia seloga, “Ay, no… Mi le no jixi ki hinto ger abil na xoru denmo jaldi.”
Sampo in Drevogeo

Te suki na sampo intre drevo, na nasa nasacu de moksay, na ore darakisoti de kasirudo lilxube of bax sesu sapatu, na hisi tazeya de saye.
Te ata cel lilnahir, te side, ofplasi sesu sapatu ji te plasi sesu peda in sui.
Abruto, moyto sotilkalcu.

Te oko day baru hu da nercu.
Rutu yongu antibaruli esprey ji baru xorawidi.
Rutu loga, “Mafu, baru, mas mi no sen peldo na beyam, nundin.”
Jasusiyen Kantaka

Jasusiyen Kantaka, hu da labas syahe labas, hu da koberi sesu total jismu, minus sesu oko, har beltu har ban tul, fale espesyal misyon temki te musi na rucudu Kijawi Cinju, hu da sen bax kowa de hataripul krimentim, hu da belide hataripul lideyen Gubangu, hu da vole na krasi globali ekonomi.

Kantaka dadal na fobi ban gardiyen yon holografi fe xabahu, jaxali, te inidi basidom hu in da te jento multi manixu hu te asan abil na xekaste da ji, fori xafe to, te nenabilgi sistema fe laser hu da gardi Kijawi Cinju.
Te hifazi to in sesu jebu, mas, Gubangu, daybalayen hu da gaoje 2.1 metro, xoratake te.
Agilya de Kantaka no sen kufi cel na xekaste Gubangu, hu da gibe daybala darbe tas te.
Kantaka kriban ixikalcu kos den darbe, mas te velosi fikir ji karar sesu jaxali harka: te jeti Kijawi Cinju pas janela.
Dento awjuigi Gubangu, ji Kantaka yongu den kihoy cel na yongu bomba fe dudan ji na awpawbu.
Denwatu hu Kantaka xerca Kijawi Cinju, te no abil na ewreka to koski ban rakun uje porta to cel sesu goyuogar.
Axam in Hosu
Misu kuzin ji mi anda pas kijawi medan fe den termomosemli xafesoba.
Te loga tas mi ki te vole na onexa hosu hu denloka te ji tesu patre xugwan na mahi.
Imi anda dao fol wairbagor.
Ban duayen fe tero , hu da gardi sesu kyota, kriban atake imi.
Denwatu hu imi ata cel hosu, mi surprisa tem tosu dayje.
To sen maxmo day kom care pedabolli medan.
Misu kuzin peridi ban lilnavi hu da sen dokido in hosubyen ji te invita ki pia mi peridi to.
Imi side ji te padelu hoy midiya de hosu.
Imi no multi bla.
Sotikalya sen lilmo nenkonfortane, mas, imi nerxali xorxugwan to.
Fe fini, te loga ki hosu sen sim kom terapiyen tas te.
Mi ger preferi na yuxi videoyuxi, mas mi aham ki misu kuzin vole na tonyongu den momento ton bante, koski, xugwanpul, te no multi pala tem sesu ganjon.
Fe folo, mi xidu na laxocu cel na jacigi den hadya.
Abruto, asman xoru na luminkalcu.
Ban piu ji koncun xoru na hewansa, na lala, na krea musika hu da asan preata cel imi kos leli sotikalya de hosu.
Ban estare xoru na precu in asman ji ban atexkoncun xidu na konkure anti ete.
Samawatuli, ufuku xoru na rosocu durki Sola infracu ji xorawcu.
Mi sen ganjonpul ji, banmaner, mi vole na wawa, finfe ki misu kuzin xoru na sifrelala melodi har posjijondo sotimon ji, xafe to, te loga, “Nunto, imi ingay na ruidi cel baytu.”
Sandra ji Amanda
Amanda moywatu radya otimaismo.
Te hare multi doste.
Te sen jixifil, amusane, populer ji palafil.
Fe alo comen, Sandra sen sotilil, jandan ji te preferi na solo pasa watu.
Multi te loga ki te sen ajabu koski te max preferi na programa videoyuxi kom na labas modali labas ji na idi cel parti.
Sandra fikir ki multi te sanguli loga coxo tem te.
Ible, dento sen to hu da sengi te sotilil ji posxinloyfil.
Hatali, Amanda vole na sencu doste de Sandra.
Unyum, Sandra xidu na posjui te, mas, xosu xafe xosu, te fikir ki te suki Amanda, fe folo, ete nerxali sencu doste.
Xafe to, Sandra xoru na interes tem maner hu fe da Amanda abil na sen dostefil ji joxufil.
Te hata xiwon na sen sim kom te.
Fe folo, Sandra xoru na konduta fol maner de Amanda: te xoru na max tabasum, na yongu max meykapu, na pala ton max insan, mas, te xoru na wanji na fale xey hu te suki da.
Te wanji na sen he se.
Hatali, Amanda no antiya den neo filya de Sandra.
Ban din, dur parti in baytu de Amanda, Sandra xorjui ki te ganjon kalya.
Te inidi banyokamer ji te xoru na wawa.
Te xoraham ki te nun wanji se.
Amanda, hu da yolyu tem Sandra, swal tas te ku keto okur.
Sandra plasi sesu hanta in tesu ketif ji te jidi loga, “Mi fikir ki to kriban sen satu des dua fe noce. Mi ingay na ruidi cel misu baytu leki mi sencu haulixu.”
Finili, Sandra exidi of parti har ajabu tabasum, mas, to sen tesu awtenti to.

Termodo or Nentermodo Fruta
Avayar le sen Tamil fempoemayen.
Te jiwa fe cennyan 3 LND (lefe nunli daywatumon).
Te sen daycinonpul, mas pia burfahuri.
Ban din, te vole na idi cel alo deha.
Te xoru na anda.
Hay multi termo.
Te rahatu bax drevo.
Drevo sen pul fe syahe prumu.
Mannini folpasa.
Avayar voka te, ji te peti of te na cudu bannumer fruta.
Nini swal tas te kama te vole termodo fruta kam nentermodo fruta.
Te haha ji loga, "Kemaner to sen ible ki fruta sen termodo?"
Nini esraru.
Avayar loga, "Okey, am gibe tas mi termodo fruta."
Nini supraidi drevo.
Te treme ban xube.
Fruta sokutu cel infer per gubarpul geo.
Femixu ofcudu oto.
Te exhawa pas sesu munte cel na awgi gubar.
Nini swal, "Daymama, keseba? Kam to sen termopul?"
Femixu bevinamragi tesu lexiyuxi.
Xorfe den din, te awetiraf sesu burfahuriya.
Basa-taytido fal Srinivasan V R
Halowin
Halowin asel of _Samhain_, daylama Kelti festival hu da le xoru lefe max kom 2000 nyan ji le marka fini de xuha ji xoru de bardimosem.
Insan le imanu ki denwatu, byen intre jiwane insan ji moryen sencu dambo ki fe folo ruho abil na dolantan Dunya.
Dur discu de Kristoismo, hin cwenton le kombina ton Din de Moy Santoyen (din 1, mesi 11).
Leaxam de den din le sencu konedo kom _All Hallows’ Eve_, hu da le bekurtogi xali cel _Halloween_ (Halowin).
In Eskoti ji Eyre, nini le cwentonli labas kostum ji le idi of baytu cel baytu cel na lala, loga poema ji humorxey, or onexa maharaxey por jayeza denpul kom fruta, jozi or pesatoken.
Insan le pia eskultur lenterna of xalgam fe tayti fe daykabaca.

Hijerayen of Eyre ji Eskoti le preporta multi to of hin cwenton cel Utara-Amerika, ji denloka Halowin le darajeli evolu cel dento hu imi kone da nundin: jaxne fe kostum, daykabaca ji cwenton fe na idi of baytu cel baytu cel na taslum kendi.
